Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary

Join athenahealth's Patient Experience (PEX) division as a Product Manager for the Patient Messaging Zone in Bangalore. In this role, you will own a defined product area within Patient Messaging, driving the roadmap for AI-enabled communication capabilities that help patients and care teams connect efficiently and safely. You will work closely with engineering, data science, UX, and analytics teams to deliver messaging experiences that are usable, trustworthy, and grounded in responsible use of AI. This role partners closely with US-based product peers and reports to the Zone's product leadership in Bangalore.

About The Team

The Patient Messaging Zone brings together Product Management, Engineering, UX, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve how patients and provider staff communicate. The team is expanding its use of AI to reduce staff burden while keeping patients safe and informed. This role will help shape product decisions for an assigned area within that portfolio, working in close partnership with the Bangalore development organization and US stakeholders.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Product Strategy & AI-Enabled Delivery

Define and manage the product strategy and roadmap for an assigned area within Patient Messaging.
Learn users' workflows (patients, front-desk/clinical staff) and propose AI-enabled solutions that reduce friction and improve response times.
Collaborate with data science and engineering to shape AI features ensuring they are measurable and appropriate for patient-facing communication.
Define expected behavior for AI-enabled capabilities, including guardrails for trust, explainability, escalation to a human, and handling of low-confidence outputs.
Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements that support engineering delivery, including requirements specific to model behavior, edge cases, and fallback paths.
Use AI-enabled tools and product analytics to inform requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and speed up decision-making across planning and delivery.

Cross-Functional Execution

Work with engineering and scrum teams to prioritize backlog items and guide day-to-day delivery in an Agile environment.
Partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate customer needs, market trends, and competitive signals relevant to patient messaging and conversational AI.
Contribute to product discovery: identifying problems, testing concepts, and validating solutions (including AI-generated outputs) with users and stakeholders.
Monitor product and model performance after release; use feedback, quality metrics, and user input to guide iterative improvement.
Support launch planning, alpha/beta feedback cycles, adoption activities, and resolution of production issues.
Represent the voice of the customer in product and design discussions, balancing efficiency gains from AI against patient safety and data sensitivity considerations.
Coordinate with legal, compliance, security, and patient safety partners on responsible-AI review processes for messaging features.

Collaboration Across Geographies

Work closely with US-based product peers to align on workflow design, requirements, and roadmap sequencing.
Contribute to measurement frameworks for feature and model performance within the zone.
Support continuous improvement efforts across the product lifecycle, including documentation of AI feature behavior for internal and client-facing teams.

Expected Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related field preferred.
8+ years of product management experience; healthcare or health technology experience preferred.
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and how they apply to product delivery, including familiarity with model lifecycle concepts (training, validation, deployment, monitoring).
Understanding of responsible AI principles - bias, explainability, human oversight, and trust.
Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality considerations, and experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing of model-driven features).
Experience bringing AI-driven or data-intensive products to market and supporting adoption post-launch.
Technical understanding of mobile, SaaS, messaging infrastructure, and APIs sufficient to assess feasibility and timelines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI/technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable gathering requirements from globally distributed teams and coordinating delivery across geographies.

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal-opportunity

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Product Manager III

Team Description

Travel is unpredictable — flights cancel, bags go missing, plans change. Our Insurtech team builds the protection layer that turns those moments from trip-enders into non-events, across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. We sit at the intersection of a two-sided marketplace, a regulated financial product, and one of the richest traveler datasets in the world which means the surface area for smart product work is enormous: embedded attach experiences, servicing delighters and AI-driven personalization of what "protection" even means for each traveler.

In this role, you will own product strategy and roadmap for a core Insurtech area (e.g., embedded protection attach), driving it from ambiguous problem to shippable requirements in partnership with engineering, design, data science, and legal/compliance. Run the roadmap on data and experimentation—prioritizing by attach-rate lift, designing compliant A/Bs, and balancing conversion, unit economics, and traveler trust—while building reusable platform capabilities and applying AI/ML (recommendations, pricing signals, agent-assist) safely within a regulated environment.

In This Role, You Will

Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for a core area of the Insurtech portfolio e.g., embedded attach in the post-booking protection upsell aligning to EG's attach, revenue, and traveler NPS goals across brands and points of sale.
Translate ambiguous problems into crisp requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and drive them to delivery with engineering, design, data science, legal/compliance, and our partners.
Use data and experimentation to run the roadmap, not just report on it: prioritize backlog by expected lift on attach rate, design A/Bs and holdouts that respect regulatory constraints; make explicit trade-offs between conversion, unit economics, and traveler trust.
Deliver outcomes end-to-end — from discovery and carrier/product structuring, through launch across brands and regulated markets, to scaled adoption and continuous optimization with a bias toward operational excellence
Drive platform thinking across Insurtech and adjacent teams (checkout, trip management, customer service,) so that protection capabilities are reusable across products, brands, B2C, and B2B surfaces rather than rebuilt each time.
Apply AI/ML pragmatically to real Insurtech problems: personalized coverage recommendations, dynamic pricing signals, agent-assist for support. Safely integrate these into a regulated product, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop where required, and clear success metrics.

Minimum Qualifications

4+ years of Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in a technical, analytical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience in product delivery within technology organizations.
Professional experience as a Product Manager, including ownership of a product, feature set, or service from discovery through launch and iteration, working with engineering and design in an agile environment.
Proven ability to define product requirements, write clear user stories or PRDs, interpret data and metrics, and use experimentation or A/B testing to inform roadmap decisions for consumer facing products.
Demonstrated experience collaborating with engineering on system behavior, API-level requirements, data flows, and dependencies to ensure robust, scalable, and reliable product solutions.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products in partnership with engineering, data science, or analytics teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption, including defining success metrics, validating problem-solution fit, and managing iterative releases at scale — ideally in personalization, conversion optimization, or checkout/funnel domains.
Experience leading product strategy in complex technical environments, including partnering with engineering on system design, integration patterns, and operational readiness.
Track record of driving measurable impact using data, experimentation, and customer insights; comfortable working with analytics, experimentation platforms, and instrumentation requirements — particularly in high-traffic, high-stakes conversion funnels.
Experience influencing cross-functional and cross-organizational stakeholders, resolving conflicting priorities, and driving alignment on roadmaps and trade-offs across multiple teams or domains.
Experience leveraging AI productivity tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI) and low-code agent platforms (Alloy, n8n) to accelerate product development and automate workflows is preferred.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

Location - BLR/GGN

About the Role
Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.
As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.

What You Will Do
Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.
Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.
Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.
Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.
Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.

What You Bring
4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.
Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.
Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.

Why This Role
Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

Digital Product Manager (AI) The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.

This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.

What You’ll Do

Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale. 
Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans. 
Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness. 
Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution. 
Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path. 
Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level. 
Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement. 
Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop. 
Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery. 
Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders. 

Basic Qualifications

8-13 years of work experience in the related field
Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or 
Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or 
Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or 
High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience. 
2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions. 
Working knowledge of AI product development, including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. 
Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation. 
Design thinking experience 
Ability to evaluate AI opportunities across desirability, feasibility, viability, value, risk, scalability, and data readiness. 
Experience with AI platforms, MLOps, or enterprise AI architecture. 
Familiarity with AI (e.g., LLMs, agents, NLP) and ML productization at scale. 
Strong presentation and public speaking skills with experience communicating to executives 
Familiarity with biotech workflows (e.g., lab automation, computational biology, clinical data, etc). 
Hands-on ability to analyze product usage, model output quality, or design A/B experiments. 
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments where priorities evolve quickly. 
Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across functions and levels.

As a Product Manager in the Product Operating Model (POM), your focus is on defining, prioritizing, and delivering products or capabilities that solve customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. You are accountable for the success of your product, partnering closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. You balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility to ensure your product creates real value.

In This Role You Will Get To

1. Product Discovery & Strategy

Understand the flight order lifecycle through research, data analysis, and feedback loops
Define the product vision, goals, and outcomes in alignment with the group and portfolio strategy to reduce risk to flights P&L. 
Research, troubleshoot, diagnose, and recommend solutions to complex business and technical problems.
Translate data insights and market trends into product opportunities
Outcome Ownership
Define, track, and deliver against product outcomes, lagging and leading indicators. Focussed on outcomes over output. 
Balance short-term risks, long-term opportunities , technical debt, and enabler work in your product backlog
Continuously evaluate whether product initiatives are driving intended value
Stakeholder Alignment & Communication
Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, including Commercial Teams, Finance, Technology, Accounting, and Financial Planning & Analysis to bring products to market.
Partner with business sponsors, portfolio managers, and cross-functional teams to align on outcomes
Partner with Data teams to identify insights that drive faster decision making. Act as the voice of the flights business and advocate for value delivery in decision-making.
Planning & Execution
Lead quarterly and sprint planning for your product team with an outcomes focused approach. 
Ensure dependencies are identified, managed, and communicated
Participate in demos, standups, and retrospectives to support delivery progress
Roll up your sleeves. We are a lean team and there is no job either big or too small. Some days you will be planning for the next quarter, and other days you will be diving into database records or inspecting API responses to help the development team troubleshoot an issue. We are very hands-on.

Who You Are

Requires a Bachelor's degree; an MBA is preferred.
4-6 years of experience taking full ownership of product success by defining visions and managing priorities to drive business and customer value.
A strategic thinker capable of connecting business opportunities with technical execution across engineering and design teams.
Strong quantitative skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making; knowledge of SQL, Tableau, and BigQuery is advantageous.
Active practitioner of the Product Operating Model, skilled at making trade-offs and empowering teams to deliver consistent value.
An effective communicator who builds alignment across teams and stakeholders fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity within the Flights team and throughout the organization
Experienced at translating complex problems into clear product requirements and roadmaps with a strong understanding of technical architecture,
Highly organized, self-directed, and focused on outcomes over output
Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

About Thermo Fisher Scientific:

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of $40 billion and 100,000 employees in 50 countries. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics and increase laboratory efficiency. Our four premier brands - Life Technologies, Thermo Scientific, Fisher Scientific and Instrument and Enterprise Services - offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and comprehensive support.

The Job:

The Antibodies Solutions segment serves customers using a wide array of immunodetection methods globally. Customers operate in biotech, academia, and pharmaceutical research labs and use our technologies for mechanism of action studies, pathway analysis, and analyte identification.

Position Summary:

Our primary location for this business is Bangalore, India.

As a Product Manager in AFS you ‘own’ the product. You are responsible for the product line strategy, ensuring balanced and profitable growth. You will understand customers, the competitive landscape and analyze and provide actionable insights – then be able to implement and deliver this working with colleagues across a matrixed organization.

The position requires significant thought leadership, strategic marketing skills, and the ability to influence across a wide variety of functions / roles. The individual in this position should be viewed as a skilled operation professional with solid understanding of the market, customer, competition, and service offerings.

Customer Centric:

Be an authority on our customers. Proactively listen, understand, and develop actionable insights into how we can develop products that contribute to customers success
Articulate these insights in a concise and compelling way so that internal collaborators ‘get’ the customer and their desired outcomes and translate these into growth initiatives
Define market requirements and synthesize customer input by conducting VOC and market research to understand key market trends, use cases, customer requirements, etc.

Product roadmap:

Own the product roadmap, illustrate a vision and prioritize requirements for sustaining connections and establishing new strategic partnerships
Lead the innovation process the assigned share of the antibody business, assess opportunities & validate concepts for new product offerings
Review our current product offerings, how well the product is performing in the market, understand how it impacts the company’s operations and how it ultimately contributes to profit
Independently establishes and leads critical initiatives that drive commercial success and support the overall business strategy

Execution:

Define the strategies and provide direction for the programs that will generate awareness and fill gaps in the primary antibody portfolio.
Serve as a product level administrator in implementing comprehensive business priorities for the portfolio in collaboration with marketing
Be responsible for the execution of initiatives to drive profitability
Own the pricing model, ensure that we are extracting the maximum value, considering different regional and competitive insights
Support global product marketing readiness initiatives as required

Collaboration:

Interacts with varying levels of internal and external collaborators including direct client communication and presentation to leadership
Assist supply planning, procurement, technical support, program management, and commercial teams with a range of business operation asks
Maintain a positive and collaborative professional relationship with stakeholders, peers and team members
Exhibits excellent presentation, communication, and writing skills, able to inspire through persuasive presentation of information
Work closely with applications team to develop use scenarios and technical specifications for new web functionality

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

Customer focused, with strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, able to talk to the market and present informative analysis
Demonstrate Product Management fundamentals, 4Ps, segmentation and positioning, value propositions, persona development, claims matrix mapping, etc
Financial acuity (forecasting, market share, top and bottom line)

Who we are looking for:

Master’s, PhD level or Business education is advantageous.
Experience within Product Management and/or Product Marketing
Product line/market knowledge of immunodetection is beneficial
Willingness to travel up to 10%, both domestically and internationally, as required
Proficient in English

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

The Digital Services AI Product team is building the foundation for the next generation of help experiences on eBay. We are focused on making support personalized, effortless, fast, and trusted, providing seamless help where and when customers need it.

With hundreds of millions of listings and a global community of buyers and sellers, eBay’s scale creates a unique opportunity to transform how people find help, resolve issues, and navigate an increasingly complex global commerce and regulatory environment. We are developing an ecosystem of AI Agents and composable AI platforms that enable adaptive, scalable help experiences across every customer touchpoint.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will define and lead the strategy for how we design, build, and scale AI-powered help experiences, including capabilities that help eBay address product regulatory compliance requirements and policies at scale. You will work closely with design, engineering, data science, operations, policy, legal, and compliance teams to turn emerging AI capabilities, customer needs, and regulatory requirements into simple, trusted, and impactful products for customers and the business.

What You Will Accomplish

Define the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for AI Agents, composable AI platforms, and capabilities supporting product regulatory compliance and trusted commerce experiences.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and data to improve how regulatory requirements and product policies are understood, operationalized, and surfaced across customer experiences.
Translate customer, business, policy, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product direction and requirements.
Partner with Legal, Policy, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Engineering, Design, and Data Science to build scalable solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory obligations, and business objectives.
Use data and experimentation to guide decisions, measure impact, identify emerging risks, and drive continuous improvement.
Bring customer insights, regulatory developments, data, and industry trends together to inform product strategy and improve the product experience.
Develop scalable capabilities that can adapt to evolving product regulations, marketplace policies, and requirements across markets and jurisdictions.
Partner closely with design, engineering, and data science to deliver reliable, explainable, and high-quality AI-powered products at scale.
Build alignment and strong partnerships across teams to stay focused on shared goals and drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Keep customer trust, safety, and ease of use at the center of product decisions while enabling eBay to meet its regulatory and policy commitments.


What You Will Bring

6+ years of product management experience, ideally including experience with AI/ML, data-driven products, trust, risk, compliance, policy, or marketplace platforms.
Experience applying AI and automation to improve customer experiences and solve complex customer or business problems, such as conversational AI, decisioning, classification, policy interpretation, or workflow automation.
Experience working on product regulatory compliance, trust, risk, policy, or other regulated product domains is highly valued.
Ability to translate complex regulatory, policy, operational, and technical requirements into scalable product capabilities and intuitive customer experiences.
Skilled at using data and insights to uncover opportunities, drive prioritization, assess risk, and measure success.
Technical fluency and foresight to collaborate effectively with engineers, data scientists, and AI/ML teams.
Strong judgment when working with AI-powered products where accuracy, explainability, customer trust, and regulatory compliance are important.
High ownership mindset with a bias for action and focus on creating customer and business impact.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical teams, including Legal, Compliance, Policy, and Operations.
Experience building 0→1 products and navigating ambiguity, evolving requirements, and complex stakeholder environments with confidence.
Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, customer support, self-service, trust, risk, or regulatory technology is a plus but not required.


Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

About Global HealthX

Global HealthX is on a mission to reshape how people experience healthcare. We build products that
touch real patients and providers, in a market that is early, enormous, and moving fast. We are past the"will this work" stage and squarely in the "how big can this get" stage which means whoever joins
now gets to shape the product, the roadmap, and the culture while the story is still being written.

About Healix Engage

Healix Engage is our patient and provider engagement platform — the layer that turns healthcare
interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a
roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only
dream about: core problems still to be solved, and the freedom to solve them well.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own Healix Engage end to end. This is not a backloggrooming, ticket-shuffling role. You will set direction, make the hard calls on what gets built and what does not, and be accountable for outcomes not just output. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and leadership, with unusual latitude to run experiments, kill bad ideas quickly, and double down on what is working.
If you have been the PM who quietly does the strategic thinking while someone senior takes the
meeting this is your chance to take the meeting.

What You'll Do

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Healix Engage, and translate it into a sequence of releases that compound.
Talk to users constantly patients, providers, internal teams and turn what you hear into sharp product decisions.
Define the problems worth solving, write crisp specs, and partner with engineering and design to ship fast without shipping sloppy.
Use data to decide. Set the metrics that matter, instrument them, and let the numbers not opinions settle debates.
Prioritize ruthlessly against limited time and resources the hallmark of a great PM at a growing company.
Be the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone aligned on the "why" and the "what's next."

What We're Looking For

Roughly 3–5 years in product management, ideally including time taking a product from early to scaling (0→1 or 1→10 experience is a big plus).
A track record of shipping products that moved real metrics you can point to specific outcomes you are proud of.
Strong product intuition paired with genuine comfort in data; you can zoom from strategy to a Figma detail to a SQL query and back.
Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and course-correct quickly.
Clear, persuasive communication you can align a room and write a spec that does not need a translator.
A builder's temperament: high ownership, low ego, and a bias for action. You would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.

Bonus: experience in healthcare, health-tech, or another regulated, high-trust domain.

About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Product Strategy & Vision

In this role, your work will involve: 

Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap based on market trends, customer needs, and company goals.
Work closely with senior management and stakeholders to align the product strategy with business objectives.

Market & User Research

Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities, gaps, and market demands.
Understand customer needs and translate them into product requirements.
Define user personas and use cases to ensure products meet user expectations.

Product Development

Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to deliver products that are functional, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.
Prioritize product features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer feedback, technical feasibility, and business impact.
Manage the product development lifecycle, including setting timelines and milestones.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, customer support) to ensure successful product launches.
Communicate progress, roadblocks, and product updates with stakeholders and teams across the organization.
Lead and facilitate communication between technical and non-technical teams.

Performance Tracking & Iteration

Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success.
Track product performance post-launch and gather customer feedback for continuous improvement.
Iterate on product features based on data insights and feedback.

Stakeholder Management

Present product updates, roadmaps, and strategies to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Manage relationships with external vendors and partners as needed.

Go-to-Market Strategy

Collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to define go-to-market strategies for product launches.
Ensure proper communication and training for internal teams and customers during product releases.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in the tech or software industry.
Strong understanding of product development processes, including agile methodologies.
Ability to work with cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
Strong organizational and project management skills.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Asana, or other project management platforms.
Knowledge of user experience (UX) design principles.
Experience working with APIs and technical teams.
Data-driven mindset with experience in A/B testing and user research methodologies.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management

General Summary

Directs a comprehensive product strategy from product conception and definition through end of life. Functions as a central resource with design, process, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing, and distribution as the product(s) and/or product line(s) move through their lifecycle. Formulates and executes long-term roadmaps for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends. Directs those involved in the design, modification, and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance of the product or product line.

Experience : 14+ Years

The Responsibilities Of This Role Include

Working independently with little supervision.
Making decisions that are moderate in impact; errors may have financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.
Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. May require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.
Having a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to provide input on key decisions).
Completing tasks that do not have defined steps; simultaneous use of multiple mental abilities is generally required to determine the best approach; mistakes may result in significant rework.
Exercising substantial creativity to innovate new processes, procedures, or work products within guidelines or to achieve established objectives.
Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or conflicting; advanced data analysis and interpretation skills are required.
Occasionally participates in strategic planning within own area affecting immediate operations.


The Responsibilities Of This Role Do Not Include

Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).


Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Conducts complex analyses to assess marketability of products based on market, customer, technology, and other ecosystem demands.
Creates a business case for the development of a new product or product features in an established product area (i.e., time to market, cost, market share).
Markets new and complex products and technologies through technical marketing opportunities such as conferences, congresses, and direct customer contact and drives product launch efforts.
Prepares and delivers highly complex technical presentations for new and existing products that explain and demonstrate products managed to customers.
Contributes to the creation of a differentiated product roadmap in an established product area, promotes it within team, and ensures all team members understand the product roadmap.
Directs the development of complex products and services with minimal supervision and communicates with individuals across functional teams.
Completes product development and definition activities for a moderately complex, owned product, including determination of cost and impact, and interacts with sales team to generate forecasts.
Maintains expertise by staying up to date on competitors, technological advances, and the product ecosystem and takes the lead on development and design innovation of products in an established area to articulate differentiation of products to customers and identify trends.
Communicates regularly within own team and cross-functional team(s) to ensure team-level understanding of product plans for a product line.
Ensures successful cross-functional collaboration by ensuring that agreed upon KPIs and specifications are met for product(s), upon delivery by engineering team.
Collaborates with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop product goals (e.g., performance, cost, timeline, customer schedules), discuss product feasibility, and facilitate cross-functional decision making for products they own.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related technical field.
4+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business, or a related field.
Experience in software product management, platform strategy, product planning, or a related technical discipline.
Some experience with Android, AOSP, mobile software platforms, system software, or related ecosystem technologies.
Experience defining and executing complex software products and technology roadmaps.
Experience coordinating across multiple technology domains, product management teams, and engineering organizations.
Understanding of mobile platform architecture, Android ecosystem requirements, software development lifecycle, and customer integration considerations.
Experience working with Google, OEMs, carriers, developers, or other technology ecosystem partners.
Ability to translate customer and market needs into product strategy, requirements, and execution priorities.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, problem-solving, negotiation, and communication skills.
Ability to influence decisions and drive results across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
Experience balancing technical feasibility, customer value, business priorities, schedule, quality, and risk.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

About Sibros Technologies

Who We Are

Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.

Learn more at www.sibros.tech.

Our Mission

Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.

Follow us on

LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram

About The Role

Job Title: Product Manager - Core Platform & Infrastructure

Reporting to: Group Product Manager

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5+ years

As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog - you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. You will own the core platforms that orchestrate flawless over-the-air (OTA) updates, secure remote diagnostics, and resilient vehicle-to-cloud data ingestion, transforming complex technical constraints into a highly reliable, scalable enterprise platform.

What you’ll do

Own the Core Vehicle-to-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. You will ensure this core platform acts as a rock-solid, extensible foundation that reliably powers all downstream applications built on top of it, such as advanced troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and fleet management tools.
Optimize Value Delivery: Ruthlessly prioritize the platform backlog. You’ll make the hard trade-off decisions between technical debt, architectural scalability, security compliance, and OEM feature requests to maximize platform ROI.
Define System Boundaries and APIs: Partner closely with Embedded, Cloud, and Security Engineering to define robust APIs, data contracts, and platform abstractions that allow Sibros to integrate seamlessly into diverse OEM vehicle architectures.
Drive Platform Reliability & Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
Autonomous Decision-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day-to-day tactical guidance.
Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.

What you should know

Required Qualifications

Professional Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience in high-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
Automotive & Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).
Systems Thinking & Scale: Experience managing backend or platform products that bridge embedded edge environments and distributed cloud infrastructure. You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self-directed leader with a history of making high-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast-paced environment.
Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Automotive Cybersecurity & Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434).

Description

The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.

If you’re passionate about building enterprise-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.

Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights - through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.

With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.

Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.

You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best-of-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.

Odessa is seeking a senior product leader to own the end-to-end user experience strategy across the platform. This role will turn product experience into a company-level advantage by combining product management, experience design, customer discovery, analytics, performance, and platform thinking. The leader will move the organization beyond isolated visual improvements toward simpler business workflows, stronger design ownership, and measurable improvements in adoption, usability, and customer confidence.


Primary role

The AVP, Product Management, User Experience will define and communicate a multi-year product experience vision, principles, and roadmap. The role will establish clear ownership for product experience, prioritize high-usage and high-friction journeys, and align Product, Digital Experience, Framework, Engineering, Automation and AI around shared priorities. This leader will translate customer and market insights into executable product decisions and ensure user-facing capabilities are designed for simplicity, responsiveness, quality, and scale.

What you’ll do

Set the UX product strategy: Own a multi-year product experience vision and roadmap that connects market needs, measurable customer outcomes, platform constraints and Odessa’s broader product strategy.
Own high-impact journeys: Prioritize the most-used and highest-friction workflows using customer feedback, telemetry, product analytics, usability evidence, and commercial impact.
Simplify the experience: Reduce unnecessary screens, clicks and context switches; promote task-oriented journeys, progressive disclosure and role-relevant experiences that hide avoidable complexity.
Integrate UI, UX, performance and business experience: Treat visual design, workflow design, terminology, responsiveness, and process fit as one product experience, with common outcomes and measures.
Lead discovery and product definition: Engage customers, prospects, domain experts, and internal stakeholders to frame problems, define target outcomes, shape requirements and make clear portfolio and sequencing trade-offs.
Drive roadmap execution: Convert strategy into sequenced initiatives, business cases, product requirements and release plans; partner with Framework, Engineering and Architecture to balance near-term improvements with foundational platform evolution.
Strengthen design ownership: Build a high-performing product and design capability that creates high-fidelity concepts while owning product and domain understanding, product decisions, stakeholder influence and longer-term UX direction.
Institutionalize customer-centered practices: Establish journey mapping, prototyping, usability validation, benchmarking, and experience-quality reviews across the product lifecycle.
Make prioritization evidence-based: Define telemetry and product analytics for priority workflows, establish adoption and friction measures, and use evidence to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
Champion quality by design: Introduce early UX and design-system quality reviews, so experience defects are identified before customer releases, and user-facing quality improves.
Influence across the organization: Create shared goals across Product, Digital Experience, Framework, Engineering, QA, Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success; resolve cross-functional trade-offs and communicate decisions clearly.
Represent the product experience: Bring a strong product narrative to executive reviews, strategic customer discussions, product demonstrations, and go-to-market planning.

Proven ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, and multi-release roadmaps for complex enterprise products or platforms.
Strong understanding of user experience strategy, interaction and journey design, design systems, usability research, and product analytics.
Ability to connect customer problems, business outcomes, market context, and technical constraints to make clear product decisions.
Experience leading cross-functional work across Product, Design, Engineering, Architecture, QA, Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success.
Demonstrated success building and leading senior product and design talent and strengthening product and domain capability.
Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with people who bring different viewpoints.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in financial services, asset finance, leasing, or lending.

Position Overview

The Senior Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.

This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery

Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

Roadmap & Release Ownership

Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

Hands-On Delivery

Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking

Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

Team Development

In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

Module-specific Experience (by Role)

Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:

Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.
Compensation & Advanced Compensation: Salary structures, merit and bonus plans, compensation cycles, equity, allowances, and global pay practices.
Recruiting, Paradox & HiredScore: Recruiting business processes, offer management, candidate experience, AI screening tools, and sourcing integrations.
Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
US Benefits & US Payroll: Open enrollment, benefit plans, ACA compliance, payroll processing, tax configuration, and off-cycle runs.
People Analytics & Peakon: Workday Prism Analytics, dashboards, engagement survey design, action planning, and People Analytics storytelling.

Preferred Qualifications

Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

About Revantage

Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

Manage cross‑team dependencies
