jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Position Overview

The Experienced Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the Total Rewards: Compensation & Advance Compensation Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery

Own your assigned Workday module(s): Compensation & Advance Compensation end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

Roadmap & Release Ownership

Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

Hands-On Delivery

Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy. 
Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
Own day-to-day delivery.

Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking

Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

Module-specific Experience (by Role): Compensation & Advanced Compensation

Salary structures, merit and bonus planning, compensation cycles, and global pay practices — configuration and operational support.

Compensation Structures: Grade profiles, salary ranges, pay bands, compensation plans (salary, hourly, allowance), and eligibility rules.
Merit & Bonus Planning: Merit matrices, bonus plan configuration, target amounts, proration rules, and manager worksheet setup.
Compensation Cycles: Annual and off-cycle review configuration, approval routing, budget pools, and cycle administration.
Advanced Compensation: Long-term incentive plans, equity award management, one-time payments, and complex plan eligibility.
Global Pay Practices: Multi-currency compensation, country-specific allowances, cost-of-living adjustments, and grade localization.
Integrations & Reporting: Payroll input mapping, compensation statement generation, comp data audits, and Prism-ready pay analytics 

Preferred Qualifications

Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

About Revantage

Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

Director, Product Management – Core Data and Decision Intelligence

Target in India | L7

About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Target is investing in the next generation of intelligent store experiences that connect operational, digital and physical environments to create smarter outcomes for guests, team members and the business.

Our Core Intelligence Product teams are building the foundational capabilities that enable Target’s stores to understand what is happening, anticipate what matters, recommend the right actions, and continuously learn from outcomes.

About the Job – Director, Product Management, Core Data and Decision Intelligence

As Director of Product Management for Core Intelligence, you will help define and build the intelligence foundation powering the future of Target’s store operations and experiences.

You will lead a portfolio of highly technical products that bring together signals from operational systems, store environments and enterprise platforms; transform those signals into trusted context; and use data science, AI and intelligent systems to generate actionable recommendations at scale.

Your work will enable Target to move beyond static rules and fragmented signals toward context-aware, continuously learning intelligence that can power multiple Store products, workflows and experiences.

Based in Target in India, you will lead Product Managers and partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams to identify high-value problems, develop reusable intelligence capabilities and translate technology investments into measurable outcomes for Target’s stores.

Intelligence Product Vision & Strategy

Define and execute the product vision and strategy for a portfolio of foundational Core Intelligence capabilities. 
Shape how operational and physical signals are transformed into trusted context, insights and recommendations that power Store experiences. 
Build scalable, reusable intelligence capabilities that can serve multiple products, workflows and operational domains. 
Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML, predictive intelligence, recommendation systems, simulation and emerging technologies to solve complex Store problems. 
Translate enterprise and Stores priorities into clear product strategies, investment choices, roadmaps and measurable outcomes. 
Balance near-term business value with development of durable intelligence capabilities that can scale across Target. 

Product Discovery & Intelligence Capability Development

Develop a deep understanding of Target’s store operating environment and identify opportunities where intelligence can meaningfully improve decisions and experiences. 
Establish strong discovery mechanisms across Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations to move from problems to hypotheses, experiments and scalable solutions. 
Drive rapid experimentation, simulation and learning to validate opportunities before scaling investments. 
Build feedback loops that allow intelligence capabilities to learn from outcomes and improve over time. 
Ensure intelligence products are designed for trust, explainability, interoperability, scalability and long-term extensibility. 

Product & Organizational Leadership

Lead and develop Product Managers across a portfolio of highly technical intelligence products. 
Create clear product ownership, accountability, success metrics and decision rights across the portfolio. 
Build a strong Product organization in Target in India with deep technical, strategic and business acumen. 
Coach Product Managers to lead through customer problems, discovery, evidence and outcomes rather than requirements and delivery. 
Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, ownership and continuous learning. 
Establish product operating mechanisms that enable empowered teams while maintaining alignment across a complex ecosystem. 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX, Store Operations and experience Product teams. 
Influence senior leaders and partners across geographies without relying on direct authority. 
Translate complex technical and intelligence concepts into clear product and business narratives. 
Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to create alignment around strategic investments. 
Help establish clear boundaries and interfaces between reusable Core Intelligence capabilities and the experiences they power. 

About You

4-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree in technology, engineering, data science, business or a related field is a plus. 
8+ years of Product Management experience, preferably across highly technical, data-intensive, AI/ML, platform or enterprise products. 
Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and leading complex product portfolios. 
Experience leading and developing Product Managers. 
Strong understanding of data-driven products, AI/ML concepts, recommendation systems, intelligent platforms or related technology domains. 
Proven ability to translate complex technology into customer and business outcomes. 
Strong systems thinking and ability to connect multiple capabilities into a coherent product strategy. 
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influence skills. 
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and solving problems where neither the solution nor the path is obvious. 
Experience working across global Product and Engineering organizations is strongly preferred.

About Agrim

Agrim is a fast-growing B2B agri-inputs e-commerce platform serving retailers across India. We are building technology-led solutions to transform a large and fragmented agri-inputs ecosystem across Seeds, Agro Chemicals, Fertilizers, Agro-Tools and Animal Feed.

The Role

We are looking for an Associate Program Manager – Business & Analytics who thrives on solving complex, ambiguous business problems.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of Business, Product, Data and Technology. You will identify problems, break them down from first principles, design solutions, work with cross-functional teams and drive initiatives through execution to measurable business impact.

What You’ll Do

Identify and solve high-impact business problems across Growth, Operations, Supply Chain, Product and Customer Experience.
Own initiatives end-to-end — problem definition, solution design, execution and impact measurement.
Use data, analytics and experimentation to identify opportunities and make decisions.
Work closely with Business, Product, Technology and Data teams to build and implement solutions.
Design experiments, test hypotheses and continuously improve processes and outcomes.
Build scalable solutions using technology, data and automation wherever relevant.
Ensure solutions are implemented, adopted and translated into measurable business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

1.5-3 years of experience in Program Management, Consulting, Product, Analytics, Business Operations or similar roles.
Working knowledge of SQL / Python.
Strong problem-solving and structured thinking with a first-principles approach.

The Director of Available to Promise (ATP) will lead two strategic product portfolios: Availability and the Guest Fulfillment Optimization Engine (GFOE).

Availability

The Availability portfolio delivers accurate and reliable availability and fulfillment information to Target’s digital guests. The portfolio enables capabilities that maximize digitally purchasable assortment, encourage store visits, improve the guest experience, and reduce fulfillment costs - while meeting the performance, reliability, and scalability demands of Target’s digital platform.

The role will lead a team of product managers to develop product plans to deliver features in service of optimizing digital purchasability, improving digital profitability, ship expense reduction, and delivery date accuracy. Job Description

About The Role:

We are seeking an Agentic Product Lead to join us initially on a contract basis, with a clear pathway to a full-time position. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), you will operate cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market (GTM), and Channel Partnerships.

Rather than incrementally improving existing features, your mission is to drive market-disrupting innovation by answering one core question: Which tasks that our customers currently perform manually—or pay third-party software to handle—can be executed by an AI agent?

Working directly in the field, you will engage with ELMO customers and channel partners to map tech stacks, evaluate operational friction points, analyse the HR landscape, and identify adjacent point solutions across our HCM, Rostering, Time & Attendance, and Payroll platforms.

This is a broad, high-impact role focused exclusively on AI Agents. You will translate direct market insights into decision-grade Product Requirement Documents (PRDs); defining agent scope, human-in-the-loop oversight checkpoints, and evaluation harness while building stress-tested pricing models alongside RevOps to secure executive sign-off.

As engineering squads build via our AI-SDLC, you will orchestrate cross-functional delivery, eliminate execution roadblocks, safeguard product vision from PRD to launch, and track post-launch displacement and adoption metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Field Research & Discovery: Conduct ongoing customer research and maintain a consistent feedback cadence with key channel partners to map customer tech stacks, identify pain points, and uncover displacement opportunities.
Displacement Opportunity Pipeline: Identify, size, and sequence agentic AI opportunities that can replace adjacent vendor software, point solutions, and manual workflows.
Solution Definition & PRDs: Partner with Product teams to author comprehensive PRDs that outline agent scope, autonomy levels, human-in-the-loop oversight checkpoints, evaluation approaches, and technical platform dependencies.
Commercial Modelling: Collaborate with RevOps and Growth teams to stress-test pricing and commercial models (per-seat, outcome-based, or hybrid) prior to executive review.
Delivery Orchestration: Work alongside Product and Engineering teams to track, facilitate, and unblock project delivery.
GTM & Partner Enablement: Partner with Sales Enablement, Product Marketing, and Channel Partners to launch AI agents with compelling value propositions and clear software displacement narratives.

What We Are Looking For

Agentic AI & LLM Expertise: Practical understanding of agent capabilities, orchestration, tool-calling, guardrails, failure modes, and running evaluation harnesses (evals).
Strategic Mindset: Ability to map a customer's entire software ecosystem, identify third-party vendor vulnerabilities, and quantify potential software spend to displace.
Mixed-Methods Research Mastery: Demonstrated success in customer discovery, contextual inquiry, design thinking, and data synthesis.
Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience building pricing models, unit economics, and business cases that withstand executive scrutiny.
Trust & Oversight Design: Deep awareness of human-agent interaction models, autonomy tiers, auditability, and safety mechanisms.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to align, unblock, and drive execution across teams without direct line management authority.

Key Success Indicators

Establishing a regular cadence of customer interviews and active channel partner feedback loops.
Delivering proposed AI agents backed by fully validated PRDs and stress-tested commercial models.
Successfully transitioning approved AI agents into active build cycles supported by clear, actionable delivery roadmaps.

Job Description:
As a Senior Product Manager of Managed Security Testing at VikingCloud, you will be responsible for the strategic planning, development, and execution of our offensive security testing services, including penetration testing as a service (PTaaS), vulnerability assessments, phishing simulations, social engineering testing, and specialized security assessments. You will own the product roadmap for VikingCloud's managed security testing portfolio, working closely with our internal security testing teams, third-party testing partners, and customers to deliver high-quality offensive security services that help merchants and financial institutions identify and remediate security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them. This role requires deep understanding of offensive security methodologies, industry certifications and frameworks (CREST, PTES, OWASP, PCI DSS ASV), and the ability to bridge technical security testing with compliance requirements. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including security consultants, engineering, sales, and customer success to build scalable, automated testing platforms while maintaining the rigor and quality expected from professional security assessments. Your work will directly support customers' compliance programs (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) while providing actionable security insights that reduce risk.

Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy for VikingCloud's managed security testing services, including penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, web application testing, mobile app testing, API testing, phishing simulations, social engineering assessments, and automated testing. Define the product vision that balances automation and scalability with the technical rigor required for professional security testing.
AI Security Testing (AISec): Develop testing methodologies and a comprehensive product strategy for Larege Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents, Chatbots, and other AI powered technologies. This includes an “AI Red Teaming” strategy and packages for testing the robustness of customer-facing AI applications.
PTaaS Platform Development: Lead the development of VikingCloud's Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS) platform, creating modern delivery mechanisms that provide continuous testing, real-time reporting, seamless remediation tracking, and collaborative workflows between testers and customers. Define platform requirements for test scoping, scheduling, execution tracking, finding management, retesting, and certification delivery.
Testing Methodology & Standards: Ensure all security testing services adhere to industry-recognized methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, NIST SP 800-115, and PCI DSS testing requirements. Maintain current knowledge of CREST accreditation requirements and ensure VikingCloud's services meet or exceed these standards. Define quality assurance processes for testing deliverables.
Certification & Compliance Alignment: Build security testing services that directly support customer compliance requirements including PCI DSS (ASV scanning, segmentation testing, penetration testing), SOC 2 Type II (security testing evidence), ISO 27001, NIST frameworks, and industry-specific regulations. Position testing services as essential compliance components that provide both security value and audit evidence.
Roadmap Planning & Prioritization: Create and maintain detailed product roadmaps for testing services and PTaaS platform capabilities. Prioritize features and service enhancements based on customer feedback, compliance requirements, competitive analysis, revenue potential, and operational efficiency gains. Balance automation initiatives with maintaining high-quality manual testing where required.
Phishing & Social Engineering Programs: Develop comprehensive phishing simulation and security awareness testing capabilities including campaign management, template libraries, user tracking, training integration, and reporting dashboards. Create social engineering testing services including vishing, smishing, physical security testing, and pretexting scenarios tailored to different industries and threat models.
Service Delivery & Scalability: Design service delivery models that enable VikingCloud to scale testing services efficiently while maintaining quality. Define when to use internal testers versus third-party partners, automation versus manual testing, and on-demand versus scheduled assessments. Create standardized testing packages for common use cases while allowing customization for complex environments.
Vulnerability Management Integration: Integrate security testing services with VikingCloud's existing vulnerability scanning and management capabilities. Create workflows that enable customers to move seamlessly from continuous scanning to targeted penetration testing to remediation verification. Build unified vulnerability management dashboards that combine scan results, pen test findings, and remediation status.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, or related technical field required; advanced degree (M.S. in Cybersecurity) or MBA is a plus.
10-14 years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or security consulting with at least 4-5 years in product management or service delivery leadership roles.
Hands-on penetration testing experience including web applications, APIs, mobile applications, network infrastructure, wireless networks, and cloud environments. Direct experience conducting security assessments, not just managing testing programs.
Deep understanding of offensive security methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, SANS Top 25, and MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS frameworks.
Strong knowledge of CREST certification pathways and accreditation requirements including CREST Registered Tester (CRT), CREST Certified Tester (CCT), CREST Practitioner Security Analyst (CPSA), and CREST infrastructure, application, and specialist certifications. Understanding of how CREST accreditation differentiates testing services in the market.
Professional security certifications strongly preferred including OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), GPEN (GIAC Penetration Tester), GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester), CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), or CREST certifications. Multiple certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise are highly valuable.
Experience with compliance-driven security testing including PCI DSS penetration testing requirements (Requirement 11.4), PCI DSS Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) program, SOC 2 security testing, ISO 27001 testing requirements, and other regulatory frameworks.

Experience with AI-augmented security testing, managing the security of AI/ML pipelines, prompt engineering for security testing, and use of AI agents in automated vulnerability discovery.

ABOUT DBMCI ONE

DBMCI One is a learning platform for medical students and doctors, a product of NHPL (Neuroglia Health Private Limited), a subsidiary of M3, Inc., Japan's largest healthcare company, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

NHPL is also the company behind Marrow, India's largest and most trusted learning platform for NEET PG preparation.

DBMCI One brings together the legacy of Dr. Bhatia's Medical Coaching Institute, trusted by generations of medical aspirants, with the product velocity and data discipline of a modern tech company. We are building the definitive learning platform for India's next generation of doctors: one that adapts to how each aspirant learns, making the journey from preparation to practice measurably better.

The stakes are real. The ambition is bigger.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the learner growth and engagement charter at DBMCI One. This is not a coordination role. It is a high-ownership position where you define what keeps a medical student coming back every day, what drives them from trial to deep engagement, and what ultimately makes them succeed.

You are joining at an inflection point. The habits and learning outcomes you shape today will determine how thousands of medical students learn, and in turn, how they diagnose, treat, and care for millions of patients tomorrow.

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

AI is not a tool you will be asked to explore here. It is the default. You are expected to prototype, automate, and iterate using AI natively from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Own the full growth loop: Activation Engagement Habit Formation Retention for DBMCI One learners across platforms.
  • Define and drive the product roadmap for learner-facing features, from discovery through experimentation, launch, and post-launch iteration.
  • Use AI-assisted prototyping and vibe-coding tools to independently build and test product ideas, reducing dependence on full engineering cycles for early validation.
  • Design and run GTM experiments: scope the hypothesis, build a lean version, get it in front of real users, gather feedback, and iterate fast before committing to a full build.
  • Design and run A/B experiments at pace. Test hypotheses, kill what does not work, and double down on what does.
  • Conduct structured user research: interviews, session analysis, and cohort studies to uncover the real reasons learners drop off or stay hooked.
  • Identify leading indicators of learner success and build features that move them, not vanity metrics.
  • Use agentic AI and automation workflows to accelerate research synthesis, user feedback analysis, and product iteration cycles.
  • Write crisp PRDs, define acceptance criteria, and partner with Engineering and Design through the full delivery cycle.
  • Own the metrics framework for your charter. Build dashboards, present to leadership, and stay fully accountable for outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Content and Academics teams to ensure product and pedagogy reinforce each other.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2 to 4 years of Product Management experience at a tech-first company. Consumer internet, EdTech, or mobile-first products are strongly preferred.
  • Strong product thinking grounded in user behaviour. You can articulate the "why behind the why" for any user action or drop-off.
  • Hands-on data fluency: SQL, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and A/B experiment design. You live in data, not just talk about it.

Title and Summary

Lead Product Manager - Technical - Data Lake/ Data Warehouse

Who is Mastercard
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview
The Data Collection and Engineering Program is looking for a Lead Product Manager Technical to drive data warehouse implementation in the UAE region and support other applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about the data, data warehouse, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.

Role
- Owns the working backwards document and vision for feature releases
- Develop system technical requirements with the aid of the technical team. Perform system reviews with users.

Ensure development and test teams have all the required information to accurately capture and transformed from source systems data to target systems
- Participate in and drive user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that the product meets the needs of users.

- Propose design changes and drive fixes with the development team as needed to improve its application performance.
- Act as a liaison between business users and development teams to address any grievances/issues after the deployment of the Data Applications.
- Use data analysis to understand user behaviour and make informed decisions about the product.


All About You:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify and solve problems using data analysis and other methods.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders, both technical and non-technical.
- Ability to work independently to complete tasks, as well as work collaboratively with others to achieve goals.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously, while meeting deadlines and ensuring quality.
- Knowledge of product management best practices.
- Knowledge of the principles and practices of product management.
- Experience with data analysis and data architecture, including the use of tools and techniques.
- Bachelors degree in a related field, such as business, computer science, or engineering.
- 8+ years of experience in Information Systems (Database/DWH/Big Data development) and latest 5+ yrs of product management.
- 5+ years of experience in Design or Development on Data Warehouse ETL Projects or Big Data Projects.
- Expert SQL skills.
- Experience in the Banking and Payment domain is a plus.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.
As a member of the Optum Insight Product (OI Product) division, you will play a key role in advancing administrative, financial, and clinical processes through software-enabled services, cloud platforms, and data science. Our team''s vision is to harness cloud technology, machine learning, and innovative analytics to simplify healthcare complexity and improve patient outcomes across the health system. In this role, you will support and manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for data science and cloud-focused products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define product strategy, maintain a robust product roadmap, and act as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical execution teams.

  • Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and business leaders to define product strategy and maintain a detailed, forward-looking product roadmap

The opportunity

The Customer Contact Experience, or CCX, Product Manager has end-to-end accountability for the business and technology success of EY s global cloud contact center service. The role develops and communicates the product vision and roadmap, translating business priorities into the technical roadmap while ensuring the service remains desirable, viable, functional, secure, reliable, compliant and cost-effective.

The Product Manager leads collaboration across business stakeholders, engineering, operations, architecture, security, privacy, procurement, finance, risk and external suppliers. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from requirements and investment decisions through delivery, adoption, service operation and continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities

  • Own and communicate the CCX business product vision, strategy and roadmap, ensuring that business priorities and desired value drive the technical product roadmap and service offerings.
  • Act as the voice of the customer and principal point of contact for business stakeholders, engineering, operations and other product teams.
  • Gather, validate and prioritize business requirements, feature requests, technical improvements and regulatory obligations.
  • Manage the product backlog and lead cross-functional delivery from concept through design, testing, release and operational readiness.
  • Oversee service performance, incidents, problems, capacity, business continuity, disaster recovery and continuous improvement.
  • Manage Genesys and other technology suppliers, including roadmap alignment, service reviews, escalations, contracts, licensing and commercial discussions.
  • Maintain oversight of product costs, forecasts, licensing consumption and investment requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with EY security, privacy, data retention, records management, supplier risk and Responsible AI requirements.
  • Coordinate required architecture, security, privacy and risk assessments for new capabilities and integrations.
  • Define and monitor product KPIs covering service performance, adoption, customer satisfaction, cost and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate product direction, releases and service changes to senior stakeholders and user communities.
  • Monitor contact center, cloud, automation, analytics and AI developments and evaluate relevant opportunities for EY.

Skills and attributes for success

  • Strong product management, roadmap development and prioritization capability.
  • Ability to lead a multi-disciplinary global team through the product lifecycle, create clarity across business and technical stakeholders, and drive a product mindset with limited supervision.
  • Strong customer focus with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder, supplier, communication, negotiation and decision-making skills.
  • Strong analytical, commercial and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to balance customer value, cost, operational stability, technical feasibility, risk and compliance.
  • Experience working across global teams, cultures and time zones.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • Significant experience in technology product management, service ownership or a comparable end-to-end technology role.
  • Strong knowledge of contact center and customer experience solutions, preferably in a global cloud environment.
  • Strong business analysis capability, including problem definition, stakeholder facilitation, solution evaluation, requirements specification and maintenance of functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Experience planning and delivering product activation, stakeholder communications, documentation and training to increase adoption, remove usage barriers and support organizational readiness.
  • Experience managing strategic technology suppliers or managed service providers.
  • Understanding of enterprise security, privacy, data protection and regulatory governance.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ideally, you will also have

  • Experience with Genesys Cloud CX.
  • Knowledge of IVR, routing, recording, workforce engagement, digital channels and contact center analytics.
  • Understanding of IP telephony, SIP, SBCs, WebRTC, PSTN connectivity and Microsoft Teams telephony.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, REST APIs, identity services and enterprise integrations.
  • Familiarity with Azure, AWS, Power BI, DevOps, scripting or automation.
  • Knowledge of GDPR, privacy impact assessments, data residency, retention and Responsible AI governance.
  • Experience with global service operations, business continuity and disaster recovery.

Measures of success

  • A clear, actively managed business product strategy and roadmap that demonstrates desired business value and drives an aligned technical product roadmap.
  • Reliable, secure and compliant service delivery.
  • Effective delivery and adoption of product improvements.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Effective supplier, financial and licensing management.
  • Measurable improvements in product performance, operational efficiency and customer experience.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Senior Product Manager Managed Security Testing

Location: Remote

Shift time: 01.30 PM - 10.30 PM IST

Report to: SVP


About VikingCloud:

VikingCloud is the leading Predict-to-Prevent cybersecurity and compliance company, offering businesses a single, integrated solution to make informed, predictive, and cost-effective risk mitigation decisions faster. Powered by the Asgard Platform, the industrys largest repository of anonymized cybersecurity and compliance event data, we continuously monitor and analyze over 6+ billion online events every day.

VikingCloud is the one-stop partner trusted by 4+ million customers to provide the predictive intelligence and competitive edge they need to stay one step ahead of cybersecurity and compliance disruptions to their business. Our 1,000 dedicated cybersecurity and compliance expert advisors understand that it’s not just about technology. It’s about transacting business and delivering an exceptional customer experience every day, without fail. That’s the measurable value we deliver. And that’s what we call, Business Uninterrupted.


Job Description:

As a Senior Product Manager of Managed Security Testing at VikingCloud, you will be responsible for the strategic planning, development, and execution of our offensive security testing services, including penetration testing as a service (PTaaS), vulnerability assessments, phishing simulations, social engineering testing, and specialized security assessments. You will own the product roadmap for VikingCloud's managed security testing portfolio, working closely with our internal security testing teams, third-party testing partners, and customers to deliver high-quality offensive security services that help merchants and financial institutions identify and remediate security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them.


This role requires deep understanding of offensive security methodologies, industry certifications and frameworks (CREST, PTES, OWASP, PCI DSS ASV), and the ability to bridge technical security testing with compliance requirements. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including security consultants, engineering, sales, and customer success to build scalable, automated testing platforms while maintaining the rigor and quality expected from professional security assessments. Your work will directly support customers' compliance programs (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001) while providing actionable security insights that reduce risk.


Responsibilities:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy for VikingCloud's managed security testing services, including penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, web application testing, mobile app testing, API testing, phishing simulations, social engineering assessments, and automated testing. Define the product vision that balances automation and scalability with the technical rigor required for professional security testing.
  • AI Security Testing (AISec): Develop testing methodologies and a comprehensive product strategy for Larege Language Models (LLMs) AI Agents, Chatbots, and other AI powered technologies. This includes an “AI Red Teaming” strategy and packages for testing the robustness of customer-facing AI applications.
  • PTaaS Platform Development: Lead the development of VikingCloud's Penetration Testing as a Service (PTaaS) platform, creating modern delivery mechanisms that provide continuous testing, real-time reporting, seamless remediation tracking, and collaborative workflows between testers and customers. Define platform requirements for test scoping, scheduling, execution tracking, finding management, retesting, and certification delivery.
  • Testing Methodology & Standards: Ensure all security testing services adhere to industry-recognized methodologies and frameworks including CREST standards, Penetration Testing Execution Standard (PTES), OWASP Testing Guide, NIST SP 800-115, and PCI DSS testing requirements. Maintain current knowledge of CREST accreditation requirements and ensure VikingCloud's services meet or exceed these standards. Define quality assurance processes for testing deliverables.
  • Certification & Compliance Alignment: Build security testing services that directly support customer compliance requirements including PCI DSS (ASV scanning, segmentation testing, penetration testing), SOC 2 Type II (security testing evidence), ISO 27001, NIST frameworks, and industry-specific regulations. Position testing services as essential compliance components that provide both security value and audit evidence.
  • Roadmap Planning & Prioritization: Create and maintain detailed product roadmaps for testing services and PTaaS platform capabilities. Prioritize features and service enhancements based on customer feedback, compliance requirements, competitive analysis, revenue potential, and operational efficiency gains. Balance automation initiatives with maintaining high-quality manual testing where required.
  • Phishing & Social Engineering Programs: Develop comprehensive phishing simulation and security awareness testing capabilities including campaign management, template libraries, user tracking, training integration, and reporting dashboards. Create social engineering testing services including vishing, smishing, physical security testing, and pretexting scenarios tailored to different industries and threat models.
  • Service Delivery & Scalability: Design service delivery models that enable VikingCloud to scale testing services efficiently while maintaining quality. Define when to use internal testers versus third-party partners, automation versus manual testing, and on-demand versus scheduled assessments. Create standardized testing packages for common use cases while allowing customization for complex environments.
  • Vulnerability Management Integration: Integrate security testing services with VikingCloud's existing vulnerability scanning and management capabilities. Create workflows that enable customers to move seamlessly from continuous scanning to targeted penetration testing to remediation verification. Build unified vulnerability management dashboards that combine scan results, pen test findings, and remediation status.
  • Customer Requirements & Research: Engage directly with customers to understand their security testing needs, compliance drivers, budget constraints, and desired outcomes. Conduct market research on offensive security trends, emerging attack techniques, and evolving compliance requirements. Translate customer insights into actionable product requirements and service offerings.
  • Testing Team Enablement: Work closely with VikingCloud's security testing professionals to understand their workflows, tooling needs, and pain points. Define platform capabilities that make testers more efficient and effective. Create standardized reporting templates, finding libraries, and testing playbooks that improve consistency and quality across the testing team.
  • Third-Party Tester Partnerships: Establish and manage relationships with third-party penetration testing firms and independent security researchers to augment VikingCloud's testing capacity. Define qualification criteria for external testers including required certifications (CREST, OSCP, GPEN), experience levels, and specializations. Job Summary

FourKites is looking for a sharp, curious and execution-focused Product Manager to join the Visibility team and own our Over-the-Road (OTR) portfolio: Truckload, LTL, Parcel and Last Mile. This is FourKites flagship product line. Some of the worlds largest shippers use it to track billions of dollars of freight every day.

This is not a PM role. You will own real product outcomes from day one. Youll work hands-on with data, build your own prototypes, talk directly with enterprise customers, and partner with engineering and design to ship features that improve adoption, retention and tracking quality.

The role sits where supply chain operations meet modern software product development, and youll need both. You need deep empathy for how freight actually moves across modes, and the analytical rigor to turn that into product bets worth making.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership Outcomes

  • Own product outcomes for one or more OTR modes (Truckload, LTL, Parcel or Last Mile), including tracking quality, ETA accuracy and carrier coverage.
  • Track and analyze adoption, engagement and retention KPIs for your area.
  • Find friction points and adoption gaps using usage data, customer interviews and feedback from Customer Success and Sales.
  • Build and prioritize a backlog that measurably improves customer stickiness, and bring well-reasoned prioritization recommendations to roadmap planning.

Data AI-Assisted Product Development

  • Write your own SQL to explore feature usage, tracking performance and customer behavior, without waiting on an analyst.
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor and similar) to build working prototypes, internal tools and quick analyses that make a requirement concrete before engineering picks it up.
  • Work hands-on in product analytics platforms like Pendo, and maintain dashboards that track adoption trends across customer segments.
  • Turn quantitative findings into clear product hypotheses and actionable backlog items.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering on instrumentation and event tracking.

Customer Engagement

  • Run discovery sessions and join onboarding calls, QBRs and support escalations to understand shipper and carrier workflows firsthand.
  • Work with Customer Success Managers to surface systemic product gaps and recurring pain points.
  • Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning and sprint reviews.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work with Engineering and Design through scoping, development and post-launch monitoring, partnering directly with squads across time zones.
  • Support Product Marketing with onboarding materials, release notes and adoption playbooks.
  • Contribute to presales conversations and market requirements gathering with Solutions teams.

Who you are

Were hiring at two levels:

  • Associate Product Manager: 2-4 years in product management or a related role. Strong BA, analyst, solutions or implementation backgrounds in logistics tech are welcome.
  • Product Manager: 5+ years, including end-to-end ownership of a product area and a track record of shipping with measurable business impact.

For both levels:

  • Practical experience in supply chain or logistics. You understand shipper pain points, carrier dynamics and how freight moves day to day.
  • Comfort working hands-on with data: strong SQL, familiarity with analytics tools, and the ability to build a data-driven story on your own.
  • Proven use of AI tools to speed up PM work beyond drafting documents, such as building prototypes, scripts and internal tools yourself. Be ready to walk us through something youve built this way.
  • Strong customer engagement skills. Youve run discovery calls, written user stories, and can turn qualitative feedback into crisp requirements.
  • Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones.
  • Ability to work with significant overlap with US Central Time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with two or more of truckload, LTL, parcel and last mile.
  • Prior work on SaaS onboarding flows, feature adoption programs or customer health scoring.
  • Experience with Pendo, Amplitude or similar product analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with agile development and working directly with engineering squads.
  • Bachelors degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, economics or another quantitative field.

What success looks like in year 1

  • You independently own a product area within OTR visibility, with clear adoption and engagement KPIs.
  • Youve shipped customer-facing improvements end to end, from discovery through post-launch analysis, with significant business impact.
  • You use data to find insights before anyone has to ask for them.
  • Youve built prototypes or internal tools that changed how a requirement was scoped or how your team works.
  • Customer Success and Engineering see you as a reliable, high-signal partner.

* The Founder

Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

Mission

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

The role

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

What we’re looking for

Customer obsession. You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.

Product judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.

A builder’s instinct. You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.

Technical fluency. You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.

Care for the details. You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.

Ownership. You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.

Clear communication. You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

Experience

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.

You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.

You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.

You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.

You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.

You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Product Management, Scheme and Regulatory Compliance

Overview

Mastercard Gateway, formerly known as MPGS, operates at the centre of the global payments ecosystem and supports customers across more than 70 countries. As an agnostic gateway serving acquirers, merchants, and partners globally, Mastercard Gateway must continuously respond to payment scheme mandates, regional regulatory requirements, and internal Mastercard compliance obligations.

From a Gateway Scheme Compliance perspective, this role is critical to ensuring that scheme and regulatory changes are identified early, assessed accurately, prioritized effectively, and delivered within mandated timelines. The role supports the translation of scheme communications, announcements, bulletin into clear business impact assessments, product roadmap priorities, execution plans, and stakeholder communications that help reduce financial, operational, reputational risk.
This role also supports gateway customers to gain benefit via reduced scheme fees, higher approval rates, and enable new MC product and services.

Role

Reporting to the Director of Scheme Compliance, the role holder will support the Product Compliance function for the Mastercard Gateway product suite. The primary objective is to strengthen MPGS readiness for scheme mandates and regulatory obligations by driving disciplined intake, impact assessment, prioritization, governance, and execution tracking across the product lifecycle.

The role will scan and analyse card scheme rules, bulletins, announcements, and mandates, assess applicability to MPGS, and convert these inputs into actionable roadmap items, compliance requirements, customer-impact assessments, and delivery priorities.
The role will manage the collection, assessment, and prioritization of scheme compliance initiatives across Gateway, working closely with Global Product Management, Regional Product teams, Product Management-Technical, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Customer-facing teams. The role will also support governance forums and PI Planning inputs to ensure compliance priorities are visible, understood, and reflected in delivery plans.

The Compliance Product team is responsible for maintaining a structured relationship with Payment Schemes, including Mastercard, Visa, Amex, and other relevant networks, for receiving, analysing, clarifying, and operationalizing scheme bulletins and mandates.

In addition, the role holder will support internal and external communication, training, and readiness activities for stakeholders and customers impacted by scheme or regulatory changes.

Responsibilities

Analyse card scheme communications, mandates, bulletins, and regulatory updates to identify applicability, business impact, customer impact, delivery risk, and compliance deadlines for Mastercard Gateway.
Provide clear summaries of scheme rule changes and translate them into actionable requirements for impacted Gateway business areas.
Partner with Product, PMT, Region, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Customer-facing teams to ensure required changes are prioritized and delivered within mandated timelines.
Support roadmap planning and SAFe PI or Kanban Planning by ensuring scheme compliance priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines are clearly represented in delivery plans.
Maintain a central repository of scheme communications, impact assessments, decisions, evidence, and delivery status for auditability and transparency.
Build and maintain internal portals, trackers, and communication channels for scheme compliance updates and mandate visibility.
Define, document, and continuously improve internal processes for scheme compliance intake, triage, assessment, governance, escalation, and closure with end to end ownership.
Support MPGS business areas with scheme-related queries, clarifications, and interpretation of scheme requirements.
Prepare internal and external communications, training material, customer readiness updates, and implementation guidance for impacted stakeholders.
Liaise with payment networks and schemes where applicable to clarify requirements, represent MPGS considerations, and advocate appropriate Mastercard or customer positions.
Identify and escalate compliance gaps, delivery risks, financial exposure, and customer impacts in a timely manner, with recommended remediation and communication plans.
Use and bring AI efficiency in day-to-day work and in the compliance process which will add benefit to the Gateway and customers.

All About You

8+ years of experience in Product Management, Payments, Scheme Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, Gateway products, Acquiring business, Merchant services, or related payments domains.
Strong understanding of card schemes authorization & clearing modules, payment gateways, acquirers, merchants, acquiring banks, ecommerce, card present, digital and token payment flows.
Experience interpreting scheme rules, mandates, bulletins, compliance requirements, and regulatory updates, with the ability to convert them into clear product requirement and delivery actions.
Experience working with agile and Kanban delivery models, ideally including SAFe, PI Planning, backlog prioritization, dependency management, and cross-team execution tracking.
Ability to build effective relationships across Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Regional, Commercial, Sales, Support, and Customer-facing teams.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess business impact, delivery complexity, financial exposure, reputational risk, and customer implications.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across global teams and time zones.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex scheme requirements for both technical and business audiences.
Self-organized, self-driven with E2E ownership mindset, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced global payments environment with evolving priorities and strict compliance deadlines.
Knowledge on AI tools, AI agents and application like Aha, Confluence, Jira is essential.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Industry Context: AI-driven supply chain innovations reduce logistics costs by 15%+, inventory by 35%+, and improve service efficiency by 65%+. Companies prioritize AI-enabled automation as the key enabler for customer experience, sustainability, and resilience.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.

FourKites is looking for a sharp, curious and execution-focused Product Manager to join the Visibility team and own our Over-the-Road (OTR) portfolio: Truckload, LTL, Parcel and Last Mile. This is FourKites' flagship product line. Some of the world's largest shippers use it to track billions of dollars of freight every day.

This is not a PM support role. You will own real product outcomes from day one. You'll work hands-on with data, build your own prototypes, talk directly with enterprise customers, and partner with engineering and design to ship features that improve adoption, retention and tracking quality.

The role sits where supply chain operations meet modern software product development, and you'll need both. You need deep empathy for how freight actually moves across modes, and the analytical rigor to turn that into product bets worth making.

What you'll be doing

Product Ownership & Outcomes

Own product outcomes for one or more OTR modes (Truckload, LTL, Parcel or Last Mile), including tracking quality, ETA accuracy and carrier coverage.
Track and analyze adoption, engagement and retention KPIs for your area.
Find friction points and adoption gaps using usage data, customer interviews and feedback from Customer Success and Sales.
Build and prioritize a backlog that measurably improves customer stickiness, and bring well-reasoned prioritization recommendations to roadmap planning.

Data & AI-Assisted Product Development

Write your own SQL to explore feature usage, tracking performance and customer behavior, without waiting on an analyst.
Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor and similar) to build working prototypes, internal tools and quick analyses that make a requirement concrete before engineering picks it up.
Work hands-on in product analytics platforms like Pendo, and maintain dashboards that track adoption trends across customer segments.
Turn quantitative findings into clear product hypotheses and actionable backlog items.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering on instrumentation and event tracking.

Customer Engagement

Run discovery sessions and join onboarding calls, QBRs and support escalations to understand shipper and carrier workflows firsthand.
Work with Customer Success Managers to surface systemic product gaps and recurring pain points.
Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning and sprint reviews.

Cross-Functional Execution

Work with Engineering and Design through scoping, development and post-launch monitoring, partnering directly with squads across time zones.
Support Product Marketing with onboarding materials, release notes and adoption playbooks.
Contribute to presales conversations and market requirements gathering with Solutions teams.

Who You Are

We're hiring at two levels:

Associate Product Manager: 2–4 years in product management or a related role. Strong BA, analyst, solutions or implementation backgrounds in logistics tech are welcome.
Product Manager: 5+ years, including end-to-end ownership of a product area and a track record of shipping with measurable business impact.

For both levels:

Practical experience in supply chain or logistics. You understand shipper pain points, carrier dynamics and how freight moves day to day.
Comfort working hands-on with data: strong SQL, familiarity with analytics tools, and the ability to build a data-driven story on your own.
Proven use of AI tools to speed up PM work beyond drafting documents, such as building prototypes, scripts and internal tools yourself. Be ready to walk us through something you've built this way.
Strong customer engagement skills. You've run discovery calls, written user stories, and can turn qualitative feedback into crisp requirements.
Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones.

Prior work on SaaS onboarding flows, feature adoption programs or customer health scoring.
Experience with Pendo, Amplitude or similar product analytics tools.
Familiarity with agile development and working directly with engineering squads.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, economics or another quantitative field.

You independently own a product area within OTR visibility, with clear adoption and engagement KPIs.
You've shipped customer-facing improvements end to end, from discovery through post-launch analysis, with significant business impact.

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

QAD's AI Platform is the domain intelligence layer that sits between the ERP and autonomous AI agents. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable — transforming QAD from a system of record into a system of action.

Job Description

This role owns the full product lifecycle for QAD's Copilot, Search, and Conversational Analytics capabilities — from architecture through to market launch. You will define what gets built, why it matters to manufacturing users, and how it reaches them: shaping the product vision, driving engineering delivery, and partnering with GTM to ensure adoption.

The intelligence that powers these surfaces — how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how data is retrieved, and how responses are generated — is where QAD's AI moat is built. You will need to engage deeply with these layers, not as an engineer but as the product owner who defines the contracts, quality standards, and sequencing decisions that determine whether they work in production at enterprise scale.

You will report to the Head of Platform Product, with day-to-day direction from the Director of the AI Platform org. This role is evaluated through the quality of your product thinking, your influence on engineering direction, and the outcomes you drive in the market.

The Opportunity

Manufacturing users today cannot query their own operations without analysts, BI tools, or pre-built reports. QAD's AI platform changes this — but only if the Copilot and Search layer is built correctly and lands with users. You will own both sides of that equation.

Define the semantic search and conversational analytics product that allows manufacturing users to query operational data — orders, inventory, suppliers, quality records — in natural language, without SQL or BI expertise
Own the intelligence contract: how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how retrieval is orchestrated, and how responses are grounded in governed data — the foundational decisions that determine product quality at scale
Drive the Copilot from concept to customer — including the contextual layer architecture, the grounding contract against the platform's Semantic Layer, and the GTM motion that gets it adopted in manufacturing workflows
Build the feedback loops that make the product smarter over time: how recurring query patterns surface ontology gaps, how session analytics drive prioritisation, and how discovery findings translate into product improvements
Establish QAD's conversational analytics presence in market — working with GTM to define positioning, enablement, and the narrative that differentiates QAD's intelligence layer from horizontal AI tools

Key Responsibilities

Copilot & Conversational Analytics

Own the product definition for QAD's Copilot: how queries are understood, context assembled, data retrieved, and responses generated — specifying the contracts that engineering builds against
Define the grounding contract: the rules that ensure every Copilot response cites governed manufacturing data, not hallucinated inference — including confidence signalling and graceful fallback behaviour
Drive the conversational analytics strategy: how natural language queries translate into analytical results across manufacturing data domains without exposing SQL or BI complexity to the user
Specify the disambiguation model: how the Copilot handles ambiguous queries, missing context, and conflicting data signals in real manufacturing workflows

Search

Own the product definition for QAD's semantic search layer: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking, and result structure across manufacturing data domains
Define the search intent taxonomy — operational (find order, trace shipment), analytical (show trends, compare periods), and diagnostic (why is this delayed, what caused this variance) — and specify result formats by intent type
Drive the federated search architecture: how results from ERP operational data, analytical stores, and the knowledge graph are ranked and merged into a coherent, useful response

Discovery, Delivery & GTM

Maintain a structured customer discovery programme — extracting real manufacturing query patterns and translating findings into specific product and architecture implications
Own the product backlog: writing stories to Staff Engineer level of specificity — API contracts, state machines, data flows, edge cases — that engineering can build without verbal clarification
Partner with GTM to define the launch and adoption strategy for Copilot and Search: positioning, sales enablement, onboarding playbooks, and the narrative that lands with manufacturing buyers
Define the quality framework for these surfaces: what signals matter for product performance — retrieval relevance, grounding rate, latency distribution — and how they inform roadmap decisions

Stakeholder Management & Managing Up

Proactively surface dependencies, risks, and scope changes to the Director and Head of Platform Product — with a resolution proposal, not just an escalation
Communicate product and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders — translating trade-offs into business implications without jargon
Build credibility with Engineering, Architecture, and GTM through the quality and precision of written work

Qualifications

Product Experience

7–12 years in product management, with significant time owning AI-powered, search, or analytics products in enterprise B2B environments — from definition through production launch
Proven track record owning the full product lifecycle: customer discovery, specification, engineering delivery, and GTM — not just one slice
Experience working in matrixed organisations — driving outcomes across Platform, Engineering, Architecture, and GTM without direct authority
Evidence of structured discovery practice applied to a technical product surface — ability to extract product implications from user research, not just UX insights

Core Technical Depth — Required

These are the primary technical domains this role owns. Strong command is expected from day one.

Semantic search architecture: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking models, and relevance evaluation at enterprise scale
Conversational AI product design: how natural language queries are translated into structured analytical results across complex, domain-specific data without exposing backend complexity to users
LLM-integrated product specification: grounding strategies, hallucination mitigation, response quality gates, and context window management — sufficient to define product contracts engineering builds against
Data platform fluency: OLAP vs operational DB reads, federated search across heterogeneous stores, and how data freshness constraints affect product quality — sufficient to hold authoritative conversations with data engineers
SQL and data modelling: sufficient to validate query plans, understand schema implications, and reason through retrieval architecture trade-offs

Working Familiarity — Expected to Grow Into

These domains sit in adjacent platform layers that Copilot and Search consume. Deep expertise is not required on day one, but working fluency is expected — and will expand as the platform scales toward agentic capabilities.

Intent detection and query understanding pipelines: how user inputs are parsed, classified, and routed across platform layers
