Responsibilities:

Why this role exists : 

We are looking for a Director, Product Strategy & Operations – Product Adoption to drive how customers discover, adopt, engage with, and derive value from HighLevel’s products and capabilities.

This role will sit at the intersection of Product Strategy, Product Management, Growth, Customer Success, Data, and Operations. The primary mandate is to identify adoption gaps across the customer journey, translate data and customer insights into clear strategic priorities, and partner with product teams to improve activation, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.

This is not a traditional program management or product operations role. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, strong analytical depth, customer understanding, and execution to influence product roadmaps and materially improve adoption across the platform

What You'll Do

Product Adoption Strategy

Define and drive HighLevel’s product adoption strategy across key products, features, and customer segments.
Identify the biggest barriers preventing customers from discovering, activating, and repeatedly using high-value capabilities.
Develop frameworks to measure adoption across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and activation through sustained engagement and expansion.
Prioritize adoption opportunities based on customer impact, business value, and strategic importance.

Adoption & Growth Analytics

Establish clear adoption metrics and success criteria for strategic product initiatives.
Analyze customer journeys, funnels, cohorts, feature usage, and behavioral patterns to identify opportunities and friction points.
Partner with Data and Product teams to understand time-to-value, activation, feature penetration, engagement, retention, and churn.
Segment adoption by customer type, cohort, geography, product, and use case to uncover actionable insights.
Build executive-level visibility into product adoption performance and emerging risks.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence

Translate adoption insights into actionable product recommendations.
Partner with Product leaders to influence roadmaps based on customer behavior, adoption gaps, and business priorities.
Identify opportunities where onboarding, UX, education, packaging, cross-product journeys, or product capabilities need to change to improve adoption.
Develop business cases for high-impact adoption initiatives and help teams prioritize investments.

Cross-Functional Execution

Partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Revenue teams.
Drive cross-functional initiatives aimed at increasing adoption of strategic product capabilities.
Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, metrics, and accountability for adoption initiatives.
Ensure product launches go beyond shipping by defining how new capabilities will achieve meaningful customer adoption.

Customer & Market Insights

Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, pain points, and reasons for non-adoption.
Combine quantitative product data with qualitative customer insights to identify root causes.
Partner with customer-facing teams to establish systematic feedback loops into Product.
Benchmark adoption and customer experience against relevant SaaS and technology platforms.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

Increase activation and adoption of strategic product capabilities.
Improve time-to-value for new and existing customers.
Increase feature penetration and depth of product usage.
Improve engagement and repeat usage of high-value workflows.
Reduce adoption-related friction and early customer drop-off.
Establish measurable relationships between product adoption and retention, expansion, and customer value.
Build a scalable operating model for measuring and improving adoption across HighLevel.

Ideal Candidate Profile

12+ years of experience across Product Strategy, Growth, Product Management, Product Operations, Strategy & Operations, or related functions, with meaningful leadership experience.
Strong experience driving product adoption, activation, engagement, retention, or product-led growth within a technology/SaaS business.
Demonstrated ability to use product and customer data to identify problems and drive strategic decisions.
Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, segmentation, experimentation, retention, and customer lifecycle metrics.
Track record of influencing Product roadmaps and senior stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
Ability to move comfortably between executive-level strategy and hands-on problem solving.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
Strong communication and storytelling skills, particularly when translating complex data into clear recommendations.
Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB products, platform businesses, or multi-product ecosystems is highly preferred.

Drive cross-functional execution across Product, DS, Eng, Design, and GTM — with a particular focus on coordinating the two-sided nature of the product (contributors and consumers).

Familiarity with Indian credit signals (ROC filings, GST compliance, bureau inputs, bank statement proxies, alternate data) and how they complement trade payment data.

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Real ownership and fast execution.

Morgan and Chase brands. About the role We're building a brand-facing platform that enables our partner brands to grow on Purplle through operational excellence and data intelligence. The core objective is simple: create real, measurable value for brands operating on our platform — making it easier for them to run their business with us and easier for them to grow it. You'll join as a Product Manager owning a meaningful slice of this platform end-to-end — from problem discovery through launch and adoption — working closely with a small, high-ownership product team and cross-functional stakeholders across the business. What you'll do - Own product areas end-to-end: discovery, PRD writing, design collaboration, build oversight, launch, and adoption. - Ground every decision in real data — you'll pull and interpret actual usage, operational, and business data rather than working off assumptions. - Partner closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional business stakeholders to ship high-quality, brand-facing products. - Translate ambiguous, evolving business problems into clear, build-ready specifications. - Run a disciplined, iterative delivery cadence — validate direction early, correct fast, and ship surgically once something's approved. - Own outcomes, not just output — define what success looks like for your area and instrument for it. - Build with an AI-native mindset — actively identify where AI/LLM capabilities can create outsized value for brand users (automation, intelligence, personalization) rather than treating AI as an add-on, and use AI tools yourself to move faster through discovery, spec-writing, prototyping, and analysis. About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own and elevate one of the most operationally critical parts of our product ecosystem: the systems and workflows that power everything. This is a high-trust, high-visibility role — the individual in this seat will become the primary product decision-maker for a wide surface area spanning Sales, Business, and cross-functional stakeholder needs, working in close partnership with our Global Business Head.

This is a rare opportunity to combine deep technical ownership with real strategic influence. You'll be entrusted with day-to-day prioritization judgment on behalf of senior leadership, giving you outsized decision-making scope relative to a typical PM role at this level. You'll also have a mandate to bring modern, AI-driven thinking into a substantial, complex product area — identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency that haven't been explored before.
This role suits a Product person who thrives on complexity and ownership, enjoys being the person stakeholders trust with hard calls, and is energized by solving deep, structurally complex problems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Ownership & Prioritization
Serve as the primary product owner for a broad portfolio of enterprise and operational systems.
Partner closely with the Global Business Head to translate business priorities into a clear, well-sequenced roadmap, exercising independent day-to-day judgment on what matters most.
Convert competing, ambiguous requirements from multiple stakeholders into a coherent, defensible plan.
Make and communicate difficult trade-off decisions with clarity and confidence.
2. Technical & Systems Depth
Build a genuinely deep, hands-on command of the underlying systems and codebase — going well beyond requirements-gathering into real technical fluency.
Own product quality end-to-end: understand technical risk, architectural constraints, and the true cost of new requests.
Partner closely with engineering to balance system integrity with business velocity.
3. AI-Driven Innovation
Bring a first-principles, AI-native lens to a large and complex product area, proactively identifying where automation, AI, and modern tooling can unlock efficiency or new capability.
Champion new approaches independently, without waiting for a formal mandate to innovate.
4. Senior Stakeholder Management
Operate as a sharp, credible partner to senior stakeholders across Sales, Business, and Technology.
Influence effectively at the senior level — building trust and alignment even when delivering difficult or unpopular decisions.
Communicate priorities, trade-offs, and rationale in a way that earns confidence from leadership.
5. Sustained, Independent Ownership
Operate effectively and consistently in a complex, matrixed environment with many stakeholders and long-running technical complexity.
Maintain strong engagement, energy, and standards over sustained periods, including in phases that are less visible or less immediately rewarding.
Build productive, effective working relationships across a wide range of engineering and business collaborators.

Required Experience & Skills

7+ years in Product Management, with substantial experience owning complex, technically deep, or platform-style product areas.
Demonstrated ability to go deep technically — genuinely comfortable partnering with engineering on architecture and system trade-offs, not just at the roadmap layer.
Proven track record of prioritization and decision-making under real, competing pressure, with the ability to speak to specific examples.
Strong, demonstrable fluency in applying AI/automation to solve business problems independently.
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with senior and cross-functional audiences.
A track record of sustained, high-quality delivery in complex or ambiguous environments over an extended period.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability; comfortable operating in ambiguity.
Travel industry experience (B2B travel, travel marketplaces, booking platforms, distribution, hospitality, or travel technology) preferred, not required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:
Is energized by scope and ownership, and comfortable being the person a wide range of stakeholders rely on for judgment calls.
Treats complex, technically deep systems as a craft to master.
Brings AI-native thinking as a default instinct.
Is diplomatic and sharp at once — able to build trust with senior stakeholders while still holding a clear point of view.
Has the temperament and consistency to perform at a high level over the long run.

Priority Criteria

Given the scope and complexity of this role, the following are considered essential:

1. Deep technical and systems fluency — genuine, hands-on command of the product's technical foundation.
2. Strong, credible influence with senior stakeholders — able to align and hold a position at the leadership level.
3. Sustained high performance in complex environments — consistent delivery and engagement over time, not just in short sprints.
Strong AI/automation fluency and sharp day-to-day prioritization judgment are highly valued and heavily weighted in selection, alongside the above.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the ability to:
Become the trusted product decision-maker for this portfolio → Elevate system quality and technical health → Introduce AI-led efficiencies not previously explored → Maintain strong prioritization discipline amid competing demands → Sustain this level of performance and engagement over time.

Preferred Industry: Travel / Travel Technology / Hospitality / OTA / B2B Marketplace

Description

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores.

The Merchant In-Store Operations team, within JWO, owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in-store associate experience and education; Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day-to-day, and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed.

You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In-Store Operations —covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long-term Merchant In-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments.

As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting with emerging technologies like generative AI and AI-powered agents, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, deep retail operations and customer support expertise, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.

Key job responsibilities

Define and evangelize the long-term vision for Merchant In-Store Operations, developing strategic roadmaps for unattended operations, planogram tooling, and in-store associate experience that align with Just Walk Out's goal of scaling from 400 to 7,000+ stores by 2028
Own the unattended operations strategy, designing and delivering the systems, workflows, and merchant-facing capabilities that enable fully unmanned JWO stores (micro-markets, kiosks, grab-and-go locations) to operate reliably at scale with minimal human intervention, including remote monitoring, automated alerting, and self-service recovery mechanisms
Lead the planogram tools vision and execution, owning the end-to-end product experience that enables merchants and solution architects to design, configure, validate, and update store layouts and product placements across diverse physical formats, reducing planogram setup time and improving accuracy for new store launches and seasonal resets
Own the JWO In-Store Associate Experience and Education strategy, building intuitive tools, dashboards, and training resources that empower store associates to understand autonomous retail operations, troubleshoot common issues, manage day-to-day store tasks, and deliver excellent customer service in a checkout-free environment
Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade in-store operations capabilities, making technical decisions that balance merchant needs across diverse verticals (Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, Hospitality) with engineering constraints, platform stability, and the ability to support stores with vastly different physical layouts and operational requirements
Own the operational playbook for unattended store formats, defining standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and automated remediation workflows that ensure consistent store uptime and customer experience across geographies and merchant types
Define and track key metrics including store uptime, mean-time-to-resolution, associate task completion rates, planogram accuracy, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product investment decisions
Build and maintain relationships with enterprise customers and cross-functional stakeholders, gathering requirements from merchants operating at scale, understanding in-store operational constraints, and ensuring Merchant In-Store Operations capabilities meet current needs while anticipating future requirements as the business scales globally

Our Company 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You’ll Do 

In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience. 

Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance. 

Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency. 

Who You Will Work With

On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field. 
12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers 
Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 
Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence. 
Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization. 
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences. 
Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities. 

What You Will Bring

Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time 
Hands-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR). 
Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware. 
A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage. 
Vision to anticipate industry trends, next-generation backup architectures, AI-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready. 



Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

The initial focus will be on Roundel and Target marketing spend, with the opportunity to expand measurement capabilities across loyalty, promotions, and other enterprise marketing investments.

Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future.

Job Description

As the Product Manager, Engagement - you'll be focused on driving roadmap execution and delivery. You will be instrumental in shaping the technical delivery within our Consumer Experience division, headquartered in our new office in Bangalore. In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for providing strategic direction for the product management function, ensuring the successful implementation of our roadmap, and contributing to the overall success of Skillz. Your role will encompass inspiring a culture of challenging the status quo, promoting data-driven decisions and KPIs, leading by example, and fostering innovation within the eSports domain. This is a unique opportunity for an experienced product manager to impact the eSports space significantly.

3+ years of PM/live operations experience. 
3+ years of experience in building and delivering user-centered, engaging experiences across a range of platforms, with the ability to demonstrate the success and impact of efforts for both users and businesses. This should include at least 3 years in games (RMG or mobile). 
Demonstrated experience in increasing activity spent in app/per session, quantity of games played, and increased % of AGPP.
Experience in the Gaming Industry (ideally). Experience in building web or mobile gameplay, competition features, and/or social experiences in social casino or puzzle games is a strong plus. Knowledge of consumer products, refined visual design sensibility, and a passion for mobile. 
Able to work in-office 5 days a week in Bangalore, India. 
A great communicator (verbal, written, and visual) who can influence and build consensus within a product team and with executive stakeholders across the company. 

What We Are Looking For

Durability and Resiliency - A startup mindset and comfort in building from the ground up. 
Ability to work cross-functionally with stakeholders to define the consumer product vision, strategy, and roadmap for achievements and social game modes aligned with the overall company product roadmap and business strategy. 
A strategic thinker who can own the overall plan, including design, implementation, GTM (Go-To-Market), and analysis framework of features and functional refinements. 
Ability to work with the Leadership team to estimate ship dates of major deliverables with 75% accuracy or better. 
An excellent communicator capable of clearly sharing feature development progress, metric impact, etc., with a multi-functional group. 
Ability to understand and articulate the company mission to the Engineering and Design teams. 

Join Skillz and Let's Redefine the Boundaries of Gaming!

Together, we'll create a world where skill, passion, and innovation thrive. Join our team and be part of the journey. We look forward to having you on board!

Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About Glean

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About The Role

Glean is seeking a Product Manager to help solve a ubiquitous problem that all knowledge workers in the world struggle with on a daily basis. You’ll deliver best-in-class products for finding, curating, sharing, discovering, and managing knowledge. We’ve only taken the first step towards our long-term vision of an intelligent work assistant, and we need great product leaders to take us the rest of the way.

We’re currently a very lean product team, so you’ll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself. You’ll collaborate closely with our stellar Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Success partners to understand our customers and build category-defining tools. You’ll wear many hats and gain both breadth and depth of experience. As Glean’s PM for Protect ( Security and Governance) you’ll develop new technologies and product features spanning explainable / transparent AI systems, identification and prevention of various vectors of AI risks, and the observability, security and privacy features around AI agents and underlying data for our customers.

You Will

Spending a lot of time with our customers to deeply understand their knowledge needs
Developing key parts of our product roadmap, marrying customers’ needs with our product vision
Empowering your team by giving context, setting direction, and building alignment
Driving customer-focused decisions, clear prioritization, and efficient execution
Coordinating cross-functionally with with leadership, go-to-market teams, and other key stakeholders across the company
Building processes that will scale as our team and company go through rapid growth

About You

You have 8+ years of experience in product management at SaaS companies, primarily serving large enterprises with responsibilities spanning security, governance, trust, identity, data integrations.
You have a strong technical background and experience with both UX and API driven products, integration paths, and 3rd party product partnerships.
You are an excellent written and verbal communicator.
You have a proven track record of taking ownership, taking initiative, and delivering results.
You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.
You have a learning and growth mindset.
You are mission-first and understand that your success is measured by your product and team’s success.

Location:

This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset At Glean

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.
Who We Are… 
When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…
From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
Senior Staff Product Manager – Technical (Data & Audience Platform Team), Hyderabad
About Warner Bros. Discovery:
Warner Bros. Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The new company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.
For more information, please visit www.wbd.com.

Meet our team
The Data and Audience Platform team sits within the Data & Analytics organization in WBD's Global Tech division. We build the data platform behind our streaming services and content businesses - the pipelines, data lakes, and serving infrastructure that turn billions of events into audience insights, personalization, and intelligent products.

About the Role
The Senior Staff Product Manager-Tech, AI/ML Roadmap and Platform Strategy, will define and drive the Data & Audience Platform (DAP) AI roadmap across predictive ML, GenAI, agentic workflows, AI-enabled analytics, data activation, and AI-native platform capabilities. This role is intentionally AI-centric: it exists to elevate DAP from a data and analytics platform organization into a product-led AI enablement function that identifies the highest-value AI opportunities, chooses the right technologies, and converts experimentation into durable business outcomes.
This role will be accountable for disciplined AI product strategy: selecting the right problems, validating that the newest technology is actually the best fit, defining measurable business value up front, and ensuring platform investments are reusable, governed, cost-aware, and scalable. The role will work across DAP, engineering, analytics, data science, architecture, product, operations, privacy/legal, AI governance, and senior leadership to make AI investments actionable, safe, and outcome driven.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Shape AI product strategy and roadmap priorities across DAP platform areas.
Evaluate AI/ML opportunities through value, feasibility, cost, data readiness, governance, and reuse lenses.
Write AI-focused PRDs, product briefs, model/agent behavior requirements, evaluation criteria, and launch readiness requirements.
Partner with engineering, data science, and architecture to compare model, platform, vendor, and implementation tradeoffs.
Define KPIs and decision frameworks that connect AI outputs to business outcomes.
Run AI roadmap, prioritization, value review, and post-launch measurement forums.
Translate complex AI/ML concepts into clear executive narratives and actionable decisions.
Identify when AI work should be standardized as a shared platform capability versus delivered as a bespoke solution.
Work with cross-functional teams to intake, define, identify risks, and schedule work to develop key features.
Formulate a point of view on how proposed features align with business goals and our tech strategy.

What to Bring:
12+ years of product management, technical product management, AI/ML product strategy, data platform, analytics, or related experience.
Deep experience defining and delivering AI/ML, GenAI, data platform, customer intelligence, analytics, activation, or enterprise platform products at scale.
Strong working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts including model lifecycle, experimentation, model evaluation, MLOps, data quality, governance, semantic layers, feature/data products, and post-launch performance measurement.
Practical fluency in modern AI patterns such as LLMs, RAG, agentic systems, AI orchestration, prompt and agent lifecycle management, human-in-the-loop workflows, and AI observability.
Demonstrated ability to set product vision and direction across multiple teams and highly ambiguous technical domains.
Strong ability to evaluate technology tradeoffs across capability, quality, scalability, privacy, security, cost, maintainability, and business value.
Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into clear decisions, narratives, and value cases.
Proven ability to influence without authority across engineering, architecture, data science, TPM, analytics, operations, business, governance, and senior leadership teams.
Track record of delivering measurable customer, business, operational, or platform impact from technical product investments.

The Nice to Haves
Experience with streaming media, digital video, Customer 360, personalization, recommendations, content intelligence, advertising analytics, audience activation, commerce analytics, marketing analytics, or global platform products.
Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, model risk review, privacy/security requirements, or compliance needs for AI-powered products.
Experience creating scalable intake, prioritization, value management, and post-launch measurement mechanisms for AI portfolios.
Experience with AI cost management, cloud/data platform FinOps, model inference cost tradeoffs, vendor evaluation, or build/buy/reuse decisioning.
Experience mentoring senior PMs / PM-Ts and raising product craft across a matrixed organization.

What We Offer:
A Great Place to work.
Equal opportunity employer
Fast track growth opportunities

How We Get Things Done…
This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
Championing Inclusion at WBD
Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

The group you’ll be a part of

Product Management in Lam India, specifically Deposition Product Group.

The impact you’ll make

As a Product Manager at Lam, you play a crucial role in defining the strategy, roadmap, and features of the product. You are both strategic and tactical. You will span the entire product life cycle, from definition and planning to production release, upgrades, and end-of-life. Your leadership skills will be vital in ensuring cross-functional collaboration across different departments to drive the success of the portfolio of products. With your expertise in both business and technical domains, you’ll bring the product vision to life for Lam and our customers.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities Strategic

Drive product roadmap, strategy, vision for enhancements of existing products to meet requirements for target applications and customers.
Work in conjunction with product marketing, product line GM, technology development, customer interface to define the portfolio of products offered, including setting product life cycle strategy and ensuring execution to the defined plan of record for each product.
Facilitate review of market, technology, and competitive trends leading to development and revision of product strategy/roadmap and organizational priorities.
Functions as a central resource with design, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing and distribution as the product(s) move through their lifecycle.
Directs those involved in the design, modification and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products.
Formulates and executes long-term plans for cost/profit control.
Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends.
Define and institutionalize new processes to improve effectiveness, leverage synergies and enable maturity of the organization.
Be the change agent, driving process excellence, ownership of products, responsiveness to customer problems and leading by example.

Required Skills

Who we’re looking for

Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.
Familiarity with one or more families of semiconductor equipment, in either deposition or etch; ideally direct exposure to customer fabs.
In-depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline and broad knowledge of other disciplines within the function.
Exercises independent judgement in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. 
A confident, intellectually curious individual with a demonstrated leadership capability.
Bias for action, Drive to completion with conviction and courage.
Excellent collaboration & communication; form cross-functional partnerships to enable successful execution.
Ability to communicate complex ideas to persuade a different point of view.
Ability to bring clarity and guidance during uncertainty, Data backed decision making.
Ability to lay out clear messages and value propositions in clean and concise collateral.
Ability to solve unique and complex problems with broad impact on the business in a fast moving environment.
Leading projects with notable risk and complexity; developing strategy for project execution.
Effective management of stakeholder expectations - Business process and Operational focus, Leadership, Agility.

Preferred Qualifications

Have knowledge of best practices and how product management function integrates with others areas.
Awareness of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.
General/functional understanding of business processes.
Ability to anticipate business and regulatory issues.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

About Chargebee:
Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest-growing brands around the world today, including Calendly, Hopin, Pret-a-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study.com and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription-first businesses process over billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform.

Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 500+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA.
Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we’re on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model.

Our team builds high-quality and innovative software to enable our customers to grow their revenues powered by the state-of-the-art subscription management platform

About the Team
We own the core of Chargebee's billing platform: the mission-critical system of record that 6,500 customers across the globe rely on to run billions of dollars in revenue.
Our customers range from startups to global enterprises, across B2B and B2C, and diverse go-to-market motions including PLG, SLG, and reseller. All of them bill on the same core platform.

About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Product Manager with a platform mindset to own Billing and Subscription Management, one of Chargebee's most foundational product areas. You will lead the evolution of the core billing platform, making it more flexible, scalable, and intelligent.
The work is a balance. You will support thousands of existing businesses with urgent, high-stakes requirements, while simultaneously evolving the platform for AI-native monetization models, reimagining billing workflows, and creating dramatically better customer experiences.

What You'll Do
Shape the roadmap: Understand customer requirements, market needs, competitive movements, and emerging trends; synthesize these into clear themes that inform and prioritize the roadmap.
Drive cross-functional execution: Core billing workflows span multiple modules and teams. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, and dependent squads to drive execution with clarity and alignment.
Make hard prioritization calls: Navigate competing priorities, make clear trade-offs, and communicate decisions effectively with stakeholders.
Reimagine billing with AI: Drive innovation across core billing workflows by exploring what is now possible with AI and translating those possibilities into meaningful customer value.
Build for flexibility and scale: Understand complex billing scenarios and apply a platform mindset to ensure capabilities are designed to flexibly support the needs of a diverse customer base.

What You'll Bring
8+ years of experience in B2B enterprise product management; experience with billing is highly desirable.
High agency: Operate as the product anchor for your charter, driving cross-functional alignment and owning outcomes end to end.
Technical fluency: Understand system design concepts and APIs well enough to collaborate effectively with senior engineers and make architecture-aware product decisions.
Collaborative mindset: Thrive in a highly collaborative environment and enjoy working across teams to solve complex problems.
AI-first mindset: Excited by the productivity and process improvements that new AI tools can unlock for product management and product development.
Structured and data-driven: Break down complex problems, go deep into the details, and make decisions grounded in data.

Why This Role Matters
Work on a mission-critical platform at truly global scale, supporting billions of dollars in processed revenue. The decisions you make will directly influence thousands of businesses
Work alongside a highly talented team of experts shaping the billing and monetization landscape for a category leading product.
Build the infrastructure for what's next in billing, monetization, and AI-powered business models.
If you are excited by complex platform problems, thrive at the intersection of customer needs and technical depth, and want to shape how businesses monetize in an AI-driven world, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

We are Globally Local
With a diverse team across four continents, and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood.

We value Curiosity
We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it’s that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, and then figure out answers to them.

Customer! Customer! Customer!
Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers’ growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It’s a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun.

Role Overview...

At IDfy, privacy isn’t paperwork — it’s power. We’re using AI to decode contracts, classify PII, and help businesses stay ahead of fast-changing privacy laws. To pull this off, we need someone who can straddle worlds: fluent in privacy, sharp with tech, and confident in boardrooms.

We are the match if...

Atleast 2 years of core product management experience in B2B SaaS
Ability to bring structure to messy problems and run sharp prioritisation.
Prior experience building LOS, LMS, HRMS, CRM, or equivalent workflow-heavy products that now need AI agents to that solve for outcomes
Comfort with AI-led product patterns: LLMs, summarisation, retrieval.
Bonus: experience in AI based risk ,fraud, or compliance products.

How you will work -

Understand customer problems, collaborate with developers and designers for a robus solution
Write PRDs that people actually read.
Sit with customers. Watch them use the product. Listen more than you talk.
Partner with engineering on trade-offs. Decide fast. Document faster with our agentic software development

Here’s what your day will look like...

Global scale from day one. This is not an India-only product. You will ship to markets across Asia, the Middle East, and beyond.
Privy has already gartenered 50+ Enterprise customers and inching towards 100 and this comes with a need for speed across functions.
Real ownership. APM at IDfy owns a roadmap decided and prioritised by the product team, not a backlog.You will work directly with engineering, design, and leadership.
Build at the intersection of AI, risk, and workflow. Few PM roles let you touch all three. This one does.
Customers who care. Our users are risk analysts, ops leaders, and CXOs at top financial institutions. Their feedback will shape what you build.
Craft matters here. We care about PRDs that think clearly, dashboards that answer the right question, and UX that respects the reviewer's time.

Location: Noida
Experience: 4 - 6 Years
Function: Product
Industry: Fintech / Financial Marketplace

About LoansJagat
LoansJagat is India’s 1st Loan Consolidation Marketplace, helping customers discover, compare and access the right financial products across personal loans, business loans and other lending solutions.
We are building technology-led financial experiences that simplify borrowing and make financial discovery more transparent, accessible and customer-centric.
As we continue to evolve our product ecosystem, we are looking for an AI-focused Associate Product Manager who is excited about building the next generation of AI-powered financial products.

What You’ll Build
This is a 0→1 product-building role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of AI + consumer products + fintech.
You will work closely with product, engineering, data, business and leadership teams to identify opportunities where AI can fundamentally improve the customer and business experience.
You will:
Work on the AI product roadmap across customer discovery, lending journeys, lead qualification, engagement and post-disbursal experiences.
Identify opportunities to use Generative AI, LLMs and AI agents to solve real customer and business problems.
Convert ambiguous business and customer problems into clear product requirements, user stories and functional specifications.
Own product features from problem discovery → research → Product Requirement Document → development → testing → launch → iteration.
Work with engineering and data teams to integrate LLM/model APIs, AI workflows and intelligent automation into products.
Explore conversational AI experiences that can simplify complex financial products for customers.
Define product metrics and success criteria for AI-powered features and continuously improve them.
Conduct user research, analyze customer behaviour and identify opportunities to improve conversion, engagement, quality and customer experience.
Run experiments and A/B tests to validate product hypotheses.
Work closely with founders, product leaders, technology, design, sales and operations teams to ship products quickly.
Ensure AI features are useful, reliable, measurable and aligned with business outcomes.
Help build products that can scale from early experiments to millions of customers across India.
Take end-to-end ownership rather than waiting for perfectly defined requirements.

What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who is curious, analytical and genuinely excited about AI and product building.
You should have:
Minimum 4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Analytics, Business Product Management or a closely related role.
Experience in fintech, lending, payments, consumer technology, SaaS or digital products is preferred.
Exposure to building or launching new product features/products from scratch.
Strong understanding of product thinking, user journeys and problem-solving.
Ability to translate business problems into structured product requirements.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with product metrics, funnels and user behavior data.
Ability to work comfortably with engineering and understand technical concepts without necessarily being a developer.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across product, technology, business and leadership teams.
A high-ownership mindset with the ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment.
Curiosity to continuously experiment with emerging AI capabilities and understand where they can create real product value.

AI / GenAI Skills – Good to Have
Hands-on exposure to any of the following will be an advantage:
Generative AI / LLM-based product development
AI agents and agentic workflows
Conversational AI / AI chatbots
Prompt engineering
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or similar
AI evaluation and response-quality frameworks
AI-powered search or recommendation systems
Basic understanding of embeddings, vector databases and knowledge retrieval
AI automation workflows
Experience working with APIs and technical documentation
Exposure to tools such as Postman, SQL, analytics platforms or product analytics tools
What Success Looks Like
In this role, success will mean:
Identifying meaningful opportunities where AI can improve the LoansJagat customer journey.
Taking AI product ideas from concept to production.
Improving measurable product outcomes such as conversion, engagement, lead quality, customer experience and operational efficiency.
Building AI experiences that are simple for customers despite the underlying financial complexity.
Creating a culture of experimentation where ideas are validated through data, user feedback and measurable outcomes.

Why Join Us?
Build AI-powered fintech products from 0→1→2.
Work closely with founders and senior leadership.
Get exposure to lending, financial marketplaces and consumer fintech.
Experiment with rapidly evolving GenAI and agentic technologies.
Own meaningful products that can impact customers at scale.

If you are excited by the idea of combining AI + Product + Fintech and want to build rather than simply maintain existing products, we would love to hear from you.

We are looking for an experienced AI Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of product, technology, client engagement, and execution. This is a high-ownership, enterprise-facing role for someone who is excited by the opportunity to shape cutting-edge AI applications, work directly with international clients, and translate complex business problems into scalable AI-enabled products.

The AI Product Manager will lead the definition, shaping, and execution of enterprise AI products and features for global clients. This role requires a rare mix of product judgment, AI fluency, consulting maturity, and hands-on problem solving. You will work closely with clients, engineering teams, designers, and delivery leaders to identify opportunities, define product direction, manage expectations, and bring AI-first solutions to life.

The ideal candidate understands how to apply GenAI and agentic patterns in enterprise contexts, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and is hands-on enough to prototype ideas, validate concepts quickly, and sharpen requirements through action. This is not a purely roadmap or coordination role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, engage credibly with clients, and get into the detail when needed.

Key Responsibilities

Own the product definition and execution of enterprise AI applications, workflows, and features from discovery through release and adoption
Work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to identify business problems, frame opportunities, and convert them into clear product requirements and delivery plans
Shape AI-first user experiences, including copilots, assistants, agentic workflows, decision-support tools, and human-in-the-loop enterprise applications
Translate ambiguous business needs into structured product artifacts such as problem statements, user journeys, PRDs, acceptance criteria, prioritization frameworks, and release scope
Partner closely with engineering, UX, architecture, and delivery teams to ensure product intent is translated into practical, scalable solutions
Drive workshops, requirement discovery sessions, stakeholder reviews, demos, and alignment discussions with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
Build lightweight prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and product mock flows using modern AI tools, no-code/low-code methods, vibe coding, and basic design/prototyping techniques where useful
Help define and refine AI use cases involving agents, orchestration, retrieval, workflow automation, and enterprise system integration
Maintain a sharp eye for detail across business requirements, product behavior, user experience, and delivery quality
Manage client expectations proactively by balancing ambition, technical feasibility, timelines, and delivery realities
Support value realization and account growth by identifying follow-on product opportunities, expansion areas, and innovation pathways within client accounts
Contribute to a product and delivery culture that values speed, clarity, experimentation, accountability, and customer impact

What Success Looks Like In This Role

Enterprise AI products and features are clearly defined, well-prioritized, and shipped with strong adoption potential
Clients see you as a credible product partner who understands both business value and execution constraints
Product requirements are crisp, actionable, and reduce ambiguity for delivery teams
AI use cases move beyond demos into usable workflows that solve real operational problems
Teams make faster, better decisions because product direction, scope, and trade-offs are well managed
Client confidence improves through strong communication, attention to detail, and disciplined expectation management
You help create momentum for account expansion by spotting practical product and AI opportunities that clients want to invest in

Requirements

7-14 years of experience in ProApplication formDesign the application form for this role.duct Management, Business Analysis, Consulting, Enterprise Software, Digital Products, or related technology roles
Demonstrated experience working on software products, platforms, or enterprise applications in client-facing environments

The Team 

Morningstar’s Analytics group develops and delivers proprietary methodologies, calculations, and analytical capabilities that help investors evaluate investments and make informed decisions. The Managed Investment Calculations team translates Morningstar’s research and intellectual property into accurate, scalable, and consistent analytics used across Morningstar products.   

The Role 

We are seeking a Associate Product Manager with strong business analysis and data analysis skills to lead the development and ongoing enhancement of managed investment calculation capabilities. 

This role combines product ownership with hands-on analytical work. You will partner with methodology experts, quantitative researchers, engineering, and quality assurance teams to translate investment methodologies and business needs into detailed calculation specifications and reliable production capabilities. You will analyze complex investment datasets, prototype and validate calculations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure that implementations faithfully reflect Morningstar’s proprietary methodologies. 

The ideal candidate brings analytical rigor, relevant investment knowledge, and the ability to learn complex financial concepts quickly. You should be comfortable both prioritizing a product backlog and using SQL to investigate underlying data. Prior knowledge of Morningstar’s products or methodologies is not required.   

Responsibilities 

  • Own product priorities and delivery: Manage the tactical roadmap and backlog for managed investment calculations, balancing new capabilities, methodology enhancements, data quality, and platform improvements. 

  • Define business requirements: Partner with product teams, research, operations, and client support to clarify user needs, assess business impact, and establish scope and success criteria. 

  • Translate methodologies into calculation specifications: Work with methodology owners to document formulas, input requirements, eligibility rules, calculation frequency, exceptions, and expected outputs. 

  • Perform detailed data and business analysis: Use SQL and analytical tools to investigate datasets, assess coverage and quality, map data sources, and understand dependencies and downstream impacts.

  • Drive execution with engineering and QA: Develop actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, resolve implementation questions, and partner on test scenarios, regression coverage, and release readiness. 

  • Safeguard calculation quality: Investigate discrepancies and production issues, identify root causes, and prioritize fixes based on investor, client, and business impact. 

  • Manage methodology and implementation changes: Evaluate effects on historical results and consuming products, coordinate stakeholder review, and maintain traceability between approved methodologies and production logic. 

  • Build shared understanding: Maintain clear calculation documentation and support materials that help global teams explain analytics and resolve client questions. 

  • Measure outcomes and communicate progress: Track calculation accuracy, timeliness, coverage, and adoption, while communicating priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.

  • Understanding of managed investments, including mutual funds, ETFs, share classes, and concepts such as investment performance, risk, fees, and peer group comparisons.

Senior Technical Product Manager, Networking and Switches
Reports To: VP of Products
Location: Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India (preferred for direct access to our hardware labs), or Remote (US).
Travel: 20%
What You Will Do
  • Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high-margin lines to scale.
  • OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
  • Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
  • Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
  • Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
  • Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End-of-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
  • Cross-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.
Core Technical Expertise
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802.1X and ACLs.
  • Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP+, RJ-45, single-mode vs. multi-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate-matching mechanics.
  • PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802.3af, 802.3at, intelligent detection and backward-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
  • Harsh-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN-rail or panel-mount deployment.
  • Out-of-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out-of-band access, terminal emulation, serial-over-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
  • Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2.0, FIPS 140-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out-of-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
  • Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS-232, RS-422, RS-485) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long-distance copper extension.
  • OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (eg, 2-kV), and surge protection.
Who Will Succeed in This Role
  • You are a hands-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning-tree loop in the lab.
  • You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
  • You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
  • Bachelor s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.
EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.

Required Qualifications

Own a Flights problem space end-to-end - not a screen, not a funnel stage. Youll take the traveller journey across shopping, booking, and post-booking and be accountable for how it performs commercially and how it behaves when reality intervenes: fares that move, tickets that fail, schedules that change, and travellers who need to cancel.
The scope deliberately spans surfaces. Metasearch and comparison remain central to how travellers find us, but the interesting problems now sit in the seams - where a supplier switch at booking time creates a support contact three days later, where a baggage allowance we didnt parse at search time becomes a refund dispute, where the fare rule we couldnt read at purchase becomes a $700 agency debit memo six months on.
This is an individual contributor role with real leverage. Youll lead cross-functional squads across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Supply, Commercial, Finance Ops, and Customer Support, and youll be measured on outcomes - conversion, traffic quality, provider performance, cost-to-serve, retention - not on shipping velocity.
What youll actually work on
These are live, funded programmes, not aspirations. The detail will shift the shape wont. Here are some examples of problems you ll need to solve.
Zero Touch - self-service refunds and exchanges. Most of our contact-centre volume is travellers asking whether they can cancel or change, and most of them dont proceed once they see the cost. Youll make that answer instant, accurate, and self-serve - genuinely end to end, including back-office execution and finance reconciliation. A refund that looks automated to the traveller but spawns four manual touches behind the scenes hasnt been automated, its been moved. Youll also design the hybrid cases, with a human in the loop.
A booking record that reflects reality. Youll help define a store that traces a trip across its full lifecycle with every money movement attached, and that reconciles sources when they disagree - which they do, sometimes on the same booking, in ways that cost us real money.
Untangling the money. Payment fees, markups, booking fees, supplier costs, penalties, and the residue of every reprice, currently spread across a dozen-plus spreadsheets and recurring arguments about which one is right. Youll work with Finance Ops on the mid-office layer that puts it all on one record - including the honest build-versus-buy call.
The hard part: what makes automation here different
Read this as a preview of your first quarter, not as a warning.
  • 90% accurate is not a pass. In most products a heuristic thats right nine times out of ten is a win. Here, the 10% is a traveller told their ticket was refundable when it wasnt - so we either break a promise or eat the loss - or a void we shouldnt have processed, which returns as an airline debit six months later with a penalty attached. Youll have to reason about failure cost per decision, not aggregate accuracy.
  • The truth is spread across systems that dont agree. There is no single row you can trust. Much of this work is deciding what the source of truth is before you can automate anything on top of it.
  • Money moves before the answer is known. Funds have often already gone to the supplier by the time we decide what the traveller is owed. Product decisions here land directly on finance reconciliation, and youll need to design with that in mind rather than hand it over.
  • Complexity were choosing to keep. Continuous reprice optimization is a significant profit stream. We are not turning it off to make servicing simpler. Youll be automating on top of a system that deliberately mutates bookings after sale.
  • Some rules only exist in someones head. A real part of this role is operational design: turning tacit knowledge held by a handful of people into something a system - or an AI agent - can act on.
