Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.

This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.

What You’ll Do

Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.

DESCRIPTION

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team builds software to improve customer experience by : (1) Enabling Agentic Shopping experiences through World Product Catalog that contains all shoppable products sold anywhere in the world, (2) Growing number of customer relevant brands and products on Amazon, and (3) enriching product and brand information in Amazon catalog. We build state-of-the-art information retrieval infrastructure, extracting structured-data from unstructured-content, automatic item classification, storage systems to hold the massive catalog and distributed systems of cloud-scale. We apply parallel processing, Generative AI solutions, and machine learning algorithms to evaluate millions of products every day and to identify and prioritize new additions to Amazon’s selection efficiently. If you are customer obsessed, driven, tenacious and analytical, you will have fun solving our business problems of unprecedented scale. You will develop deep technical expertise and learn designing large scale distributed, service-oriented systems. Come join us in our journey to improve our customer experience at Amazon !

Job Summary

As a Product Owner you are the primary link between stakeholders and delivery teams, balancing business priorities, customer expectations, operational realities, and technical feasibility. You will work closely with CTO’s org, Engineering Leadership, product management and cross-function teams.

The role calls for a highly motivated, independent thinker who is organized, detail-oriented, adaptable, and effective at building relationships across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.

Maximize product value by owning the definition, prioritization, and delivery of product capabilities — translating customer, business, operational, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable requirements and measurable outcomes.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

Define and communicate a product vision aligned with Epiq's strategic objectives and client needs.
Create, maintain, and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver maximum business value.
Partner with Product Management and Senior Product Owners to align delivery priorities with the broader product strategy.
Define minimum viable products, experiments, and incremental delivery approaches that get value to business and customers early.

Backlog Ownership & Agile Delivery

Own, maintain, and continuously refine the product backlog, prioritizing on value, risk, dependencies, and technical feasibility.
Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements. Lead backlog refinement and participate in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
Provide day-to-day requirement clarification and timely product decisions to engineering, QA, and UX, resolving impediments as they arise.

Hands-On AI Fluency & Tooling

Use AI tools hands-on in daily product work — requirement drafting, story refinement, discovery synthesis, research, meeting summarization, usage analysis — and maintain reusable prompt patterns for those workflows.
Stay current on AI capabilities and emerging patterns, and translate that awareness into concrete product decisions.
Build lightweight prototypes and clickable concepts using AI-assisted and low-code tools to validate ideas before committing engineering capacity.
Identify and prioritize AI use cases on customer value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and measurable impact, including where AI can remove manual effort from operational and client-facing workflows.
Define evaluation criteria for AI-enabled features — accuracy, groundedness, latency, cost, confidence thresholds — with human-in-the-loop checkpoints and fallback paths for non-deterministic output.
Ensure AI usage meets privacy, security, client-confidentiality, auditability, and responsible-use requirements, and never treat unvalidated AI output as a final decision or deliverable.

Stakeholder & Customer Leadership

Serve as the voice of the customer and the liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, operations, and clients.
Gather and document business and customer requirements, and facilitate discovery workshops, demonstrations, and feedback sessions.

Communicate priorities, roadmap progress, delivery status, risks, and key decisions with clarity.
Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across organizational levels, from delivery squads to senior leadership.

Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

Embed security, privacy, compliance, information governance, and operational readiness into the product lifecycle.
Identify and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints early.
Define success metrics and track adoption, utilization, and business value to guide roadmap and investment decisions.

Real products, used in production by teams running connected vehicles and fleets.
High ownership in a small team: fewer layers, faster decisions, and close contact with customers. You own your product and run it.
Work that spans software, hardware, field operations, fleet economics, and reliability.

4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.

About The Role

Purplle is hiring a Product Manager to own the post-order experience — everything a customer

goes through after placing an order: order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds, and customer

support. This is the part of the journey that decides whether a customer trusts us enough to come

back.

You'll own these flows end-to-end, treat them as products to be improved rather than systems to be

maintained, and be accountable for the metrics that show they're working — reachability of support,

resolution quality, and a smooth experience even when things go wrong.

What You'll Do

Own the post-order journey end-to-end — order tracking, cancellations, returns and refunds,

and order care — and set the roadmap, balancing quick wins (e.g., real-time tracking updates)

with longer-term bets (e.g., predictive self-service).

Make customer support reachable and effective: improve discoverability of help across key

journeys, strengthen self-service and automation, and ensure clean escalation to a human

agent when needed.

Reduce avoidable contacts (WISMO, status checks) by fixing root-cause friction in tracking and

communication — without making support harder to reach.

Raise resolution quality, measured by repeat contacts, reopens, and post-resolution satisfaction

— not just the volume of cases closed.

Monitor behavioural analytics regularly, spot abnormal changes, and turn insights into a

prioritised set of product fixes.

Partner across Engineering, Design, Customer Support Operations, Logistics, and Finance to

ship improvements and align on SLAs, policies, and delivery realities.

What We're Looking For

3–4+ years in a product role, ideally in e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech.
Experience owning customer-facing journeys or post-order / order-management / customer-

support flows.

Hands-on with data — comfortable with SQL and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Looker,

Tableau) to frame hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact.

A systems thinker who maps complex end-to-end flows and finds the highest-leverage fixes.
Customer-obsessed, with strong written communication and the ability to influence cross-

functional teams without authority.

Nice to Have

Exposure to support tooling (Zendesk, Gladly, or similar), conversational automation / chatbots,

and returns or logistics platforms.

Familiarity with India's e-commerce dynamics — COD, regional cohorts, and delivery realities.

Purplle is one of India's leading beauty e-commerce platforms, with 30M+ users and one of the most

diverse beauty catalogs in the country. We're building the operating system for beauty — connecting

consumers, brands, and beauty professionals in one ecosystem. This role owns the moment of truth:

what happens after the order, where customer trust is won or kept.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.

We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

HighLevel is a powerful platform containing hundreds of interconnected capabilities across CRM, marketing, communications, automation, commerce, websites, calendars, reporting, and AI. That breadth creates enormous value - but it also introduces complexity. Users should not need to know which menu contains a capability, how every object in HighLevel is modelled, or which sequence of screens is required to complete a business task. They should be able to describe what they want to accomplish, receive an accurate answer, and safely complete the work.

Ask AI is the natural-language operating layer designed to make that possible. It allows agencies and businesses to ask questions, understand customer and operational data, generate content and assets, create product configurations, invoke specialised agents, execute supported actions, automate recurring work, and interact with HighLevel through text, voice, structured artefacts, and guided workflows.

For Ask AI to be dependable, it needs accurate and current context. HighLevel Knowledge Bases provide the shared intelligence foundation for Ask AI and the broader AI Employee ecosystem. They ingest and organise information from websites, FAQs, rich text, documents, tables, cloud files, and other approved sources so AI products can retrieve relevant information and produce grounded responses.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own the long-term product strategy for this intelligence and assistance platform. Who we are
ParkourSC is a Silicon Valley-based company building a vertical AI platform for life sciences supply chains. Pharma, biologics, and CDMO teams use us to prevent exceptions that put temperature-sensitive, regulated products at risk, and to resolve the ones that remain before they become a crisis. When a cold-chain excursion happens, our platform takes it from stability calculation through disposition and regulatory documentation, within defined guardrails and without manual intervention, and it fits how each customer's network runs. Our customers include top-10 pharmaceutical companies, so the problems we take on are dense: regulatory, operational, and technical at the same time.

About the role
We are looking for a Product Manager / Business Analyst to sit between those customers and our development team. You will take business problems and turn them into technical requirements, epics and stories that engineers can build from without a second round of interpretation.
This is a hands-on requirements and backlog role, not a people-management role. You will own the clarity of what gets built.

What you will do
Requirements and analysis
Elicit business requirements directly from customers, internal SMEs (quality, manufacturing, supply chain) and support/escalation channels.
Translate them into unambiguous technical requirements: functional behaviour, data model implications, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and explicit out-of-scope statements.
Model current-state and target-state processes (BPMN-style flows, state diagrams, data mappings) so that everyone is arguing about the same picture.
Challenge requirements that are workarounds for a deeper process problem and say so.

Backlog ownership
Write and maintain Jira epics, features and user stories with testable acceptance criteria — Given/When/Then or equivalent, covering negative and boundary cases, not just the happy path.
Groom and prioritise the backlog with engineering and QA; run refinement sessions and keep stories "ready" ahead of sprint commitment.
Sequence work into coherent feature sets and keep a forward view of what the next two to three increments contain and what they depend on.
Be the day-to-day answer to "what did you mean by this?" for developers and testers and sign off that what was built is what was specified.

Validation and GxP documentation support
Contribute to computerised-system validation artefacts: user requirement specifications, functional specifications, requirement-to-test traceability.
Maintain traceability between customer requirement, story, acceptance criteria and test evidence so that an audit trail exists by construction rather than by archaeology.
Work within change-control and documentation practices appropriate to a regulated product.

Customer-facing discovery
Join customer workshops, discovery calls and demos; run requirement walkthroughs and playback sessions.
Document and circulate decisions, open questions and assumptions — and chase the open questions closed.

What we are looking for
Required
7–10 years in product ownership, business analysis or a closely related requirements role, with a substantial portion in enterprise or B2B software delivery.
Demonstrable experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device or another regulated life-sciences setting — you understand why GxP, data integrity and audit trails change how software must be specified.
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing concepts: batch and lot handling, bill of materials, production orders, deviations and quality events, release processes.
Proven ability to write technical requirements and Jira artefacts that a development team can build from with minimal clarification.
Fluency with Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) and the tooling around it — Jira and Confluence as a minimum.
Strong written English. Much of this role is writing precisely for an audience that will act on what you wrote.
Ability to work independently: you take a vague problem, structure it, decide what needs deciding, and escalate the rest with a recommendation rather than an open question.
Comfortable managing several parallel workstreams and shifting priorities without dropping threads.
Overlap of at least four hours daily with Central European (CET/CEST) working hours.

Advantageous — we will teach the rest
Cold chain and temperature-controlled logistics: excursion handling, mean kinetic temperature, stability budgets, time-out-of-refrigeration, lane qualification, packaging and shipper qualification.
Familiarity with GDP, Annex 1/Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, or GAMP 5.
Exposure to ERP/MES/WMS or other related systems (SAP, Oracle, Track & Trace platforms) and to how they exchange master and transactional data.
Reading-level comfort with APIs, JSON, SQL and data integration patterns — enough to specify an interface, not to implement it.
Experience supporting a computerised system through validation or a customer audit.
Prior work with distributed or offshore engineering teams.

How we will know you can learn quickly
Our domain is deep and no candidate arrives knowing all of it. What we look for is evidence that you have entered an unfamiliar technical domain before, become credible in it within a few months, and can point to what you did to get there.

How we work
Small, senior product and engineering team; low process overhead, high documentation standards.
Requirements are written down and reviewed. Verbal-only decisions do not survive here.
You will get context, access to SMEs and customer exposure — and then you will be expected to run with it.

What we offer
Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience (discussed openly during the interview process)
Statutory benefits as per country labour law
Remote-first working with [equipment / co-working allowance]
Direct exposure to pharmaceutical customers and to the regulatory reality of the products we build

How to apply
Send your CV along with a short note covering a product or feature area you owned end to end, and how you specified it.

About The/Nudge

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.

Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.

About The Insight Program

Who are we solving for?

We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.

What are we solving for?

Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.

For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.

Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.

With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.

Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.

Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.

Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.

What’s in it for you?

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

About Digantara:

Digantara is a leading Space Surveillance and Intelligence company focused on ensuring orbital safety and sustainability. At the core of its infrastructure lies a sophisticated integration of hardware and software capabilities aligned with the key principles of situational awareness: perception (data collection), comprehension (data processing), and prediction (analytics). This holistic approach empowers Digantara to monitor all Resident Space Objects (RSOs) in orbit, fostering comprehensive domain awareness.

We're looking for a Product Lead to own Digantara's SDA and conjunction-analysis product line — from problem definition through global rollout. You do need to get to first principles fast, translate customer and business context into ruthless, defensible prioritisation, and own outcomes with real independence. Product Strategy & Prioritisation

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
We are seeking a deeply technical product leader to take ownership of our extensive Networking and Switches portfolio: secure console servers, managed and unmanaged PoE Ethernet switches, media converters, industrial connectivity, and serial extension solutions. This product line is central to our customers' operations across datacom, industrial, and secure government environments. We are looking for a technical authority who will drive portfolio optimization, OEM/ODM vendor management, and rigorous quality assurance, sitting at the intersection of deep hardware engineering, and product lifecycle execution. This role can be based in our Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India offices to allow for direct, hands-on access to our hardware labs, though remote (US) arrangements will be considered for exceptional candidates.



What You Will Do
Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high-margin lines to scale.
OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End-of-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
Cross-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.


Core Technical Expertise
Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802.1X and ACLs.
Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP+, RJ-45, single-mode vs. multi-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate-matching mechanics.
PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802.3af, 802.3at, intelligent detection and backward-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
Harsh-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN-rail or panel-mount deployment.
Out-of-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out-of-band access, terminal emulation, serial-over-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2.0, FIPS 140-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out-of-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS-232, RS-422, RS-485) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long-distance copper extension.
OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (e.g., 2-kV), and surge protection.


Who Will Succeed in This Role
You are a hands-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning-tree loop in the lab.
You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.


EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.

Role Overview

For most SMBs, the phone remains one of the highest-intent customer channels. A call may represent a new lead, an urgent service request, a customer trying to book an appointment, a patient looking for help, a buyer asking a final question, or an existing customer who needs immediate support. When the call goes unanswered, the opportunity is often lost.

Most SMBs cannot staff every phone line, department, location, and language around the clock. Traditional IVRs frustrate callers, outsourced answering services lack business context, and human teams spend significant time handling repetitive conversations. HighLevel's Voice AI product is designed to change that.

Voice AI enables businesses to deploy intelligent phone agents that can answer inbound calls, initiate outbound calls, understand caller intent, hold natural conversations, answer questions from business knowledge, qualify leads, collect structured information, book appointments, trigger workflows, interact with external systems, route callers between specialised AI agents, transfer calls to humans, and complete follow-up actions.

You will own the behaviour of a specific AI system or workflow inside a larger product. You will work with a team and a defined set of internal stakeholders. Your success is measured by whether the AI system behaves as specified in production over time.

You will work with QA and engineering to build and review evaluations. This is a critical part of the role. Evaluations are how you verify the AI system keeps behaving as specified once it's live.

Building a working understanding of how AI systems work, and what that means for product and analytics, is critical to this role. You will also act as a proxy for the business team and run UAT.

Alongside that, the role carries the usual weight of product ownership: picking up an unfamiliar domain fast, holding the line on scope, and keeping stakeholders aligned on what is shipping and when.

What you will own
Backlog and delivery

Turn business requirements into AI system requirements for the engineering team.

The Evals you define must align with the product requirements.

Stakeholder Management

Work with Engineering and QA colleagues to define system guardrails

Read and assess system prompts well enough to tell whether they match the spec.

Evaluation and human oversight

Interpret results and translate them for non technical stakeholders.

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:

Role Overview:

As the Staff Product Manager for HardPhones, SIP, IVR, and Call Center, you will own the strategy, execution, and architectural evolution of HighLevel's enterprise voice and contact center infrastructure. You will lead the products and platforms that power SIP communications, physical IP phones, IVR experiences, voice routing, our multi-provider communications middleware, and native Call Center (CCaaS) features.

You will define the roadmap for building a carrier-agnostic voice platform that enables reliable, scalable, and intelligent voice communications across multiple CPaaS providers. Crucially, this scope extends into Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS). You will architect and scale our native Call Center features, developing sophisticated routing logic, agent workspaces, and queue management systems.

This role sits at the intersection of communications infrastructure, telecom engineering, voice automation, contact center operations, and platform scale. You will partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Product, Support, and external communication providers to build the next generation of HighLevel's voice platform.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the vision, strategy and execution for HighLevel's HardPhone, SIP, IVR, Call Center and Enterprise Voice platforms.
Build a scalable, provider-agnostic communications platform that abstracts multiple CPaaS providers through a unified architecture.
Architect and scale sophisticated Automatic Call Distributor (ACD) capabilities, including skills-based routing, priority queues, ring groups, overflow rules, business hours and failover logic.
Design intuitive softphone experiences across web and mobile, along with real-time supervisor dashboards for monitoring, coaching and workforce management.
Own the complete lifecycle of HardPhone provisioning, including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, firmware management, inventory management and device lifecycle operations.
Drive the evolution of IVR and Voice AI, including drag-and-drop workflow builders, conversational AI, speech recognition, call transcription, agent assistance, and call summarization.
Build enterprise telephony capabilities including call recording, voicemail, conferencing, whisper/barge, monitoring, queue management and compliance recording.
Define extensible Voice APIs, SDKs, webhooks and event frameworks that enable seamless integrations with third-party applications and ecosystem partners.
Lead customer migration initiatives, including provider migrations, number portability, hosted phone onboarding, and enterprise telephony transitions, while minimizing customer disruption.
Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Support and Go-to-Market teams to deliver highly reliable, globally scalable voice products.
Establish and monitor platform KPIs including call completion rates, SIP reliability, provisioning success, IVR containment, routing efficiency, call quality (MOS), queue abandonment, agent utilization, billing accuracy, platform availability and customer satisfaction (CSAT).
Develop and execute the long-term roadmap for enterprise telephony, AI-powered communications, multi-vendor architecture and next-generation voice experiences, ensuring HighLevel maintains competitive parity and platform leadership.

Requirement:

8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of communications, telecommunications, voice infrastructure, CPaaS, CCaaS or enterprise platform products.
Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, WebRTC, VoIP, IVR, enterprise telephony, and contact center ecosystems.
Proven experience building communications infrastructure or voice platform products at scale, including Automatic Call Distributor (ACD), intelligent routing and Call Center functionality.
Strong understanding of SIP endpoint management, HardPhone provisioning, remote device management, and telephony lifecycle management.
Experience working directly with CPaaS providers, telecom operators, hardware vendors, or communications infrastructure platforms.
Experience building multi-provider routing, abstraction layers, middleware, or API-first platform products.
Experience designing scalable multi-tenant platforms and highly available distributed systems serving enterprise customers.
Strong understanding of intelligent routing, least-cost routing (LCR), provider redundancy, failover mechanisms, and global telephony architecture.
Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience defining platform KPIs and using analytics to drive product strategy.
Demonstrated ability to define long-term platform strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.

Nice-to-Have:

Familiarity with SIP infrastructure technologies.
Experience building conversational AI, speech recognition, voice automation, AI-powered call routing or agent assist capabilities.
Familiarity with STIR/SHAKEN, CNAM, E911, number portability, hosted numbers (BYOC/BYON), and regulatory compliance across global telephony markets.
Experience building contact center (CCaaS) capabilities such as workforce management, quality monitoring, call recording, coaching, and supervisor tools.
Experience working with event-driven architectures, APIs, SDKs, and developer platforms for communications products.
Understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements for voice platforms, including GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or similar standards.

Core KPIs:

Voice Platform Reliability – SIP session success rate, call completion rate, provider failover success.
Call Center Efficiency – Queue Abandonment Rate, Average Handle Time (AHT), Agent Utilization.
HardPhone Provisioning – Device onboarding success rate, provisioning time, firmware deployment success.
IVR Performance – IVR containment rate, workflow completion, conversational AI adoption.
Routing Efficiency – Least-cost routing optimization, latency reduction, provider utilization.

Why Join HighLevel?

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team.

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs, and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate, and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation, intelligence, and customer operations into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity, and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily, with 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices, and over 1 million domain names supported. The architecture is built for performance, resilience, and long-term scalability.

Our people 

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact 

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads, and 20 million conversations for more than 1 million businesses. Behind those numbers are agencies, entrepreneurs, and SMBs building independence, expanding opportunity, and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Why This Role Exists 

Voice is one of the highest-intent customer interaction channels for SMBs. Missed calls, delayed follow-ups, poor qualification, inconsistent appointment booking, and manual outbound outreach directly translate into lost revenue for local businesses and agencies.

HighLevel’s VoiceAI product is designed to change that.

VoiceAI enables businesses to deploy AI-powered voice agents that can answer inbound calls, hold natural conversations, collect customer information, book appointments, trigger workflows, send post-call summaries, and support both phone-based and browser-based voice experiences. VoiceAI also supports outbound calling from workflows for use cases like lead follow-up, appointment outreach, prospect engagement, and reactivation campaigns.

The Staff Product Manager – VoiceAI will own the strategy, execution, and quality bar for one of HighLevel’s most important AI products. This role sits at the intersection of AI agents, telephony, CRM, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, compliance, analytics, and user experience.

You will be expected to deeply understand agencies, local businesses, call-heavy industries, and the real operational jobs that VoiceAI must perform: answer calls, qualify leads, route conversations, book appointments, follow up, summarize outcomes, and help businesses scale without adding headcount.

This is not a generic AI PM role. This is a hands-on, technically fluent, customer-obsessed product leadership role for someone who can build a reliable, scalable, commercially meaningful AI voice product inside a complex, high-volume SaaS platform.

Strategic Priorities 

Make VoiceAI the default AI receptionist for SMBs: Build a product that reliably handles inbound calls, understands caller intent, answers questions, captures lead information, books appointments, and escalates when needed. 
Scale outbound VoiceAI responsibly: Build workflow-driven outbound calling for lead follow-up, appointment reminders, reactivation, and prospect engagement while respecting platform limits, consent requirements, call quality, and compliance obligations. HighLevel’s current outbound VoiceAI supports workflow-based calls, up to 1,000 outbound VoiceAI calls per location per day, and time-zone-based scheduling between 8 AM and 8 PM based on the contact’s phone-number timezone. 
Improve agent setup and time-to-value: Simplify agent creation, phone number assignment, prompt configuration, knowledge base selection, working hours, call actions, testing, and deployment so agencies can launch high-quality VoiceAI agents for clients quickly. 
Drive call quality, reliability, and trust: Improve latency, interruption handling, speech recognition, natural conversation quality, escalation logic, call summaries, transcripts, recordings, and post-call workflows. 
Deepen CRM and workflow integration: Ensure VoiceAI can update contact records, trigger workflows, generate summaries, collect structured fields, and feed downstream automation. VoiceAI currently supports post-call workflow triggers, email notifications, call summaries, contact information, transcripts, and actions taken. 
Build VoiceAI as a platform capability: Advance public APIs, webhooks, call logs, agent configuration APIs, action APIs, voice catalog APIs, and developer-facing extensibility so agencies and developers can build repeatable voice agent solutions at scale. 
Support multilingual and brand-personalized voice experiences: Expand use cases across languages, voices, locales, and branded voice experiences. HighLevel VoiceAI supports multi-language configuration and a voice library, and voice cloning is currently available in Labs for creating on-brand custom voices. 
Own VoiceAI monetization and adoption: Work closely with Product Marketing, Support, Trial Experience, Implementation, Account Management, Affiliates, RevEx, and Finance to drive activation, usage, retention, packaging, and revenue for VoiceAI and AI Employee plans. VoiceAI is part of HighLevel’s AI pricing structure across pay-per-use, AI Employee Growth, and AI Employee Unlimited plans. 

Key Responsibilities 

Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for HighLevel VoiceAI. 
Own the full VoiceAI product surface, including inbound calling, outbound calling, web/widget voice experiences, agent setup, prompt configuration, voice selection, call actions, testing, analytics, call logs, summaries, transcripts, and workflow integrations. 
Deeply understand customer use cases across agencies, SMBs, and high-call-volume verticals such as home services, medical spas, fitness, legal, real estate, insurance, dental, automotive, and local professional services. 
Translate customer problems into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and measurable success metrics. 
Partner closely with engineering on telephony architecture, LLM behavior, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency, call routing, retries, failure handling, observability, and infrastructure scalability. 
Work with design to simplify VoiceAI setup, agent testing, debugging, prompt management, call review, and performance reporting. 
Build strong integrations between VoiceAI, Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Payments, Knowledge Base, Custom Values, and AI Employee. 
Improve the quality of AI agent behavior through better prompts, guardrails, prompt evaluation, knowledge retrieval, call simulations, QA workflows, and customer feedback loops. 
Define instrumentation across activation, agent creation, test calls, phone number assignment, first successful call, call completion rate, booking rate, human escalation rate, workflow trigger rate, outbound answer rate, transcript quality, cost per successful outcome, revenue, retention, and support ticket trends. 
Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, GTM, use-case packaging, launch readiness, help docs, enablement, and agency-facing education. 
Partner with Support, Implementation, Trial Experience, Account Management, and Affiliates to identify friction, improve onboarding, reduce ticket volume, and make VoiceAI easier to sell, configure, and support. 
Own compliance-sensitive product decisions around outbound calling, consent, KYC requirements, acceptable use, timezone restrictions, call recording,

About The Role

Join the Controls Technology division as a Technology Product Owner. In this critical role, you will act as the bridge between complex business needs and our engineering teams. You will be empowered to translate intricate requirements for risk and control systems into a flawlessly managed backlog of epics and user stories. Your primary mission is to drive the delivery of high-quality, compliant software by ensuring our development teams have the clarity and context needed to execute effectively, sprint after sprint. This is a role for a product owner — someone who thrives on execution, champions quality, and is passionate about building world-class technology solutions in a dynamic, global financial environment.

What You'll Do

Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution
Own and Master the Backlog: Meticulously create, refine, and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring it is transparent, well-understood, and always ready for at least two sprints ahead.
Translate Vision into Action: Deconstruct complex business requirements into well-defined Epics, User Stories, and precise Acceptance Criteria, ensuring a high percentage of stories are accepted without rework.
Drive Sprint Success: Serve as the dedicated point of contact for the engineering team, providing unwavering clarity during sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and throughout the development cycle to remove ambiguity.
Solution Definition & Quality Assurance
Define the "What": Partner with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document requirements, defining the precise solution to be built.
Champion Quality: Drive a quality-first mindset with a relentless focus on clear, testable acceptance criteria to minimize ambiguity and reduce critical defects in UAT.
Demonstrate Value: Conduct compelling demos of new functionalities to stakeholders, showcasing the value delivered and gathering immediate feedback for iterative improvement.
Track Performance: Track and report product performance post-launch to evaluate outcomes and support decisions around future investment.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Domain Leadership
Build Partnerships: Act as the key liaison between business users, engineering teams, UX and other technology partners, fostering a collaborative environment to ensure seamless delivery; seeking continuous input from stakeholders and incorporating it into the backlog.
Become the SME: Develop a deep expertise in your assigned Controls Technology modules, becoming the recognized go-to subject matter expert for the team and key stakeholders.
Facilitate with Purpose: Lead and actively contribute to all agile ceremonies, ensuring refinement and planning sessions are efficient, productive, and outcome focused.
Dependency & Risk Management: Identify and manage cross-team and cross-platform dependencies early in the delivery lifecycle. Proactively highlight delivery risks, data dependencies, and integration challenges, and work with stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
Communicate Clearly: Communicate priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery status clearly to stakeholders and leadership. Support informed decision-making by articulating trade-offs and impacts across teams and timelines.
Align on OKRs: Develop a culture of using OKRs to ensure team members align on the purpose of the work and cascade feedback related to risk and dependencies.
Innovation in Execution
Leverage AI Tools: Utilize cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, improve the quality of user story documentation, and enhance feature file generation.
Mitigate Risk Proactively: Identify and flag potential risks and dependencies that could impact schedule or quality, and work with leadership to drive mitigation strategies.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications:

Experience: 10+ years of experience in a technology-centric role within the financial services industry, including 5+ years as a dedicated, execution-focused Product Owner in an Agile/Scrum environment.
Domain Expertise: Proven background in Risk and Controls, Operational Risk, or Regulatory functions.
Agile Product Expertise: Deep, hands-on expertise in managing a product backlog, writing high-quality user stories, story maps, and leading agile ceremonies (knowledge of SAFe Agile is preferred).
Technical Fluency: A strong ability to understand technical concepts and engage in detailed discussions with engineering teams on feasibility and solutioning.
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of deliverables.
Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Finance). A management degree such as an MBA is a plus.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

Certifications: Industry-recognized certifications such as CSPO, A-CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or CBAP are highly desirable.
Tooling: Expert-level proficiency with agile management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
AI in Practice: Hands-on experience using AI tools within a software development lifecycle is a significant advantage.
Generative & Agentic AI Knowledge: Strong understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts and their applications in a product context.
AI-Driven Capabilities: Experience contributing to initiatives involving AI-enabled or data-driven capabilities, such as intelligent monitoring, automation, or insights generation.
AI Integration: Experience partnering with data, engineering, and platform teams to support integration of AI capabilities into risk and control platforms.
AI Governance: Familiarity with ensuring AI solutions align with risk, governance, and explainability expectations.

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.


What you'll do

1. E-commerce product management

  • Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
  • Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
  • Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
  • Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
  • Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
  • Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

2. Conversion rate optimization

CRO is a major part of this role.

  • Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
  • Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
  • Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
  • Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
  • Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

3. Data & analytics

  • Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
  • Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
  • Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
  • Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
  • Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

4. Customer research

  • Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
  • Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
  • Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
  • Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
  • Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

5. AI & new-age products

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

  • AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
  • AI artwork analysis and preflight
  • AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
  • AI-assisted quoting and configuration
  • AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
  • AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
  • AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
  • Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.

Senior Product Manager CollectIQ

About Us

Omega Healthcare Management Services® is an AI-driven healthcare solutions company that partners across the healthcare ecosystem to deliver breakthrough results by reimagining and elevating revenue operations.

With a global presence spanning four countries, our team of 30,000+ professionals collaborates with hospitals, physician groups and healthcare providers to streamline operations, improve financial performance and elevate patient care outcomes. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced technology and a customer-centric approach to deliver innovative, scalable healthcare support solutions.

About the Omega Digital Platform®

The Omega Digital Platform® is our agentic AI engine. It leverages adaptive intelligence to drive automation across the revenue cycle, complemented by deep human expertise, to optimise performance and deliver sustained financial and clinical outcomes.

The platform spans the revenue cycle end to end — patient access and eligibility at the front, documentation and coding integrity through the middle, and revenue recovery at the back — with a shared intelligence layer running beneath all three. Capability built once on the platform is available everywhere on it.

About CollectIQ

CollectIQ is the revenue recovery product of the Omega Digital Platform. It works the accounts receivable a provider has already earned but has not yet collected — denied, underpaid, unanswered and written-off claims.

Most denied revenue is recoverable, and most of it is never recovered. Not through poor execution, but because the cost of pursuing a claim frequently exceeds what it is expected to return. The binding constraint in back-end revenue cycle management is claim economics, not staff capacity. Adding people does not solve it; lowering the unit cost of a resolution does, because it makes previously unworkable inventory worth working.

CollectIQ is built on that premise. It is an orchestration product, not a workflow tool — and the distinction defines the work.

A workflow tool assumes the work is human, and exists to make a person faster at a task a person was always going to do. CollectIQ treats the human as one execution path among several — alongside autonomous agents, digital pathways, bots and voice — selected when the economics and the confidence support it. Every claim is assessed, valued, routed to the most efficient sufficient path, resolved, written back to the client system and reconciled, with outcomes feeding back to improve the next decision.

The product is delivered as AI plus human workforce: technology does the work wherever it can, and people take only what genuinely needs judgement. Because Omega performs this work at scale across a large provider base, CollectIQ learns from real resolution outcomes — an advantage very few organisations in this market are positioned to build.

Department: Product Management Group

Location: Hyderabad, India

You will own a product lane within CollectIQ — one or more categories of accounts receivable, taken from zero to one. You will define the problem, scope the solution, ship it with engineering, prove it at a client, and scale it. This is a builder's role, not a backlog-administration role.

  • Govern autonomy responsibly. Set confidence thresholds and escalation rules, design how overrides are captured, and expand automation on measured evidence rather than optimism.
  • Write requirements engineering can build from. PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria grounded in real claim scenarios, with clear definitions of done.
  • Define and instrument success metrics before the build. Own adoption, resolution quality, unit economics and business impact for your lane — and own building the measurement where it does not yet exist.
  • Partner across functions. Work with engineering, data science, operations, implementation and client-facing teams from discovery through go-live and iteration. Run the agile cadence your team needs.
  • Manage partner and vendor capabilities. Where we integrate rather than build, define the integration contract, the data terms and the performance bar.

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly driven, technically curious, and customer-obsessed Customer Success Product Manager to join our fast-growing team.

This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, and Solutions Engineering. You will work closely with customers to understand how they operate, help them get the most value from our platform, and translate their workflows, requirements, and feedback into actionable solutions for our Product and Engineering teams.

You will not simply answer customer questions. You will roll up your sleeves and use the product yourself, build AI-powered workflows, configure integrations, troubleshoot implementations, create demos, and work cross-functionally to turn customer needs into product improvements.

This is an ideal role for someone who is high-ownership, meticulous, technically curious, and comfortable figuring things out without having every step defined for them.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Success Onboarding
    • Respond to customer inquiries and requests quickly and professionally, removing blockers that may delay onboarding or product adoption.
    • Own customer requests from initial inquiry through resolution, ensuring clear follow-through and communication.
    • Build strong relationships with customers and develop a deep understanding of their businesses, workflows, goals, and pain points.
    • Proactively identify opportunities to improve customer adoption, engagement, and satisfaction.
    • Help customers understand and maximize the capabilities of the platform.
    • Identify opportunities to expand customer usage and recommend higher-tier plans or additional capabilities when appropriate.
  • Product Implementation Technical Solutions
    • Become an expert user of our Central products, including advanced functionality and integrations.
    • Build and configure workflows on behalf of customers.
    • Work with advanced capabilities such as:
      • AI prompting and prompt optimization
      • Webhooks
      • APIs and API connections
      • Zapier and other third-party integrations
      • Scripting and automation
      • Account and workflow configuration
      • AI-powered workflows and agents
    • Troubleshoot customer implementations and determine whether issues can be resolved through configuration, workflow changes, or product enhancements.
    • Experiment with new product capabilities and determine practical use cases for customers.
    • Create proof-of-concepts, demos, and customized solutions that showcase the platforms capabilities.
  • Customer-to-Product Feedback
    • Conduct calls and conversations with customers to understand their workflows, requirements, and desired outcomes.
    • Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories, specifications, and implementation details.
    • Work closely with Product and Engineering to communicate customer requirements and ensure solutions are accurately understood and implemented.
    • Help identify recurring customer pain points and opportunities for product improvements.
    • Participate in product discussions and provide customer-informed input into feature development and prioritization.
    • Follow up with customers and internal teams throughout the development and implementation process.
  • AI Product Enablement
    • Use AI tools to research, prototype, improve prompts, build workflows, and accelerate customer solutions.
    • Develop compelling product demos and examples tailored to specific customer use cases.
    • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, techniques, integrations, and product capabilities.
    • Stay current with developments in AI automation and identify opportunities to apply them to customer workflows.
    • Help create customer-facing guides, documentation, specifications, and other enablement materials.
  • Account Documentation Management
    • Modify and configure customer accounts within the platform as needed.
    • Manage the operational back-and-forth associated with customer documentation, including contracts, specifications, guides, requirements, and implementation materials.
    • Maintain accurate records of customer requirements, configurations, workflows, and outstanding items.
    • Ensure customer requests and commitments are properly documented and communicated to relevant internal teams.
  • Growth Expansion
    • Develop a deep understanding of each customers business and identify opportunities where additional product capabilities can create value.
    • Identify potential upsell and expansion opportunities and work with the appropriate teams to convert those opportunities.
    • Participate in customer expansion conversations and product demonstrations.
    • Commission opportunities may be available for qualified upsell and expansion activity.

Requirements

  • High ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Skills

  • Proof-of-concepts and demos
  • Customer onboarding

This role owns end-to-end product outcomes across strategy, roadmap, development, delivery, and adoption, working closely with Cordant product teams and, where needed, other Baker Hughes entities.
The role also has direct responsibility for a team of product managers and is accountable for shaping a cohesive product direction across multiple domains. The focus is on driving consistency, reuse, and scalability across the Baker Hughes ecosystem while enabling teams to move quickly without compromising quality or alignment.
 
Partner with the best
As a Cordant Applications Studio Product Manager, you will be responsible for:
  • Own end-to-end product outcomes across vision, roadmap, delivery, adoption, and measurable business impact for the Applications Studio portfolio.
  • Define a multi-quarter roadmap that balances foundational platform investments, reusable component expansion, AI-enabled workflows, and near-term product line needs.
  • Translate customer, developer, and business pain points into clear product bets, success metrics, and adoption goals, drawing on patterns from modern software creation platforms and industrial data platforms.
  • Partner with UX, Engineering, Architecture, and Data teams from concept through release to ensure capabilities are usable, scalable, secure, and production ready.
  • Drive planning, backlog prioritization, release planning, and execution rigor across multiple workstreams while maintaining focus on customer and developer outcomes.
  • Use rapid feedback loops, experimentation, and usage insights to iterate on platform capabilities and improve onboarding, activation, and adoption over time.
  • Apply strategic thinking and outcome orientation (turn vision into measurable adoption, reliability, performance, security and cost outcomes).
  • Put into practice your commercial mindset (packaging, pricing inputs, value realization and scaling adoption).
  • Influence without authority (align global, matrixed stakeholders and teams).
  • Showcase your platform/system thinking (design for reuse, extensibility, and ecosystem growth).
  • Lead with customer and partner focus (voice of customer, partner co-creation, and thought leadership).
  • Demonstrate strong people leadership and influence skills.
To be successful in this role you will:
  • Bachelor s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field.
  • Significant experience leading product management for applications, data, analytics, or platform products.
  • Proven ownership of platform-scale products that are used by multiple teams or customers.
  • Strong understanding of industrial applications, composable architectures, user experience and application enabling platforms.
  • Experience operating in complex, global, matrixed organizations.
  • Proven ability to lead teams and deliver end-to-end outcomes.
  • Understanding of industrial, energy, or asset-intensive domains.
  • Exposure to cloud-native and hybrid data architectures.
  • Experience with ecosystems, marketplaces or low-code platforms.
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

• Own one AI, ML, or computer-vision product end to end: problem, users, roadmap, release.
  • Set the KPI a release has to move, and hold the gate when it does not clear it.
  • Decide what ships, what waits, and what dies.


Working with engineering
  • Write specs that survive the codebase, the kind engineers trust.
  • Reason about architecture, cost, and latency well enough that no one can bluff you.
  • Prototype your own ideas with AI tools instead of delegating every question.


The hard part, the part most product managers dodge
  • Design for the failure mode, not just the demo: the edge cases, the false positives, the long tail, the last twenty percent.
  • Ship against evals and real numbers, not a spec that is either met or not.
  • Build the guardrails and the fallback that turn a demo into something an enterprise will actually run.


Outcomes, not output
  • Tie the work to a number the business actually feels.
  • Turn what works once into something repeatable.
  • Say plainly what is on track and what is slipping, every week.


This role is not for you if
  • You need the product handed to you before you can care about it.
  • You think generative AI is the whole of AI.
  • You count features shipped instead of the number you moved.
  • You go quiet at eighty percent instead of owning the last twenty.
  • You need a title to feel credible, or you think a title is enough.
  • You want predictable, low-stakes, roadmap-and-standups work.


How to apply
  • Apply through the steps that follow. The questions are built to surface how you think and what you have built, not how well you polish a resume. AI-written answers are obvious, and they are rejected.
  • Everything you write, we will dig into if we talk.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the company position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
  • Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
  • Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
  • Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

    • Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
    • In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (eg, ITC, state rebates).

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

Where you'll leave your mark?

How we care for our Sprinters?

Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
