Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.

The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor

This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.

At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.

Core Responsibilities

The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.

Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context. 
Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team. 
Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions. 
Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams. 
Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform. 
Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals. 
Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch. 
Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals. 
Strategic Communication
Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization. 
Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value. 
Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process. 

What You'll Bring: Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms. 
Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment. 
Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers. 
Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy. 
Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

Our CRAFT

CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.

C — Customer trust. Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.

R — Relentless on outcomes. We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.

A — Authenticity. We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.

F — First principles, grounded in reality. We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.

T — Transparency. We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

Product Manager — Digital Platform & Engineering
Location: Noida
Experience: 3–4 years in product management
Team: Digital Platform & Engineering (DPE)

Who we are
Over the past 17 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world-class multi-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cyber City & Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta continues to expand its healthcare ecosystem through diagnostics, pharmacies, homecare services and digital health initiatives.
Digital Platform & Engineering (DPE) is Medanta's newly built product and technology organization. Modelled on India's leading internet companies, DPE brings together product managers, designers and engineers to build the products and platforms that power patient journeys, clinical care and hospital operations across the Medanta network. We work from our own office in Noida, with strong sponsorship from the CEO and the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Product Manager who can take a messy, real-world problem — on a hospital floor, at a billing counter, or in a patient's phone — define it sharply, and ship products that measurably improve how patients experience care and how clinicians deliver it.
You will be one of the early product managers in DPE, working closely with the Chief Digital Officer, engineering leadership and some of India's most eminent clinicians. The role combines the product craft of a top internet company with the rigour healthcare demands: here, a missed requirement is not just a bug — it can affect a patient's care.

What You Will Work On
Seamless patient journeys — across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care, from finding the right doctor and booking a visit to diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow-up.
Products that empower clinicians and caregivers — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads, and gives them time back for patient care.
Platform-first foundations — reusable capabilities such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
Voice-first, touch-first and AI-first experiences — products built around how people naturally interact: speaking instead of typing, tapping instead of filling forms, and intelligence that assists at every step.
A Hospital Information System built from scratch — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow, designed for how care is delivered today.
Intelligence across the hospital — AI for triage, clinical decision support, clinical documentation, and planning of beds, operating theatres and resources.
Care beyond the hospital walls — home care, remote monitoring and connected care that extend Medanta's expertise to wherever patients are.

Key Responsibilities
Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap and end-to-end lifecycle for one or more products or platforms — from discovery through launch, adoption and scale.
Lead product discovery on the ground: spend time with clinicians, nurses, front-office teams and patients to deeply understand workflows and pain points before defining what to build.
Partner with senior doctors and business leaders to understand the need behind every request, evaluate the proposed solution alongside alternatives, and align on the approach that best serves patients and the organization.
Take a platform-first view: identify common patterns across products and requests, and build reusable capabilities that scale across the network.
Translate problems into clear PRDs, user journeys and acceptance criteria; work with design and engineering to deliver intuitive voice-first, touch-first and AI-first experiences.
Use AI tools to accelerate product work — research, specifications, prototyping and analysis.
Ensure launches are complete for critical workflows, so users can rely on new products fully from day one.
Embed patient safety, data privacy and regulatory requirements (such as NABH, JCI, DPDP and ABDM) into product design from the start.
Drive adoption with operations, nursing and clinical teams, and treat user feedback as a core input to the roadmap.
Define clear success metrics for every product — adoption, turnaround time, conversion, clinician time saved, patient outcomes — and use them to continuously improve the product through regular reviews, experimentation and iteration.
Prioritize with clarity and communicate trade-offs, progress and impact transparently to stakeholders and leadership.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Must have
3–4 years of product management experience in internet product companies (e.g., e-commerce, fintech, healthtech, edtech, marketplaces or consumer platforms).
A track record of shipping and scaling products with large user bases and measurable business or user impact.
Strong first-principles problem definition, and comfort working through ambiguity.
Data-driven decision making — comfortable with funnels, analytics tools, SQL and experimentation.
Platform thinking — the ability to spot common patterns across problems and design reusable capabilities rather than one-off features.
Enough technical depth to engage engineers on architecture, APIs, integrations and data trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to partner with and build alignment among senior, expert stakeholders.
Hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product work.
Willingness to spend meaningful time in hospital environments, observing workflows and working alongside clinical and operations teams.
High ownership, a bias for both rigour and speed, strong user-experience instincts, and genuine empathy for end users.
Good to have
Hands-on software development experience before moving into product management.
Experience building platform or API products — payments, subscriptions, integrations or developer-facing capabilities.
Experience with voice or conversational interfaces, AI/LLM-based products, or complex, workflow-heavy systems (e.g., ERP, supply chain, fulfilment or clinical systems).
Exposure to healthcare, diagnostics or other regulated domains (not mandatory — strong product fundamentals matter more than domain background).

Education
B.Tech / B.E. from a top-tier institution (IITs, NITs, BITS, IIITs or equivalent).
MBA from a top-tier institution (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS or equivalent) preferred.

Why Join Us
A rare chance to build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice-first and AI-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
Work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians and learn how world-class care is delivered.
A tech-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open-door leadership.
Direct exposure to the CEO and senior leadership, who are closely involved in building this team.
Help shape how product management is practised in a newly built product organization, and grow with it.
The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. Organization OverviewCompany Description

QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.

Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform — is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.

Job Description

This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.

As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting & Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI-ready at enterprise scale.

This is a high-visibility, high-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.

The Opportunity

The Foundation Exists — The Mandate Now Is To Build ERA's Intelligence Core Into The Definitive Manufacturing Ontology Platform. You Will Have The Scope To

Define and own the manufacturing semantic layer — encoding supplier criticality, lead time patterns, quality thresholds, and operational constraints in a form AI agents can reason from
Build the contextual intelligence layer that passes metric definitions, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, anomaly-aware narrative generation
Drive QAD's conversational analytics strategy — enabling non-technical manufacturing users to query operations in natural language without SQL or BI expertise
Establish the AI evaluation framework that governs quality, accuracy, and latency of every AI-generated insight shipped to enterprise customers
Evolve the platform from reactive reporting to proactive, agentic intelligence — where the system surfaces recommended actions, not just data

Key Responsibilities

Platform Strategy & Roadmap

Own the multi-year product roadmap for ERA's Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer — from raw data pipeline to user-facing AI insights
Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from
Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis

AI & Conversational Analytics

Drive the conversational analytics product — ontology design, knowledge graph, context graph, and intent detection for natural language querying
Establish and own the AI evaluation framework: latency, accuracy, relevancy gates, LLM-as-judge, and human-in-the-loop oversight
Architect the contextual layer that passes metadata, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, enterprise-grade output
Define QAD's approach to agentic AI — moving from reactive Q&A to proactive, action-triggering intelligence within ERP workflows

Enterprise Self-Service Reporting

Own the product strategy for self-service report building — enabling business users across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, and operations to create, customise, and share reports without engineering dependency
Define the RBAC model for reporting: row-level and column-level access controls, report sharing permissions, data scoping by plant, region, and business unit — ensuring enterprise customers can safely deploy self-service capabilities across large, complex org structures
Lead the go-to-market and rollout strategy for self-service reporting across B2B industry verticals — working with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to drive adoption, define onboarding playbooks, and reduce time-to-value for enterprise deployments
Set the product bar for enterprise-grade report authoring: scheduling, export, embedding, white-labelling, and audit trails that meet the compliance and operational needs of regulated industries
Establish feedback loops with enterprise customers to continuously refine the self-service experience — tracking adoption metrics, identifying capability gaps, and prioritising the roadmap against real user workflows

Data Infrastructure & Intelligence

Partner with Engineering to define the data lake, pipeline, and event architecture that underpins ERA's intelligence layer — optimising for AI-readiness, scale, and cost efficiency
Own the metric registry and semantic data model — ensuring consistent, governed definitions of manufacturing KPIs across all ERA consumers
Collaborate with the Governance & Compliance pillar to ensure intelligence outputs meet enterprise compliance requirements; own the data quality and freshness standards within your layer
Define monetization strategy for intelligence platform capabilities including governed data exports, delta sharing, and partner integrations

GTM, Sales & Market Enablement

Act as the product authority for Sales and Marketing on ERA's Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities — providing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation across the full intelligence layer, not just reporting
Partner with GTM teams to develop selling motions for AI Insights, conversational analytics, and self-service reporting — translating platform capabilities into clear business value narratives for manufacturing buyers
Build and maintain sales enablement assets: demo environments, capability decks, objection-handling guides, and ROI frameworks that equip field teams to position the intelligence layer confidently
Engage with Marketing on thought leadership, analyst relations, and campaign strategy — ensuring QAD's AI and analytics narrative reflects the depth and differentiation of what the platform can actually deliver
Work with Solutions Engineering and Pre-Sales on complex enterprise deals — providing product depth in discovery, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements where the intelligence layer is a key differentiator

Customer Discovery & UX Partnership

Maintain a structured and continuous customer discovery programme — conducting regular interviews, site visits, and advisory sessions with manufacturing customers across segments and geographies

Job Overview

LPL Financial is seeking a Data Product Analyst to support our Strategic Data Platforms, with a strong focus on how data is produced, shaped, governed, and delivered to downstream consumers across the firm. 

This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Data Product Ownership, and Advanced Analysis, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can bring rigor and clarity to complex, data‑centric platform initiatives. 

The Data Product Analyst focuses on data as a product—helping define data contracts, validate quality, assess downstream impact, and support data product and platform decisions. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across upstream systems of record, platform services, and downstream consumers, and excels at turning complex data flows into actionable insights and decisions.

Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Capability Support 

Support product discovery by helping translate business and platform needs into clear data‑centric problem statements. 
Contribute to roadmap planning by evaluating value, risk, and complexity across data initiatives. 
Help define outcomes and success measures for data platform capabilities (e.g., usability, reliability, adoption, quality). 

Advanced Data Analysis & Problem Solving 

Perform hands‑on exploratory and diagnostic analysis across distributed data sources and platforms. 
Investigate data quality issues, lineage gaps, and semantic inconsistencies that affect downstream consumers. 
Conduct impact analysis for schema changes, new feeds, platform migrations, or system decommissions. 
Identify systemic issues in data flow, transformation, or consumption and recommend durable solutions. 

Data Product Ownership (Supporting / Platform‑Level) 

Support Data Product Owners by helping define: 
Data contracts, schemas, and semantic definitions 
Data quality rules, validation logic, and controls

Overview

The Disputes Solutions team is seeking a Director, Product Owner to help define and execute Mastercard's vision for the future of dispute management. This leader will own strategic areas of Mastercard's next-generation disputes platform and be responsible for shaping the capabilities, experiences, and operating model that will power the future of dispute resolution across the global payments ecosystem.

Based in Dublin, this role will be embedded alongside product, engineering, architecture, data science, and design teams within co-located development pods. The successful candidate will act as a senior product leader, partnering with executives, regional stakeholders, customers, and technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and drive execution of platform capabilities at scale.

This individual will play a critical leadership role in driving Mastercard's AI strategy within the disputes organization, identifying opportunities to embed intelligence, automation, predictive decisioning, and generative AI throughout the customer and operational experience. The role will help establish AI-first ways of working across product and engineering pods while ensuring capabilities align with Mastercard's strategic priorities and customer needs.

Role

As a Director, Product Owner, You Will

Collaborate directly with customers, partners, and regional stakeholders to understand emerging needs, market trends, and competitive opportunities.
Influence investment planning and strategic portfolio decisions through data-driven business cases and outcome-based prioritization.
Present roadmap decisions, strategy updates, and investment recommendations to senior executives and business leaders.
Act as a thought leader and coach across product teams, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, customer centricity, and continuous improvement.


All About You

The ideal candidate for this position should:

Demonstrate deep expertise in product strategy, product ownership, and platform development.
Possess a proven ability to define and execute product visions that span multiple products, teams, and stakeholder groups.
Have exceptional leadership skills and the ability to influence outcomes across large, matrixed organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Success Measures

The Successful Candidate Will

Deliver innovative product capabilities that strengthen Mastercard's market leadership and customer value proposition.
Successfully scale AI-enabled capabilities across products, teams, and customer experiences.
Drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, automation, and platform adoption.
Create strong alignment between Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, and Business stakeholders.

PURPOSE


The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, commercial performance, and success of Evenica's eCommerce platform.

This role focuses on understanding customer and market needs, defining what the platform should do and why, and prioritizing work that delivers the greatest customer and business value.


The Senior Product Manager will take ownership of an established product and platform, understand its existing capabilities, customers, roadmap, and processes, and help define its next stage of growth. The expectation is not simply to continue with what is already established, but to evaluate existing approaches, strengthen product practices where required, and establish a clear product direction based on customer, market, commercial, and business needs.


The Senior Product Manager partners closely with Engineering leadership, who own how the platform is built, and with Project Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and leadership to ensure the platform's direction supports Evenica's growth objectives.


EXPECTED OUTCOMES AND DELIVERABLES


Own the Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own and evolve the product strategy and roadmap for the eCommerce platform, keeping it aligned with company goals, customer needs, and market opportunities.
  • Understand the existing platform and roadmap and identify where product direction, processes, governance, or priorities should evolve.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on business goals, customer needs, commercial impact, market opportunity, and the competitive landscape.
  • Translate company strategy into clear product themes, initiatives, and measurable goals.
  • Establish and improve product prioritization frameworks and decision-making processes where required.
  • Present the roadmap, priorities, trade-offs, and reasoning behind decisions to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Own Product Commercial Performance and P&L

Lead Product Discovery and Define What Gets Built

Manage Stakeholders and Product Priorities

DESCRIPTION

The Outbound and Flow team within Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) is looking for an experienced Product Manager (Technical) to own the vision and strategy for Routing and Mansort products, based out of Bangalore. Our team provides the products and services responsible for outbound fulfillment — ingesting shipments from upstream systems (SCOT) and processing them through picking, packing, and shipping. Our vision is to improve customer experience — Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), Speed, Quality, and Cost — while improving associate safety and simplifying our operations. We do so by building products that are highly reliable, resilient, self-healing, scalable, extensible, and designed from the start with a focus on the safety and accessibility of our workforce.
As a Product Manager (Technical) — L6 for Routing and Mansort, you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap that optimizes how units and packages are routed through the fulfillment center and how manual sortation (Mansort) operations are streamlined for throughput, quality, and cost. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group, and develop and maintain product roadmaps and features grounded in team strategy. This role is inherently cross-functional — you will work closely with engineering, science, operations, and business teams across geographies to launch features and build the tools and mechanisms that scale Routing and Mansort worldwide.
A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high-quality, simple products, features, and applications. You will identify opportunities to make FC operations more efficient, and drive the design and development of software features to address them — leveraging and expanding current initiatives in Primitives and GenAI across the organization.

Key job responsibilities
- Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap priorities by working backward from customer needs, conducting research, analyzing usage data and market trends, and translating insights into clear problem statements and requirements.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, and operations partners to deliver products on time and with high quality, aligning stakeholders and making smart trade-offs when data is incomplete.
- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept through launch and beyond, including defining success criteria and key performance indicators, monitoring operational health, and iterating based on performance metrics and customer feedback.
- Evaluate technical proposals and participate in architecture discussions, understanding how technical choices influence customer outcomes and balancing feature delivery with long-term system health and scalability.
- Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, improve decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for product innovation.

About the team
AFT owns and operates the AFT Warehouse Management System (WMS) and select hardware — these technologies automate, orchestrate, and direct fulfillment in Amazon Robotics sort and non-sort buildings, traditional sort and non-sort buildings, IXDs, Fresh, Pantry, and Quick Deploy sites. AFT also owns and operates the FaaST WMS that runs in Vendor Flex buildings, India Mini-FCs (small footprint, manual buildings in IN), and select Seller Flex locations (3P Sellers who are Prime-enabled leveraging the FaaST WMS). AFT also owns the External Fulfillment Platform (EFP), which integrates 3P WMSes to the Amazon Supply Chain. AFT owns network infrastructure and devices in all building types including Sort Centers and Last Mile sites, and owns labor planning and scheduling technology leveraged for Fulfillment Centers in NA and EU and Sort Centers in NA.

AFT General Summary
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon's global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Bachelor's degree

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Overview

ABOUT JAGGAER

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.

Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com

JAGGAER is an AI-powered procure to pay and source to pay software solutions platform for manufacturing, public sector and higher education.

Job Title: Product Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

Reports To: Director of Product Management, JAI

Type: Full-Time

About The Role

This role owns JAGGAER's analytics and data products: the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the next generation of data products we build for customers. These are established, revenue-generating capabilities with live commitments across the customer base, and they are being reshaped by AI faster than any other part of the platform.

The mandate is to define and deliver what those products become in an AI-first platform. That means insight that finds the customer rather than waiting to be asked for, including generated insight and anomaly detection across their spend. It means data products built for a customer's own systems and agents to consume, not only for a person to read. And it means owning the trust layer underneath all of it, so that the answers our AI produces are accurate enough to put in front of a procurement executive.

You will work across the JAI portfolio, because the data and intelligence layer you own is what every agent and research capability in the product reasons over.

This is a strategy and delivery role in a single seat. You will set the direction, and you will be measured on what ships against it.

Principal Responsibilities

Product ownership: Own the strategy, roadmap and delivery for the analytics and business intelligence suite, Bulk Data Export, and the data products built on them. 
AI-native insight capabilities: Define and deliver new AI capabilities in this space, including generated insight and anomaly detection across customer spend, taking them from concept through early access to general availability. 
Product direction: Define what analytics and data products become as AI absorbs them, including how customers consume data when their own systems and agents are the consumer rather than a person, and where the boundary sits between surfacing an insight and acting on it. Establish the product direction for agent-ready data delivery. 
Data trust and accuracy: Own the quality bar for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over: the definitions of core procurement measures, the evaluation approach that proves accuracy, and the standard a model must meet before it is used with a customer. 
Committed delivery: Meet the existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments already sold to customers, including those carried in active RFPs and renewals, and keep the install base on a clear roadmap. 
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, applied AI, UX, and the Experience, AgentOS and Deep Research product managers, so the data and intelligence layer serves the whole JAI portfolio rather than one surface. 
Market and customer insight: Validate problems and proposed capabilities directly with customers and prospects, and use that evidence to prioritise. Support analytics and data content in RFPs and executive briefings. 
Agile execution: Translate product requirements into clear, well-defined requirements and acceptance criteria for the engineering teams, and work with them through delivery. 
Metrics and performance: Define and report the KPIs for this scope, including adoption of the AI insight surfaces, accuracy against the evaluation set, and delivery against customer commitments. 

Position Requirements

What You Will Bring

3+ years of product management experience in SaaS or enterprise software, including ownership of a product area end to end. 
Hands-on experience with AI products, including LLM-powered applications, prompt engineering, retrieval architectures, or applying AI to structured enterprise data. 
Strong working understanding of data platforms, semantic and dimensional modelling, and analytics or BI tooling. Snowflake experience is an advantage. 
A rigorous approach to accuracy: comfort defining ground truth, designing evaluation sets, and holding a quality bar under delivery pressure. 
Experience working with enterprise customers to validate problems and quantify value, rather than gathering feature requests. 
Experience with procurement, source-to-pay, supply chain or finance data is an advantage. 
Proficiency in Agile methodologies and working closely with distributed engineering teams. 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. 

Success in This Position

An outcome focus, with customer value always in mind. 
Comfortable saying no to a capability that has not met the accuracy bar, and able to explain that decision commercially to sales and to customers. 
Able to hold both a multi-year product direction and a current-quarter delivery commitment without losing either. 
Strong written and verbal communication in English, and credible with both engineering and business leadership. 
Effective at influencing without authority across product, engineering and go-to-market teams. 
Accustomed to working in an international environment across multiple development sites and time zones. 

Goals for the First 12 Months

An agreed product direction for analytics and data products in an AI-first platform, signed off with Product and Engineering leadership and reflected in the roadmap. 
Generated insight and anomaly detection delivered to early access customers, with adoption and accuracy reported as the primary measures of success. 
A published quality and evaluation standard for the data and semantic models our AI reasons over, with accuracy tracked and reported. 
All existing analytics, reporting and data export commitments met, with a clear and communicated roadmap for the install base. 
Customer validation of the new AI capabilities in this space, with quantified outcomes suitable for use in renewals and new business. 

What We Offer

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. 

Our Values - T.E.A.M 

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies. 

Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.

Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth 

Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere

Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

Principal Product Manager, APAC Payments Scheme Integrations

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. We need someone to help us move money seamlessly in APAC.

We process hundreds of millions of payments for our customers per year. When Wise started we used banks to power our payments. But as we’ve grown we’ve started connecting directly to national payment schemes such as Australia’s NPP, Singapore’s FAST, Philippines' InstaPay, and Japan’s Zengin.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead our efforts in integrating and optimising national payment scheme integrations across the APAC region. This role will focus on expanding Wise’s reach through new payment scheme integrations while continuously improving the performance of existing scheme integrations.

What You’ll Do

Understand customer needs: Build an understanding of how payment schemes impact our customers, and use this understanding to drive product decisions. 
Determine the strategy for Wise’s payment scheme integrations: Work with internal teams, regulators, and payment scheme operators in order to build a multi-year roadmap of which payment scheme functionality Wise should be connected to. Lobby for changes to payment schemes to make our customers' lives better.
Lead payment scheme integrations: Alongside engineering leads, you’ll be managing technical integrations with payment schemes. This will include working with multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring strong project management is in place, identifying risks and opportunities early and adapting to them.
Monitor and optimise: Use data to track the performance of integrations and drive continuous improvement.
Drive operational excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the scheme integration.

Qualifications

Significant product management experience in payments, ideally in finance/fintech.
8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles. 
For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role
A knack for project management: This is not a project manager role, but payment scheme integrations have many moving parts and you will be accountable for the team’s success.
Analytical mindset: Ability to use data to make informed decisions and track performance metrics.
Customer focus: A passion for building products that solve real customer problems.
A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.

Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,

Experience working with payment scheme integrations
Experience in fintech or a high-growth tech company.
The ability to write SQL
Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

About the RoleWe're looking for a Product Manager who deeply understands how acquirer

systems work end to end — not just at the application/UI level, but across the backend

processing stack. You'll own the product lifecycle for our acquiring platform, working

closely with engineering, compliance, risk, and merchant/partner teams to build and evolve

systems that handle real money movement at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Own the product roadmap across the full acquiring stack — merchant onboarding,

authorization, transaction processing, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and

chargebacks/disputes.

Get into the technical weeds: understand message flows (ISO 8583/20022),

switch/routing logic, ledger and settlement engines, and how transactions move

between merchant, acquirer, network, and issuer.

Own and drive requirements around clearing file generation — including Base II

(Visa) clearing files and Mastercard, Amex clearing files — with a solid grasp of file

structures, record types, and data elements within these scheme files.

Translate scheme (Visa/Mastercard/RuPay etc.), network, and regulatory

requirements into detailed backend and system-level product specs.

Partner closely with engineering on system architecture decisions — not just feature

requests — for authorization, capture, clearing, settlement, and refund flows.

Work with risk and compliance teams on underwriting, fraud, and dispute

management workflows, understanding the backend systems that power them.

Define and track product/system metrics — approval rates, settlement TAT,

reconciliation breaks, dispute ratios, system latency and uptime.

Manage relationships with card networks, banking partners, and processors, including

technical/integration discussions on clearing and settlement file exchange.

Requirements

4–8 years of Product Management experience with genuine end-to-end exposure to

acquirer systems — able to speak fluently about both the merchant-facing product and

what happens underneath it (switching, ledgers, clearing, settlement, reconciliation).

Strong knowledge of Visa and Mastercard clearing and settlement files from the

acquirer side, including Base II clearing file generation and Mastercard clearing file

Strong working knowledge of payment message flows and protocols (ISO

integrate with networks and issuers.

Comfortable reading system/API specs and scheme file specifications, and discussing

facing PM role.

clearing, and reconciliation issues.

Excellent stakeholder management across technical and non-technical teams.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting or reconciling Base II / Mastercard clearing file

mismatches or settlement breaks.

Nice to Have

Prior experience at a payment aggregator, acquirer, or acquiring bank in a role with

direct exposure to backend clearing/settlement processing systems.

Exposure to international payment schemes and cross-border settlement.
Background in engineering or systems design before moving into product.

Director of Product
AI Cloud and Orchestration, Velocis Platform
Reports to Chief Product Officer
Location Mumbai
Function Product Leadership, AI Infrastructure (Velocis)

Why this role, why now?
Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.
Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.

The Role
We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go-to-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.
You will move between whiteboarding high-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.

What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap
• Co-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off end to end.
• Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day-0 and Day-1 user journey.
• Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.

Team and craft
• Lead, mentor and hold accountable a team of four or more product managers across the core Velocis modules.
• Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.
• Coach high-potential talent and step in where a track needs lift.
Enterprise commercials and offtake
• Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.
• Act as executive product sponsor for key Indian enterprise accounts.
• Turn bespoke offtake and enterprise requirements into platform capabilities the wider base can use, without fragmenting the core codebase. This is one of the hardest and most important parts of the role.
Platform economics
• Own core product economics with the CPO, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin, tenant density and feature monetisation.
• Treat onboarding time to value and expansion as first-order outcomes, since Velocis revenue behaves as consumption rather than subscription and expansion is the dominant growth lever.

What you bring?
• Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large-scale cloud or general-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.
• A track record of shipping complex B2B infrastructure products from concept to meaningful revenue scale.
• Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.
• Working command of multi-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air-gapped clusters and customer-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.
• Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.

How you work?
• You zoom out to market positioning and a two-year horizon, and zoom in to specifications, telemetry and the granular detail, without losing either.
• You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.
• You are a low-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.
• You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.

Your first 90 days
• Take full ownership of the roadmap and prioritisation across the PM tracks, with clear ownership lines in place.
• Land the near-term Velocis milestones with clean telemetry on adoption and stability.
• Establish a working rhythm with engineering, operations and go-to-market that delivers predictably.

Success in the first 6 to 12 months
• Roadmap predictability and release velocity, with the Velocis milestones shipped and instrumented for adoption and reliability.
• Movement on the economics you own, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin and tenant density.
• Time to production for offtake customers and time to value in onboarding, both trending down.
• Expansion on named enterprise and offtake accounts.
• A high-functioning product team with clear ownership and a rising bar.

CORPORATE PLANNING & MANAGEMENT

Corporate Planning & Management (CPM) is a central strategic function at Goldman Sachs, responsible for driving firmwide operational excellence, business planning, and the infrastructure that enables the firm to operate with strength, resiliency, and agility. Within Spend Management, the Source to Pay function encompasses Strategic Sourcing, Procure to Pay, Integrated Travel and Expense, Infrastructure and Transformation, and Sustainable Operations — managing all aspects of the firm's spend with third parties, advising on commercial agreements, and driving operating efficiency.

SOURCE TO PAY –PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

Within CPM, the Source to Pay function oversees the end-to-end lifecycle of procurement and payables — from sourcing and vendor management through purchasing, invoicing, and payment. The Global Procurement team is focused on optimizing the procurement experience for internal firmwide stakeholders, Goldman Sachs suppliers, and Global Procurement operations teams — driving customer experience excellence, enabling frictionless interactions across the procurement lifecycle, and delivering scalable solutions anchored in the SAP Ariba platform ecosystem.

Administer and optimize SAP Ariba across Sourcing, Buying & Invoicing, SLP, and the Ariba Network, ensuring configurations support Source to Pay priorities, control requirements, and consistent user experience.

Govern critical master and reference data, including supplier records, commodity codes, ship-to and bill-to data, approval rules, and configuration dependencies that enable reliable transaction processing.

Good understanding of Ariba core processes and Accounts Payable / procure-to-pay workflows involving vendor invoicing, payment, and general ledger postings.

Demonstrated experience working within complex technical ecosystems, including enterprise platforms and vendor integrations. Strong analytical skills and the ability to summarize and present information at a management level.

Job Summary

Senior Product Manager - GP Client Experience (ADI)

Hyderabad, India

Hybrid

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the GP and client experience within ADI the experiences our fund-manager clients use to run and monitor their business: the client operations centre where they track the progress of their work, their dashboards and reporting, and the client portal. You will own the roadmap and the end-to-end product management for this stream. The first use cases go live in October 2026; your job is to build on them and own the future roadmap that takes the GP experience to its full vision.

You will translate the reality of fund administration across private equity, private credit and real assets into a clear, consolidated, self-service experience, turning information that today lives in many places into a single, trustworthy view for clients. You will work hands-on: authoring executable PRDs and building the first prototypes yourself, then partnering with engineering, design and client-delivery teams to bring them to production.

Your Responsibilities

Product strategy roadmap

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the GP client experience including the future roadmap well beyond the first use cases and converge the platform toward its full product vision.

The GP experience

  • Own the client operations centre (where clients monitor the progress of their tasks), the client dashboards and reporting experience, and the client portal defining the journeys, information design and self-service capabilities.
  • Define the single one-lens view across funds and asset classes bringing valuations, capital calls and distributions, portfolio monitoring, and fund and investor reporting into one coherent client experience.

Domain data

  • Understand how client-facing information valuations, cash flows, positions and reporting is produced across the fund-accounting, portfolio and reporting estate, and ensure it reaches clients as a single, trustworthy view.
  • Work with data and platform teams to define what information the experience needs and where it is sourced, and manage the move from legacy portals so that no client is left behind.

Building AI-Native how we work

  • Author Executable PRDs (xPRDs) structured context repositories that combine natural-language intent, machine-actionable specification, complete business and technical context, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria, and embedded governance guardrails.
  • Build the first functional prototype yourself during ideation and discovery, using AI tooling to validate desirability (product-market fit with clients) and feasibility (with architects) in parallel then hand a high-fidelity, context-rich prototype to engineering to curate and take to production quality.
  • Own the non-functional requirements performance, availability, scalability, security and accessibility from day one, treating them as first-class product requirements rather than an afterthought.
  • Work within an enhanced design-thinking approach with governance embedded from day one ethical AI and user rights, privacy, security, risk and compliance, and audit/traceability alongside explicit attention to data readiness (maturity, availability and quality).

Delivery cross-functional

  • Act as product lead across the relevant delivery teams; partner with technology and architecture on delivery, and with client-delivery and commercial teams on adoption and client engagement.

Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Proven senior product management experience delivering client-facing B2B software, portals or data/reporting products with measurable customer and commercial impact.
  • Demonstrated ability to work AI-native authoring structured, executable PRDs and building functional prototypes with AI tooling.
  • Strong experience with dashboards, reporting and data-visualisation products, and a sharp instinct for information design and self-service experience.
  • Excellent prioritisation, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity from ambiguity.

Desirable

  • Domain experience in fund administration, asset servicing or alternatives (private equity, private credit, real assets).
  • Familiarity with the fund-accounting, portfolio and reporting systems that produce client information (such as Investran, eFront, Yardi, Solvas and ReportPro).
  • Experience in agile, multi-team delivery and large product platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Outcome-driven and client-centric, keeping the client journey at the centre of every decision.
  • Hands-on and comfortable prototyping; happy to build, not just specify.
  • Collaborative and influential across product, technology, design, operations and commercial teams.

jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Principal Product Manager – Agentic/AI Data Collection
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

 Your Team's Impact

The Senior Principal Product Manager is a seasoned product professional responsible for high-impact, high-visibility internal platforms. Senior Principal Product Managers engage with internal stakeholders and process owners to find the right problems to solve, define what success looks like, and guide their team to deliver successful outcomes. They identify solutions that are valuable to internal users, viable for the business, feasible to build, and usable.

Senior Principal Product Managers typically coordinate several agile delivery teams on large and strategically important products. They are responsible for driving all aspects of the product development lifecycle — from insight-driven discovery and strategy to defining success metrics, planning, execution, and continuously optimizing to deliver value.

The Senior Principal PM has a product portfolio mindset and is always looking to direct resources toward the most valuable problems to solve. They take on an increasingly visible role in advocating for product management best practices — in this role, applied to building and scaling an AI/Agentic-native data collection pipeline and driving its adoption across all data collection processes.

 What You'll Do

30% Insights – Derives insights to support product bets

Understands the dynamics of internal data collection processes, the roles and responsibilities of the teams that depend on them, and how AI/Agentic techniques are evolving in data extraction and collection. Builds this understanding through regular, direct research and engagement with internal stakeholders and process owners across data collection.
Responsible for product discovery for the data collection pipeline. Proactively identifies opportunities across existing data collection processes and validates that a given solution is valuable, viable, feasible, and usable before it is developed — including evaluating build-vs-buy and where AI/Agentic techniques materially improve accuracy or efficiency.
Uses data to evaluate and inform strategy and decision making, including performance under increasing data volume and internal user demand.
Measures what matters: product success metrics (internal engagement, adoption across data collection processes, stickiness, extraction accuracy, coverage) as well as financial metrics (support costs, cloud/compute costs).

30% Strategy – Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results

Defines product strategy — vision, value proposition, and roadmap — for the AI/Agentic data collection pipeline, in the context of departmental strategy, overall company strategy, and relevant firm type strategies.
Evangelizes the product strategy across the business unit, including how the pipeline supports downstream document and data lifecycle capabilities.
Responsible for product business case development (investment needs, resourcing, KPIs) to take the product from POC/prototype to a fully industrialized, production-ready solution.
Accountable for adoption and retention goals across all data collection processes, as well as cost/efficiency goals.
Partners with process owners and operations teams across data collection to drive validation and buy-in for the pipeline.
Defines the adoption and rollout strategy for onboarding data collection processes onto the pipeline, including sequencing and prioritization.
Creates a product roadmap that aligns cross-functional teams — collecting and prioritizing requirements from internal stakeholders and translating them into actionable milestones, including constraints and dependencies for scaling the pipeline.

25% Execution – Delivers on product outcomes

Aligns engineering and operations teams to deliver on the vision, goals, and strategy for the data collection pipeline, coordinating the process to meet timelines.
Plans releases, prioritizes features, and defines the work and what success looks like; clearly defines internal user needs and acceptance criteria.
Interacts regularly with development teams to prioritize needs and provide clarity for iterating on solutions.
Owns product scalability: ensures the AI/Agentic data collection solution remains stable, robust, scalable, and cost-efficient as data volume and internal usage grow, implementing proactive monitoring and collaborating with engineers to balance cost and performance.
Owns integration and adoption: drives onboarding of data collection processes onto the pipeline, developing strategies that simplify deployment and adoption, and creating detailed documentation and guidelines for connecting the tool to other organizational services and workflows.
Sets realistic performance and adoption goals as processes are onboarded, tracks product performance, monitors metrics, and iterates quickly to experiment and optimize. Moves to the next most valuable process to onboard once value has been delivered.
Serves as a subject matter expert for complex support escalations related to the pipeline; advocates for reducing support burden and improving the overall experience for internal teams relying on it.

15% Leadership – Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes

Influences and motivates cross-functional teams, without authority, to achieve product outcomes — pushing teams when they need to be pushed and supporting them when they need support.
Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
Coaches team members to develop product and AI/Agentic domain expertise.
Stays informed on the latest AI/Agentic developments in data extraction and data collection; collaborates with cross-functional teams building AI-native platform capabilities for the document and data lifecycle, and establishes feedback loops with users to identify improvement areas through AI-driven solutions.
Takes an expanded role in driving best-practice adoption across the department.
Effectively advocates for product funding, resource focus, and skill development to support strategic goals.
Typically coordinates delivery across multiple agile teams.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in STEM, finance, economics , or other relevant field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 12+ years of relevant experience, preferably with a focus on AI or data-driven products or product management.
Possesses and evangelizes a product mindset — starts from problems, goals, and needs, and experiments to find the best solution.
Experience with UI design principles and user-centric product development.
Capable of inspiring several cross-functional teams to deliver on product strategy and vision; able to influence engineering, design, operations, and other internal stakeholders without direct authority.
Ability to say no to demands from stakeholders that do not align with the validated product strategy.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Strong expertise in AI/Agentic technologies, data extraction, and data collection solutions.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and ability to lead Agile teams.
Demonstrated excellence and impact in previous Product roles.

What's In It For You

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit

Role description

Our Team

At Cimpress Open, we are an emerging, dynamic, and expanding team dedicated to bringing Cimpress's unique mass customization capabilities to a global audience. Our ambition is to become the "print button" of the internet, leveraging the agility of a new entity within the Cimpress powerhouse.

The wider Cimpress organization comprises more than a dozen brands, collectively serving tens of millions of customers each year. Each brand offers tailored value propositions to meet the specific needs of its market. With a decentralized structure and autonomy, Cimpress empowers these brands to stay close to their customers. Cimpress Open will build on this foundation, benefiting from and advancing it through a focus on collaboration and driving positive change.

We are poised for significant growth, partnering with like-minded organizations that share our ambition to empower people worldwide to make an impression through personalized, meaningful physical products.

Our Culture: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We are a tightly knit, highly collaborative team that relies on open communication, psychological safety, and a healthy dose of humor to get things done. If you thrive in a friendly, witty, and fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.

What You Will Do

Raise the AI Bar in Merchandising: Serve as the product champion for our AI Merchandising. You will own the strategy and execution of leveraging artificial intelligence to completely transform content management for our partner network.

Architect the Catalogue Lifecycle: Evolve our core Catalogue Management and Lifecycle Capabilities. You'll ensure seamless tracking, optimization, and visibility of catalogue performance across all partners.

Scale the Inventory Engine: Take ownership of managing and expanding our core Inventory services, ensuring seamless and highly reliable inventory capabilities applicable across all diverse partner models.

Drive High-Visibility, Cross-Org Collaboration: Act as a critical bridge. You will collaborate closely with our Senior PMs to power our models across our partner ecosystems. Beyond Cimpress Open, you will skillfully navigate and manage a large set of stakeholders across the broader, global Cimpress organization.

Own and Deliver a Bold Feature Roadmap: Translate partner pain points and emerging tech opportunities into a prioritized, high-impact backlog. You will balance rapid, high-value wins with long-term architectural scalability.

Measure What Matters: Track and analyze key performance metrics regarding catalogue health, content accuracy, and partner onboarding efficiency to relentlessly iterate on your product space.

Learn, Build, and Scale: Work hand-in-hand with our engineering and business teams. We don't believe in copy-pasting solutions just because they worked elsewhere; we want an entrepreneurial PM eager to experiment, raise the bar, and learn from every milestone.

Required Skill Sets

7+ years of experience in product management, ideally within e-commerce (experience working in a large e-commerce organisation such as Amazon or Flipkart is a plus), SaaS, digital design, or marketplace platforms.

A strong technical curiosity, with hands-on experience using Generative AI and AI/ML automation tools, and a real interest in applying them to content and merchandising workflows.

Hands-on experience with structured product data - complex data structures, product catalogues, data mapping, Content Management Systems (CMS) at scale, or marketplace operations.

Exceptional stakeholder and relationship management skills - you know how to influence, align, and collaborate with engineering peers, senior product leaders, and diverse business teams.

Top-tier communication skills, with the unique ability to translate complex data mapping and technical AI concepts into simple, crystal-clear product requirements.

A thriving startup mindset: You are highly comfortable with ambiguity, proactive about taking initiative, and excited to wear multiple hats in a fast-paced, greenfield environment.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Cimpress Open offers an inclusive, growth-oriented environment where your impact is felt immediately. We work remotely, fostering a culture of high accountability and true autonomy. Join us to play a foundational role in a greenfield initiative that leverages cutting-edge technology to shape customer expectations and the future of Cimpress Open.

We would love to hear from you if you're ready to make a massive impact on our journey and grow hand in hand with us every step of the way.

Skills

About Cimpress
Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end-to-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Product Manager on the Incentives and Growth Platforms team, you will own the end-to-end product goal, technical strategy, and execution for core customer incentive and reward charters across the customer lifecycle. You will manage complex challenges at the intersection of behavioral economics, growth engineering, conversational AI, recommendation engines, partner platforms, and fraud/risk. This is a high-visibility role where you require strong product instincts, technical depth, and the ability to rally cross-functional stakeholders (Engineering, UX, Product Marketing, Data Science, Operations, and Risk) around a clear product point of view and infrastructure.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Responsibilities
Serve as the central product leader uniting cross-functional partners—including Software Engineering, UX/Design, Product Marketing, Customer Operations, Data Science, and Trust and Safety/Risk.
Lead the proactive use of AI tools and reasoning models to conduct deep quantitative and market research, analyze user journeys, test behavioral hypotheses, and rapidly prototype novel incentive mechanics and conversational workflows.
Own the multi-quarter strategy and technical roadmap for core customer incentive and reward charters, aligning product bets with broader business growth, customer retaining, and payback goals.

Design robust MCP tool schemas and API interfaces that empower autonomous agents and conversational assistants to deliver personalized promotional recommendations.
Design and execute rigorous A/B testing and flighting strategies to evaluate hypotheses, measure causal incrementality, and analyze redemption vs. breakage economics.
