Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding & KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.

This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk & Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time-to-verify, manual review rates, cost-to-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in-product control environment accounts for country-specific financial crime risks.
Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.

Qualifications

What we’re looking for

Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust & safety, or another regulated domain.
8+ years in the workforce with ideally 5+ years in product management or product-management adjacent roles. 
For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3+ years in a senior product manager role
A strong track record shipping customer-facing products end-to-end, not just writing strategy.
Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade-offs based on evidence.
Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,
Nice to have

Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding, 
Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.

Location

This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About Revun

Revun is a SaaS, CRM, AI, and property operations platform that brings together leasing, maintenance, payments, owner/vendor payouts, communications, compliance, reporting, AI automation, portals, dashboards, integrations, and multiple user roles into one connected operating system.

Revun is a complex operational platform requiring strong product judgment, workflow design, technical understanding, and the ability to translate real business operations into clear software requirements.

About The Role

Revun is hiring a Senior Technical Product Manager to own product requirements, roadmap priorities, workflow design, UX alignment, and product delivery.

You will work directly with leadership to determine what should be built, why it should be built, how it should work, and what should be prioritized.

You will work closely with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead, who owns technical architecture and engineering execution, while providing product direction to UX/UI, engineering, and QA.

This is not a backlog administration role. We are looking for someone who can challenge unclear ideas, simplify complex workflows, make strong product decisions, and turn business requirements into clear development execution.

What You Will Do

Own the product roadmap, backlog, feature priorities, and product-side launch readiness.
Translate business needs into clear requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets.
Determine what should be built now, delayed, simplified, or removed.
Map complex workflows across CRM, leasing, maintenance, payments, reporting, AI, integrations, and portals.
Define product requirements across multiple user roles, permissions, dashboards, and workflows.
Provide product direction to UX/UI and ensure designs reflect user needs, business rules, workflows, and edge cases.
Work with the Senior Software Architect / Technical Lead on technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, estimates, and trade-offs.
Coordinate with frontend, backend, AI/automation, integration, QA, and DevOps resources throughout development.
Define requirements for AI-powered features and determinewhere AI, automation, or human review should be used.
Work with QA on test scenarios, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and user acceptance testing.
Review completed functionality and determine whether it meets the original product and business requirements.
Identify product gaps, workflow conflicts, unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, dependencies, and launch blockers.
Conduct product discovery and use stakeholder feedback, user needs, workflow analysis, and product data to guide decisions.
Define measurable success criteria for major features and evaluate performance after release.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field. A technical degree is strongly preferred.
7+ years of product management, technical product management, or comparable product ownership experience.
4+ years working on complex SaaS, CRM, workflow automation, marketplace, fintech, PropTech, field-service, or multi-user operational platforms.
Strong experience creating product requirements, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and development-ready specifications.
Experience taking complex features from initial business requirements through UX/UI, development, QA, release, and post-release evaluation.
Strong working knowledge of APIs, integrations, databases, permissions, system dependencies, AI functionality, and modern SaaS platforms.
Experience working closely with senior engineers, software architects, QA, and Product/UX/UI Designers.
Experience with product discovery, user research, backlog management, prioritization, UAT, release planning, and launch readiness.
Ability to challenge unclear requirements, unnecessary complexity, unrealistic timelines, and weak product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strongly Preferred

Experience with PropTech, real estate technology, property management software, fintech, field service, compliance, marketplace, or operational SaaS platforms.
Experience with AI/LLM workflows, AI automation, document processing, communications, task routing, reporting, or decision support.
Experience with payments, payouts, reconciliation, accounting, ledger, or other financially sensitive workflows.
Experience inheriting an existing SaaS platform and identifying product gaps, workflow problems, UX issues, and launch blockers.
Experience preparing a complex SaaS product for commercial launch.
Experience working with remote or offshore engineering teams.
Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.

Ideal Candidate

You are not simply someone who manages tickets or maintains a backlog.

You Should Be Able To Determine

What problem are we actually solving?
Is this the right solution?
Does the workflow make sense?
What happens in the edge cases?
Is this important enough to build now?
Can it be simplified?
How will we know whether it worked?

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and turning incomplete business ideas into clear product decisions that designers, architects, developers, and QA can execute.

Within your first 90 days, you will understand the existing platform, clarify major workflows, improve product requirements and backlog quality, align UX and engineering priorities, identify launch-critical gaps, and establish a clear path toward commercial launch.

Leadership should have clear visibility into what is being built, why it is being built, what is blocking progress, and what should happen next.

Full-time, Monday to Friday, remote.

Availability during core Eastern Time business hours is required.

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Description

Product Manager

Requirements

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Product Manager to own, innovate, and scale a key WFM product line. This role is for a true product creator, someone who combines deep domain knowledge in workforce management with the commercial mindset and execution needed to bring innovative, high-impact products to market.

You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from shaping vision and strategy to driving successful launches, adoption, and ongoing growth. You will engage directly with strategic customers, partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that solve real-world challenges in contact centres and complex enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities

– Own the WFM Product Vision & Strategy:

Develop, articulate, and execute a compelling vision and strategic roadmap for the WFM product line, aligned to customer needs, market trends, and company goals.

– Drive Full Product Lifecycle:

Lead the end-to-end process from market discovery and concept validation through launch, adoption, and scaling. Measure success against business outcomes (growth, adoption, customer satisfaction, retention).


Be the Customer and Market Expert:


Deeply understand contact centre and workforce management domains. Identify emerging needs, market shifts, and technology trends to create differentiated offerings.


Product Creation & Innovation:


Identify new product opportunities, develop business cases, and lead ideation, design, and MVP/prototype delivery. Take a hands-on approach to both strategy and execution.


Strategic Stakeholder Engagement:


Act as the product ambassador with key customers (including enterprise and strategic accounts), executive sponsors, and partners. Gather high-level feedback and incorporate it into roadmap decisions.

– Go-to-Market Ownership

Work closely with commercial, customer success, and marketing teams to define go-to-market, pricing, and enablement.

– Cross-functional Leadership:

Collaborate with engineering, UX, QA, support, and operations to deliver high-quality products on time and to specification. Champion a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.


Own the strategy, roadmap, and business case for WFM Request Management covering the full request lifecycle — submission, validation, approval, and write-back to the schedule — for time off, shift swaps, shift bids, overtime and voluntary time off, schedule changes, availability updates, and fully configurable custom request types.


– Drive deep capability definition across request rules and eligibility criteria, quotas and allotments, accrual and balance validation, multi-level and hierarchical approval workflows, auto-approval and auto-decline logic, waitlists, blackout periods, notifications, and audit history — balancing employee flexibility with operational coverage and adherence.

– Act as the recognized domain expert on request management dependencies with Scheduling, Forecasting, Time & Attendance, and Mobile/self-service, partnering with peer PMs to sequence cross-product work and resolve conflicting requirements.


Lead discovery and validation with customers, advisory councils, and EAP/beta programs; write clear requirements and acceptance criteria, prioritize the backlog with engineering and UX, and make defensible trade-offs on scope, quality, and timing.
Own launch and adoption outcomes — enablement, demos, positioning, and release communications for Sales, Services, and Support — and instrument success metrics such as self-service adoption, auto-approval rates, approval turnaround time, and supervisor time saved


Job responsibilities

Experience & Skills

Must-have:

– 7 years in product management (ideally SaaS/enterprise), with a strong track record of launching and scaling B2B workforce management, contact centre, or enterprise SaaS products.

– 5+ years of direct WFM, scheduling, or real-time analyst experience (preferably in a contact centre environment), with hands-on familiarity with WFM platforms ( NICE, Verint, Assembled, etc.).

– Proven experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle, driving commercial outcomes (including pricing, EAP, and GTM).

– Deep understanding of key WFM metrics (adherence, shrinkage, occupancy, schedule optimisation, forecast variance).

– Proven ability to create, launch, and grow new products or major features, not just incremental delivery or backlog management.

– Demonstrated strategic and commercial acumen, including business case development, go-to-market, and revenue/growth responsibility.

– Experience engaging directly with executive-level customers, strategic partners, and cross-functional teams.

– Strong technical understanding of SaaS, cloud ecosystems, and the software delivery lifecycle.

– Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to have:

– Experience with global product delivery in multi-site teams.

– Experience as a contact centre workforce planner or in a management role managing planning/forecasting teams.

– Exposure to AI/ML, automation, and analytics in workforce management.

– Experience in complex B2B software environments.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.

What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

About THG Ingenuity
THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end technology platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, and THG Fulfilment. Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble. Technology is the driving force behind THG Ingenuity, and it starts with our people. We are ambitious with our goals and challenge conventional thinking.

THG Ingenuity is different because we support every person to make a meaningful impact and drive their own work. Our people are always learning, and we work every day to ensure our technology, from our software platforms to our hosting services, to our AI capability and beyond, is world-class. This enables us to keep powering THG Ingenuity and our partners on a global scale.

The Opportunity
Our checkout and payments capability is genuinely industry-leading. It processes at serious scale for some of the world's best-known brands, converts at a level we are proud of, and handles the parts most platforms avoid — multi-PSP orchestration, fraud and chargeback management, cross-border complexity, marketplace, and subscription flows. That performance is hard-won, and protecting it is half of this job.

The other half is turning that strength into products in their own right. Much of what we have built for our own clients is strong enough to be sold on its own merits to businesses that are not on the Ingenuity platform at all. Checkout-as-a-Service and Merchant of Record are the clearest examples: launched in January 2026, live with real merchants across five MoR models spanning domestic, cross-border, marketplace, and PSP white-label. Today, this is still a managed service that our team configures and operates. Turning that into something a merchant can configure and launch largely themselves is the flagship piece of work. But the same question applies right across the area, and part of the role is deciding where else it holds.

And the ground is moving. Agents are beginning to buy on behalf of customers, which changes assumptions the whole industry has built checkout on — how a purchase is authenticated when there is no human at the screen, what fraud signals mean when the buyer is software, how liability and Merchant of Record models work when an agent is transacting on someone's behalf, and what a checkout experience even is when nobody is looking at it. We do not think anyone has this fully worked out yet. We want someone who will actively go and find out, and who sees the chance to shape it rather than react to it.

It is an unusual but exciting combination: a live, high-performing product with real revenue to protect, a genuine product-building challenge in front of it, and a part of the industry that is about to change shape.

Where the Role Sits
You will own the Checkout & Payments domain, which sits within our Fintech engineering area alongside Delivery & Returns. Product at THG Commerce runs as five customer-journey domains, each a delivery trio of product, UX, and engineering; you will be the product lead for this one, working with a dedicated squad structure and an embedded designer. You will be part of the senior product group that sets strategy for the commerce platform as a whole — the roadmap you own has dependencies running through discovery, loyalty, and fulfilment, and you will be in the room where those trade-offs get made.

This is also the first product role in our Pune office. Your domain stakeholders and the commercial team are in the UK, so strong communication in all forms is essential to ensure the handover of information is smooth and clear. You will help shape how product works in that office from the beginning. There is no line management in this role at the moment. Your influence comes from depth of expertise, clarity of thinking, and the trust you build with engineering, commercial, finance, legal, and our merchants.

What You'll Own
Checkout performance: Conversion and payment success across every market and channel. This is a live, high-performing product for major brands, and keeping it there comes before anything new.
The payment stack: Multi-PSP orchestration and routing, authorisation rates, payment method breadth and mix, tokenisation, and genuinely localised checkout experiences market by market — including the economics of all of it.
Fraud, risk and disputes: Fraud strategy and tooling, the balance between fraud loss, false positives and customer friction, and chargeback and dispute management. You own where that balance sits and the argument for it.
Merchant of Record and cross-border: Our five live MoR models, the liability and compliance implications of each, market and acquiring coverage, and the tax, regulatory, and consumer protection obligations that come with operating across borders.
Productisation: Turning managed capabilities into products that stand on their own — self-serve configuration, onboarding, developer experience, packaging, and the standards a third party will hold us to. Checkout-as-a-Service is the flagship, but the question applies more widely.
Subscriptions and recurring revenue: Subscription models operating natively within MoR and checkout, and the flexibility, billing, and retention mechanics behind them.
Money movement: Settlement, payout, reconciliation, and FX — the parts cross-border merchants will not buy without and will not forgive us for getting wrong.
Agentic commerce: Working out what agent-led buying does to checkout, payments, fraud, and Merchant of Record, and turning that into experiments and roadmap where it earns its place.

How You'll Work
In close partnership with engineering, UX, commercial, trading, finance, legal, and data science — leading complex programmes across multiple squads, external partners, and third-party integrations.
Alongside the commercial team, who own the route to market. They run the sales motion; you supply the product, the positioning, and the technical credibility — and join the conversation when the questions get deep.
As the domain expert in client-facing conversations, with brands that will test how well you know your subject.
Against metrics you define and own: checkout conversion and payment success, authorisation rates, payment method mix, cost per transaction, fraud loss and false positives, chargeback rates, settlement accuracy, subscription retention, and merchant NPS.

About You
You have significant hands-on product experience across checkout, payments, Merchant of Record, cross-border commerce, or commerce infrastructure — in payments or cross-border specialists, a marketplace, a PSP or orchestrator, or a large-scale platform. We care more about the depth and breadth of what you have owned than the number of years.
You have genuine breadth across the domain. You can move between checkout UX, routing economics, fraud model performance, subscription mechanics, and MoR liability in a single conversation, and you know how a decision in one shows up in the others.
You know what separates an internal capability from a product a stranger will pay for and depend on — the documentation, the sandbox, the SLA, the versioning discipline, the support model — and you hold that bar without being asked.
You are fluent in the language of payments and cross-border commerce. You can hold your own with acquirers, PSPs, fraud vendors, tax advisers, and marketplace partners, and you know what to ask for, what is negotiable, and what is not.
You are comfortable in regulated territory. PSD2 and SCA, PCI DSS scope, indirect tax and duty, local acquiring and licensing, and consumer protection are constraints you design within rather than obstacles you route around.
You know the competitive landscape. You can articulate where the established c

Job Purpose

The Senior Product Manager for Commercial Cards will be responsible for strategic development in form of the build from scratch in terms of product, customer journey, technology, management, and growth of DBS's Commercial Cards product portfolio within the dynamic Indian market. This role involves driving product innovation, enhancing customer experience, ensuring market competitiveness, and achieving business objectives while adhering to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the Indian commercial cards landscape, including emerging payment trends like UPI, strong analytical skills, and a proven track record in product lifecycle management within the Indian financial services industry.

Key Accountabilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy and roadmap for Commercial Cards in India, aligning with the bank's overall business goals, market trends, and RBI's directives on card issuance and conduct of business.
Product Development & Enhancement: Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from conceptualization and business case creation to launch and post-launch performance monitoring for new and enhanced commercial card products, considering specific Indian market needs and regulatory requirements. This includes features like online, NFC, and international transaction controls as per RBI mandates.
Market Competitiveness & Customer Experience: Continuously monitor market trends, competitor offerings from other Indian private banks (e.g., ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Axis Bank), and customer feedback to ensure commercial card products remain competitive and deliver a superior customer experience, potentially integrating with indigenous payment systems like RuPay.
Revenue Growth & Profitability: Drive the revenue growth and profitability of the commercial cards portfolio through effective pricing strategies, usage initiatives, and targeted campaigns, while also navigating any RBI restrictions on incentives or specific card offerings.
Risk & Compliance Management: Ensure all commercial card products and processes adhere to internal policies, regulatory requirements set by the RBI, and industry best practices for risk management and compliance, including mandates on card activation and usage.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities for product innovation and differentiation in the Indian commercial cards space, staying abreast of developments in digital payments and fintech landscape in India.
Define product requirements, features, and functionalities based on customer needs, market analysis, and business objectives, incorporating features like spend management, online access, and integration with treasury services relevant to Indian businesses.
Collaborate closely with various internal stakeholders including Sales, Technology & Operations, Credit, Legal & Compliance, Marketing, and Customer Service to ensure successful product delivery and management, specifically addressing Indian market nuances.
Manage product pricing, cost analysis, and profitability for the commercial cards portfolio, considering the competitive pricing landscape among Indian private banks.
Develop and implement go-to-market strategies for new product launches and enhancements, working with marketing teams and ensuring compliance with advertising guidelines in India.
Monitor product performance metrics, analyze data, and generate insights to optimize product offerings and business outcomes, leveraging advanced analytics tools common in the Indian banking sector.
Oversee the resolution of product-related issues and escalations, working with relevant teams and ensuring adherence to Indian customer grievance redressal mechanisms.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies, payment trends (e.g., UPI, RuPay), and regulatory changes impacting the commercial cards industry in India, such as changes in online transaction rules or card issuance.
Represent DBS at industry forums and events related to commercial cards in India, contributing to the bank's thought leadership in the sector.

Requirements

Rich experience in product management within the financial services industry in India, with significant experience specifically in Commercial Cards or Corporate Payments for an Indian private bank.
Proven track record of successfully launching and managing financial products throughout their lifecycle in the Indian market.
Demonstrated ability to drive business growth and profitability for a product portfolio, considering the competitive landscape and regulatory environment of Indian banking.
Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder relationships, including interactions with payment networks like Visa, Mastercard, and RuPay in India.

Technical/Professional Knowledge And Experience

In-depth knowledge of commercial card products, Indian payment systems (e.g., RuPay, UPI), and industry best practices (e.g., Visa, Mastercard schemes) within India.
Strong understanding of corporate treasury needs, procure-to-pay processes, and working capital solutions relevant to Indian businesses.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and methodologies to interpret market trends and product performance in the Indian context.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements applicable to commercial card products in India, particularly RBI circulars and Master Directions.

Education / Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
Master's degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., Certified Product Manager, PMP) are a plus, especially those with a focus on the Indian financial market.

Core Competencies

Strategic & Visionary: Ability to develop a clear product vision and translate it into actionable strategies for the Indian commercial cards market.
Customer-Centric: Strong focus on understanding and addressing the unique needs and pain points of Indian corporate clients.
Analytical & Problem-Solver: Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and formulate effective solutions for the Indian market.
Influential & Communicative: Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including regulatory engagement.
Results-Oriented: Drives for results and takes ownership of product success in the competitive Indian banking sector.
Adaptable: Thrives in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, capable of managing multiple priorities within the evolving Indian regulatory and technological landscape.

Work Relationship

Superior(s): Head of SME Business, Credit Head,
Peers: Product Managers (across different product lines), Sales Managers, Technology Managers, Operations Managers, Credit Managers, Marketing Managers, Compliance Officers.
External Parties: Commercial Card Network partners (Visa, Mastercard, Ru Pay), payment technology vendors, corporate clients in India, and relevant industry associations and regulatory bodies.

Job Description

Be at the heart of how a global workforce connects, collaborates, and communicates. Join a people-centered team that values experimentation, career growth, and the thoughtful application of emerging technologies.

About The Team

Product Manager, Quantitative Analytics

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape, grow and improve our industry-leading, multi-cloud database platform. jobs.sourceTitle: Senior Product Manager – ShuruKar | The Bharat Project
jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
Build a product that helps Bharat start up.

There are millions of aspiring entrepreneurs across Tier 2, Tier 3 and rural India with the ambition to build something of their own.

What They Often Don't Have Is Access To The Right Mentor, The Right Information, The Right Network, Or Simply Someone Who Can Tell Them

“You have an idea. Hereʼs what you should do next.”

That is what we are building with ShuruKar.

ShuruKar is YourStoryʼs AI-powered entrepreneurship platform under The Bharat Project designed to become a digital co-pilot for aspiring and early stage entrepreneurs across India.

From helping someone validate their first business idea to discovering government schemes, understanding their market, creating a pitch, finding mentorship and taking the first steps towards building, ShuruKar is being built for the entrepreneur who may never have had access to a startup ecosystem before.

And weʼre looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build it.

About The Bharat Project

The Bharat Project is YourStoryʼs mission to enable 1 million entrepreneurs across Tier 2, Tier 3, and rural India.

We work at the intersection of technology, entrepreneurship, storytelling and grassroots ecosystems partnering with governments, institutions, universities, incubators and communities across India.

Through initiatives spanning idea discovery, AI-led mentorship, skilling, funding access, market linkages and storytelling, we want to make entrepreneurship more accessible to anyone with the ambition to build.

ShuruKar is the technology layer powering that mission.

About The Role

As Senior Product Manager – ShuruKar, you won't inherit a mature product with a neatly defined roadmap.

You'll help build one.

You will own critical parts of ShuruKar's journey, understanding entrepreneurs on the ground, identifying their biggest problems, translating those problems into product experiences, shipping quickly, measuring behaviour, and continuously improving the product.

You'll work across AI, product, growth, content and community to build experiences for a very different kind of internet user often mobile-first, vernacular-first and interacting with entrepreneurship for the first time.

This is a 0→1 + 1→10 product role with significant ownership.

What You'll Build

ShuruKar AI Co-Pilot

Build a personalised AI mentor that understands where an entrepreneur is in their journey and helps them figure out what to do next from idea to execution.

Not another chatbot.

A product that can genuinely become an entrepreneur's 24x7 digital guide.

Idea → Business Journey

Design Experiences That Help Users Move From

“Mere paas ek idea hai” → “Mujhe pata hai ab kya karna hai.”

Think idea validation, market research, business planning, MVP guidance, pricing, pitch creation and actionable next steps.

Access to Opportunities

Make hundreds of government schemes, grants, mentorship programs, funding opportunities and ecosystem resources actually discoverable and useful for entrepreneurs.

Entrepreneurship at Bharat Scale

Build for users beyond India's startup bubbles.

That means thinking deeply about WhatsApp, vernacular experiences, voice, low-friction onboarding, trust, assisted journeys, and AI interfaces that work for the next generation of entrepreneurs.

What You'll Own

Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define what we build, why we build it and what success looks like for ShuruKar. 
User Discovery: Spend time with aspiring entrepreneurs, founders, students and ecosystem partners to understand real problems rather than relying only on dashboards. 
0→1 Product Development: Take ideas from messy problem statements to prototypes, MVPs and shipped products. 
AI Product Experiences: Work closely with engineering and AI teams to design useful, contextual and trustworthy AI-led journeys. 
Product Growth: Own activation, engagement and retention loops. Shipping is only half the job getting people to repeatedly derive value is the other half. 
Experimentation: Run fast experiments across onboarding, AI interactions, content, notifications, WhatsApp and product journeys. 
Data & Insights: Define funnels and product metrics, identify drop-offs and turn behaviour into product decisions. 
Cross-functional Execution: Work across engineering, design, content, growth, editorial, partnerships and Bharat Project teams to take products from idea to market. 
Field → Product Feedback Loop: Translate insights coming from Bharat Project programs, state chapters and grassroots activations into scalable technology. 

What We're Looking For

You probably have 5 to 8 years of product experience, with meaningful experience owning consumer or platform products end-to-end.

But years alone aren't what we're hiring for.

We're Looking For Someone Who

Has built and shipped products rather than only managed roadmaps. 
Is comfortable operating with ambiguity and creating structure where none exists. 
Thinks deeply about users, funnels, behaviour and product metrics. 
Can move comfortably between strategy, UX conversations, data and execution. 
Has strong product intuition but is willing to kill their own hypothesis when the data says otherwise. 
Understands experimentation, activation, engagement and retention. 
Can work closely with engineers and designers without turning product management into ticket management. 
Is genuinely curious about AI-native products and conversational interfaces. 
Wants to build for users outside the traditional English-speaking, metro startup ecosystem. 

Experience with consumer internet, AI products, fintech, edtech, marketplaces, vernacular products or products built for India's next 500 million users would be especially relevant.

Why Join Us? 

Build for a million entrepreneurs

Your work won't just optimise another funnel. The ambition is to help create and enable 1 million entrepreneurs across Bharat.

Build AI for the real world

Explore what AI looks like when designed for first-time entrepreneurs, vernacular users and people outside traditional startup ecosystems.

Founder-like ownership

You'll have significant freedom to shape the product, roadmap, experiments and eventually the larger ShuruKar ecosystem.

Access to India's entrepreneurial ecosystem

YourStory sits at the intersection of founders, investors, governments, institutions and emerging startup communities across the country.

See your users in the real world

The Bharat Project operates across states, colleges, communities and entrepreneurial ecosystems giving you something most product teams don't have:

A direct line between the people you're building for and the product you're building.

The Mandate Is Simple.

Can we use technology and AI to make starting a business easier for anyone in India?

If that's the kind of product problem you want to spend the next few years solving, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your profile along with one product you've built that you're genuinely proud of and tell us why.

Job Description

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Our mission is to build smarter shopper experiences across the entire customer journey — from discovery on social to conversion on the product page. Whether it's optimizing a shoppable gallery experience on a retailer PDP or scaling visual content distribution across a global brand-retailer network, we're here to be a true strategic partner for businesses.

As the Senior Product Manager responsible for Bazaarvoice Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, you will play a critical role in shaping how brands and retailers display and distribute visual user-generated content at scale. Your primary focus will be on understanding the needs of brand marketers, retailer merchandising teams, and end shoppers — then building products that drive trust, engagement, and conversion through authentic visual experiences at every point of sale.

Defining a strategy and creating a 1–2 year roadmap for Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, balancing the needs of both sides of Bazaarvoice's brand-retailer network.

Overview

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

Responsibilities

Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Translate complex cybersecurity and managed-services concepts into clear requirements, prioritization logic, workflows, and acceptance criteria.

Strong platform mindset — multi-tenant data models, workflows, integrations, identity/access, and scalable systems.
An AI-first way of working: fluent in using AI tools to draft requirements and documentation and build working prototypes.
Strong business instincts — able to tie product decisions to partner economics, adoption, and revenue.
Ability to work hands-on with engineering on requirements, trade-offs, and execution.
Proven ability to operate as a strong, self-directed IC and to mentor and influence a globally distributed team.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with US-based teams.


Strongly Preferred Kills :

Experience with MSSP, MDR, managed security services, or multi-tenant / partner-facing (channel) platforms.
Experience building AI-driven capabilities — agentic AI, copilots, intelligent recommendations, or workflow automation.
Familiarity with design tooling such as Figma for prototyping and UX collaboration.
Experience with reporting/analytics, dashboards, and enterprise integrations (ServiceNow, Jira, CMDB, SSO/IdP).


Why This Role Matters

You will shape how the world's managed security providers — and the customers who depend on them — see, prioritize, and act on cyber risk at scale. About Us

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the GP and client experience within ADI — the experiences our fund-manager clients use to run and monitor their business: the client operations centre where they track the progress of their work, their dashboards and reporting, and the client portal. You will own the roadmap and the end-to-end product management for this stream. The first use cases go live in October 2026; your job is to build on them and own the future roadmap that takes the GP experience to its full vision.

You will translate the reality of fund administration — across private equity, private credit and real assets — into a clear, consolidated, self-service experience, turning information that today lives in many places into a single, trustworthy view for clients. You will work hands-on: authoring executable PRDs and building the first prototypes yourself, then partnering with engineering, design and client-delivery teams to bring them to production.

Your Responsibilities

Product strategy & roadmap

Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the GP & client experience — including the future roadmap well beyond the first use cases — and converge the platform toward its full product vision.
Prioritise a single backlog against client value, commercial impact and key-client risk; make trade-offs visible and take decisions at pace.

The GP Experience

Own the client operations centre (where clients monitor the progress of their tasks), the client dashboards and reporting experience, and the client portal — defining the journeys, information design and self-service capabilities.
Define the single ‘one-lens’ view across funds and asset classes — bringing valuations, capital calls and distributions, portfolio monitoring, and fund and investor reporting into one coherent client experience.

Domain & data

Understand how client-facing information — valuations, cash flows, positions and reporting — is produced across the fund-accounting, portfolio and reporting estate, and ensure it reaches clients as a single, trustworthy view.
Work with data and platform teams to define what information the experience needs and where it is sourced, and manage the move from legacy portals so that no client is left behind.

Building AI-Native — How We Work

Author Executable PRDs (xPRDs) — structured context repositories that combine natural-language intent, machine-actionable specification, complete business and technical context, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria, and embedded governance guardrails.
Build the first functional prototype yourself during ideation and discovery, using AI tooling to validate desirability (product-market fit with clients) and feasibility (with architects) in parallel — then hand a high-fidelity, context-rich prototype to engineering to curate and take to production quality.
Own the non-functional requirements — performance, availability, scalability, security and accessibility — from day one, treating them as first-class product requirements rather than an afterthought.
Work within an enhanced design-thinking approach with governance embedded from day one — ethical AI and user rights, privacy, security, risk and compliance, and audit/traceability — alongside explicit attention to data readiness (maturity, availability and quality).

Delivery & cross-functional

Act as product lead across the relevant delivery teams; partner with technology and architecture on delivery, and with client-delivery and commercial teams on adoption and client engagement.

Essential

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

Proven senior product management experience delivering client-facing B2B software, portals or data/reporting products with measurable customer and commercial impact.
Demonstrated ability to work AI-native — authoring structured, executable PRDs and building functional prototypes with AI tooling.
Strong experience with dashboards, reporting and data-visualisation products, and a sharp instinct for information design and self-service experience.
Excellent prioritisation, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity from ambiguity.

Desirable

Domain experience in fund administration, asset servicing or alternatives (private equity, private credit, real assets).
Familiarity with the fund-accounting, portfolio and reporting systems that produce client information (such as Investran, eFront, Yardi, Solvas and ReportPro).
Experience in agile, multi-team delivery and large product platforms.

Personal Attributes

Outcome-driven and client-centric, keeping the client journey at the centre of every decision.
Hands-on and comfortable prototyping; happy to build, not just specify.
Collaborative and influential across product, technology, design, operations and commercial teams.

What We Offer

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

Active sports, events and social committees across our offices

Are you...

As we enter our next phase of growth, we're making significant investments in cloud, AI, and platform engineering to build the future of product innovation.

By combining cloud-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.

About The Role

Cross-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.

As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.

What You Will Do

Own and prioritize the product backlog for AI Services – a shared collection of common AI capabilities leveraged by Esko product and engineering teams.
Proactively gather needs from cross-functional product teams and turn them into clear, well-scoped requirements for the Esko AI engineering teams.
Act as a bridge between Esko AI and other cross-functional teams - product, engineering, and commercial – to ensure their success in building AI-powered capabilities that deliver on the intended customer value.
Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.
Weigh competing requests from multiple stakeholders against the long-term company strategy and priorities, while documenting risks and expected trade-offs.
Define and maintain adoption / success metrics for the shared capabilities - and use them to continually re-prioritize the backlog and indicate risks and areas of additional focus.
Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs clearly across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For

At least 5 years’ experience in a Software Product Management role, preferably including ownership of a platform, API or other shared-services product used across multiple internal teams.
Undergraduate or master’s degree in computer science or related discipline.
Native or fluent proficiency in English.
Experience initiating, deploying, and scaling AI-powered capabilities in production, with a track record of managing the development cycle from proof-of-concepts or early-stage ideas into production capabilities that other teams depend on.
Experience acting as a liaison in a large, global organization with multiple cross-functional teams - gathering and distilling requirements from varied stakeholders, aligning competing priorities, and driving toward a successful shared outcome.
Strong product management fundamentals: backlog ownership and refinement, roadmap creation & communication, and the ability to write clear, unambiguous requirements for engineering to build and test against.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.


Preferred Experience

What Success Looks Like

Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation of AI Services, rather than “re-inventing the wheel”.
Ideas and concepts forged by different teams are assessed for potential development as centralized AI services.

AI services are clearly explained and documented, with measures taken to minimize any roadblocks or barriers to successful adoption.
AI Services grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions.
A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies.

Critical Duties

Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and architects to ensure AI model behavior and outputs align with product requirements and business KPIs.
Define success metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for AI products, and track delivery against those measures on an ongoing basis.
Engage stakeholders at all levels to gather, validate, and communicate product requirements, roadmap status, and delivery progress.

Demonstrated experience working with Agile/Scrum teams, writing or refining user stories, and managing product backlogs.

Company Overview

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

The Product Management group partners with technology teams across the product lifecycle to specify, develop, and deliver the firm's infrastructure and middle- and back-office applications. What You'll Do

Contribute to the product vision for Investor Allocation modules and carry features from concept to creation.

Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.

About the role
DevRev is hiring a Senior Product Manager for the Computer Data and Analytics Platform – a hands-on product leader who will own the trusted data foundation that makes Computer precise, useful, and safe across every experience.
Computer should not merely report on work. It should understand customer, product, and operational context; reason across it; and help people and agents take the right action. The Computer Data and Analytics Platform makes that possible through a unified, governed, low-latency data layer that turns data from DevRev and connected systems into durable context for humans, applications, analytics experiences, and AI agents.
You will define how data is captured, modeled, governed, queried, and activated across DevRev. The platform will support operational reporting and embedded analytics, while also enabling grounded, context-rich agentic conversations in Computer – helping users ask questions, investigate work, receive trusted answers, and take safe actions in the flow of work.
This is a unique opportunity to build the foundation for an AI-native operating system – where customer context, product telemetry, structured records, events, and machine reasoning converge.
What you'll do
Lead the Computer Data and Analytics Platform vision and roadmap - Define and scale the platform that transforms operational and product data into reliable, reusable context for analytics, dashboards, applications, APIs, workflows, and Computer. Set a clear strategy for data modeling, query experiences, data freshness, governance, and activation.
Build trusted, AI agent-ready data foundations - Own the product direction for a platform that preserves source-of-record fidelity while making data easy to discover, understand, and use. Shape the abstractions that let Computer and people work with data confidently – including lineage, permissions, access controls, quality signals, and semantic definitions.
Define the data lifecycle from capture to activation - Guide the end-to-end path from source systems and event capture through change data capture, durable query representations, and governed serving layers. Ensure the platform supports real-time and historical workloads without forcing every experience to depend on a single data store or query engine.
Enable precise answers and safe actions with Computer - Partner with the AI platform to make natural-language data experiences dependable. Drive capabilities that allow Computer to retrieve grounded context, generate useful analysis and visualizations, and execute approved actions through clear permissions, guardrails, and auditability.
Build high-performance, flexible query experiences - Shape the experience for interactive analysis, embedded analytics, and developer workflows. Leverage in-process and local query technologies, including DuckDB where appropriate, to deliver responsive, secure experiences for applications, notebooks, and agents.
Design for multiple personas and levels of abstraction - Serve developers, data and product teams, support leaders, GTM teams, and operators. Provide opinionated defaults and ready-to-use experiences for common workflows, while preserving composability for technical users building applications, integrations, and custom data products.
Champion a platform-grade developer experience - Treat data as a core developer product. Prioritize intuitive APIs and SDKs, documentation, modular primitives, observability, extensibility, and a clear path from prototype to production.
Drive platform-wide interoperability - Ensure the Computer Data and Analytics Platform works seamlessly with DevRev’s product data, customer records, connected systems, applications, workflows, and AI agents. Establish the shared data contracts and platform capabilities that power a complete customer and product understanding.

What you'll bring
8+ years of product management or complementary experience building data platforms, developer platforms, analytics products, AI products, or infrastructure products.
Experience defining products that span data ingestion, data modeling, data quality, governance, querying, and downstream activation.
Strong understanding of modern data architectures, including source systems, event streams, change data capture, lakehouse-style storage, query engines, and serving layers.
Familiarity with embedded and in-process analytics, such as DuckDB, and the trade-offs between local, operational, and centralized query patterns.
Practical understanding of AI-native data experiences, including grounded retrieval, natural-language querying, Text-to-SQL, evaluation, permissions, and safe action execution.
Ability to design products that serve both technical and non-technical users without compromising trust, usability, or extensibility.
A record of partnering deeply with engineering, design, AI/ML, security, and go-to-market teams to ship reliable, scalable platform products.
Strong product judgment in ambiguous, technical environments – with the ability to turn an architectural direction into clear customer value, milestones, and adoption measures.

Why This Role
You will define the data foundation that makes Computer increasingly capable over time. Your work will enable a future where every interaction can benefit from complete, trusted context: Computer can answer with evidence, surface insights at the right moment, automate approved workflows, and help teams build faster on a shared data platform.
This is not a traditional BI role. It is a chance to build the connective layer between DevRev’s product, customer, and operational data – and the intelligent experiences that turn that data into outcomes.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join Firefly group. As part of our ambitious team, you will develop a business around Generative-AI surfaces for Adobe, driving innovation and crafting a flawless user experience. Experience working on AI-based products is highly desirable.

Roadmap and Launch

Collaborate with go-to-market teams to ensure efficient product launch initiatives

Research Partnership

Connect with client product teams to influence individual product roadmaps

8-10 years of product management experience, preferably in a large technology company
Proven track record of developing Customer facing web surfaces, SaaS and APIs
Experience with image, video and audio editing products is a plus
Proficient in AI technologies and their application in product development
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Information Technology & Digital

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.

About The Role

The role ensures clear product vision, roadmap ownership, and strong value delivery, translating Genesis objectives into well‑defined product outcomes aligned to procurement priorities. This includes shaping product strategy, defining success metrics, prioritising backlogs, and ensuring products are delivered in line with agreed objectives, timelines, and governance standards.

The Product Manager works closely with programme leadership, delivery teams, business stakeholders, and enabling IT&D functions to maintain transparency, support informed decision‑making, and ensure that Genesis products deliver measurable business value. This includes contributing to executive forums (e.g. Steering Committee and EOLT) with clear product insights on progress, risks, dependencies, and benefits realization.

Your responsibilities

Product Strategy & Ownership

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for multiple AI products across the Source‑to‑Pay lifecycle (e.g. sourcing, negotiations, contracting, supplier management, buying, savings tracking).

Translate Procurement strategy and pain points into high‑value AI use cases, balancing innovation with practical business impact.

Define product success through clear value metrics, KPIs, and adoption measures, ensuring benefits are realised and sustained.

AI Product Delivery

Lead the end‑to‑end product lifecycle: discovery, POCs, MVPs, scaling, and continuous improvement.

Shape and prioritise the product backlog, working closely with Product Owners, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, Business Analysts, and Architects.

Ensure AI products are designed responsibly, with appropriate consideration for model performance, explain ability, data quality, security, and compliance.

Stakeholder and External Partners Management

Act as the primary interface between Procurement, IT&D and Partners/Vendors

Partner closely with Procurement leaders across GBS to ensure tight business alignment on benefits delivery and adoption.

Manage and govern relationships with external partners, ensuring outcomes, delivery quality, and knowledge Innovation and Thought Leadership

Stay current with AI trends including LLMs, agent‑based systems, optimisation algorithms, game theory, and decision intelligence, and assess their relevance for Procurement.

Champion experimentation and learning, helping the organisation move from proof‑of‑concept to scaled value.

Act as an AI evangelist within Procurement, able to simplify complex concepts for non‑technical stakeholders.

The experience we're looking for

Skills/Experiences

Essential

12+ years of experience as a Product Manager delivering digital or AI driven products.
Strong Procurement domain knowledge, particularly across the Source to Pay process.
Solid understanding of AI and analytics concepts, including LLMs, ML models, algorithms, and data pipelines (hands on coding not required).
Ability to work effectively in complex, matrixed environments with global stakeholders.
Experience working with external vendors and partners to deliver technology products.

Desirable

Experience delivering AI products in procurement, supply chain, or enterprise functions.
Familiarity with concepts such as agentic AI, optimisation, simulation, and game theory.
Experience operating within Agile / product led delivery models.
Background in transformation, innovation, or advanced analytics programmes.

Technical / Professional Qualifications:

Essential

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Supply Chain, Procurement, or a related discipline.
Proven experience using product and delivery management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, Productboard, or similar) to manage backlogs, roadmaps, and delivery flow.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint (executive storytelling), PowerBI (analysis and value tracking), and Word.
Solid understanding of digital and AI product lifecycles, including discovery, MVP delivery, scaling, and benefits realisation.

Desired

Certification or formal training in Product Management (e.g., Pragmatic, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Scrum Product Owner).
Certification or training in Agile / Scaled Agile methodologies.
Exposure to or training in AI, analytics, or data driven products (e.g., Generative AI, Machine Learning fundamentals)

The skills for success

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership, AI Product Management, Procurement (Source-to-Pay) Expertise, Stakeholder Management & Alignment, Backlog Prioritisation & Value Definition, Agile / Product-led Delivery, Data & AI Concepts (LLMs, ML, Data Pipelines), End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management (Discovery to Scale), Vendor & Partner Management, Business Value Realisation & KPIs, Cross-functional Leadership (Tech & Business Teams), Risk & Governance Management, Decision Making & Problem Solving, Communication & Executive Storytelling, Tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Productboard, PowerBI)

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Description

The role involves leading the end-to-end lifecycle of pharmaceutical brands, including market analysis, product positioning, and launch planning. The individual will collaborate closely with sales, medical affairs, digital transformation, and other teams to develop product strategies, promotional plans, and evidence-based messaging aligned with company objectives.

Key day-to-day responsibilities
Monitoring product performance
Analyzing market trends and competitor activity
Developing brand communication
Supporting field teams with necessary documents and tools
Field Work - Regular interaction with doctors, chemist, retailers, and other stakeholders
Participation in conferences and events

Preferred Qualifications
B.Pharm is preferred. An MBA in Marketing / Pharmaceutical Management / Healthcare Management will be an added advantage.
Minimum 1–2 years of pharmaceutical sales experience as a Medical Representative / ABM or in a similar field role.
Minimum 5–7 years of Product Management Team (PMT) / pharmaceutical marketing experience.
Overall experience of approximately 9–10 years in the pharmaceutical industry preferred.
Candidates demonstrating career stability, preferably with at least 3 years in an organization, will be given preference.

Desired Qualifications
Candidates with experience in specialized therapy areas such as Orthopaedics, Gynaecology, and Physician-focused segments will be preferred.
Strong experience in product management, brand management, market analysis, product positioning, and promotional strategy.

Experience in developing promotional materials, campaigns, training inputs, and field-force communication.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and analytical abilities.

Pharmed Limited, headquartered in Bengaluru, India’s Silicon Valley, is one of the fastest-growing pharmaceutical companies in the country. Since 1946, the organization has focused on “Caring for India,” delivering evidence-based pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products that improve quality of life. Pharmed is widely recognized within the Indian medical community, with a portfolio that supports disease management and enhances lifestyle across specialized therapy areas. Its prescription-driven brands are regularly promoted to gynaecologists, orthopedicians, physicians, dermatologists, and otolaryngologists. 

To know more, visit the 'About Us' page on LinkedIn or check the website for more.

What do you need for this opportunity?

AI product exposure, Healthcare exp, US healthcare domain, Agile/Scrum, End-to-End Product Ownership, Excel, Presentation & communication skills, SQL

Incubyte is Looking for: 

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept to launch and beyond. You'll act as the central hub, working with stakeholders and clients to define product roadmaps and success metrics.

Requirements

Technical Acumen: You should have a solid understanding of software engineering concepts to help drive product strategy
