(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

Job Description

A Product Manager defines and supports the building of desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products balancing the needs of the client, business, design and development team over the product-market lifecycle.

Job Description - Grade Specific

Heorshe leads small multidisciplinary team internal and external to design, prototype and build cutting edge products and services. Heorshe supports the creation of user flow, process flows, diagrams to capture business, data or tech flows. Heorshe appears to the client as a trusted practioner and plays an hands on role in the delivery of project activities and deliverables.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to join our dynamic and collaborative Product Organization. Staff Product Managers will organize, define, prioritize and lead the execution of a complex product roadmap, usually responsible for more than one product in the product line. Staff Product Managers lead product teams and coach/mentor Product Owners and Product Managers. Staff Product Managers are key members in aligning solution designs into new platform services and identifying new product opportunities to drive new business growth. 

Your Mission

Successful delivery of multiple products within product line
Act as SME for product while growing knowledge of adjacent products
Outline product strategy (customer value, competitive position, business value)
Define product goals and themes (OKRs)
Drive product initiatives and lead geographically distributed cross‑functional teams
Drive alignment across product teams and GTM teams, contributing to GTM plan with Product Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams
Set and clearly communicate development objectives, needs, and status of projects to internal stakeholders and customers
Act as primary escalation point for product line, de‑escalating and communicating

You Are

A subject matter expert in your product line, who can handle significant complexity in your role and exercises independent and sound judgement. Someone who thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment while juggling multiple personas and prioritize competing tasks and deadlines to deliver on aggressive timelines. You are capable of supervising activities, projects, and teams. 

Your Experience Includes

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical or business field
7 – 10 years of relevant experience in an enterprise software development environment
4+ years of experience as a Product Manager
Experience managing product roadmaps and document goals and themes, for more than one product in a product pipeline
Proven ability to develop product strategies and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management
Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle
Experience planning for “end of life” in product and leading EOL processes across stakeholders
Experience contributing to technical debt planning and automation backlog
Recent experience using an Agile/Scrum methodology to build world class software
Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to know when it’s necessary to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done
Skilled at working effectively with cross functional teams, and influencing conversations to drive positive outcomes for the product and the business
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Extra Awesome

Previous experience in a B2B environment with multiple parties involved and/or impacted by potential changes to the product
Strong knowledge or experience in similar field, including privacy, vendor management, publisher/AdTech, MarTech, sustainability, or compliance
CIPP/E or CIPM certified

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

Who We Are

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

Who You Are

As Product Manager for Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM), you will help shape and deliver how carriers, distributors, partners, and policyholders securely access Zinnia’s platform. Working alongside senior product leadership, you will own the backlog and delivery for parts of the identity product area — authentication, authorization, and the user lifecycle — balancing security and compliance with a smooth user experience. You will partner day to day with Engineering and Security to turn requirements into shipped features.

What You’ll Do

Own the product backlog and contribute to the CIAM roadmap across consumer (policyholder), partner (distributor/agent), and workforce identity.
Write clear requirements and user stories for identity capabilities - authentication (SSO, MFA, passwordless), authorization (RBAC/ABAC, delegated access), and the user lifecycle (registration, provisioning/SCIM, recovery, deprovisioning).
Work with Engineering and Architecture on identity protocol decisions and implementation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM).
Contribute to build-vs-buy and platform evaluations for identity providers, and help maintain the integration approach across Zinnia products.
Balance security, privacy, and usability — helping reduce friction while protecting against account takeover, credential stuffing, and abuse.
Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance to ensure identity features meet regulatory and industry obligations applicable to the insurance industry.
Track feature performance and success metrics (e.g., authentication success and abandonment, MFA adoption) and use them to prioritize improvements.
Collaborate closely across Product, Engineering, and Security as a day-to-day point of contact for identity requirements.
Support release planning and ensure enhancements respond to carrier, distributor, and end-user needs.

What You’ll Need

5+ years in Product Management, with exposure to identity and access management or customer identity (CIAM).
Bachelor’s / Master’s or equivalent degree in technology or a related field.
Working knowledge of modern identity standards and protocols: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, and session/token concepts.
Familiarity with CIAM/IAM platforms and identity providers (e.g., Okta/Auth0, Ping, Microsoft Entra / Azure AD B2C, or equivalent).
Understanding of authentication and authorization models (SSO, MFA, passwordless, RBAC/ABAC) and common account-security threats.
Awareness of security, privacy, and regulatory/compliance requirements in a regulated industry.
Hands-on understanding of API integration, SQL, and data analysis.
Solid understanding of the SDLC, technology system interfaces, and data integration.
Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, and Security in a global, cross-functional setting.
Experience with Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and related tooling.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills; comfortable managing moderately complex problems with guidance from senior product leadership.
Experience in the Life & Annuity or broader financial-services industry is a plus, not mandatory.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, profit sharing, PF, incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We’re looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Role: Product Manager – Digital Twins for Data Center
Location: Bangalore / Chennai
Experience Required: 12-19 Years

About the Role

This is a strategic product leadership role focused on building and scaling HCLTech’s Data Center Digital Twin and Intelligent Infrastructure solutions portfolio. The role sits at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, AI-led digital platforms, enterprise software, and industry go-to-market strategy
Own the complete Digital twin solution lifecycle – identifying the market opportunities, defining the value proposition, solutioning with customers & partners and measuring the real-world business outcomes
You are the feature owner, voice of the proposition with the customer, partners & analysts
You will lead discovery workshops, executive business reviews and solution design sessions with customers and translating their needs into differentiated solutioning
You will work horizontally across engineering, sales, pre-sales, delivery and marketing to ensure that the value propositions are positioned correctly, priced to win, and delivered in a way that creates measurable and repeatable customer value.

Key Responsibilities

Define and drive the vision, roadmap creation of value proposition for AI-led digital twins for large Data Centers / AI Factories. Develop differentiated offerings leveraging AI, Digital Twins, IoT, analytics, and automation platforms. Translate customer and market requirements into scalable solution frameworks, accelerators, and reusable offerings.

Define innovative offerings by working closely with product, delivery & GTM team and leveraging AI & Agentic AI, industry leading DC digital twin platforms and the systems provided by various OEMs providing critical equipment for Data centers (Infra, Power, Cooling, Facility operations etc.). 

Key Responsibilities:
Value proposition: Own and continuously refine the value proposition for digital twins in data center. Map product capabilities to specific customer pain points and quantify the business case & ROI framework
Solution design: Lead end-to-end solutioning with customers and partners. Define the integration architectures with customer systems to the digital twin platform
Pre-sales & deal support: Engage directly in strategic deals – lead solution demonstration, respond to RFPs/RFIs, present to customers and develop solution proposals
Customer co-creation: Run structured discovery workshops, and co-innovation programs with key customers
Partner & ecosystem solutioning: Define and manage solution partner relationships and GTM playbooks with strategic partners
Competitive & market intelligence: Track competitor positioning, analyst coverage and adjacent technology trends. Translate market signals into positioning and roadmap input
Thought leadership: Represent HCLTech in industry forums, analyst interactions, partner ecosystems, and strategic customer engagements.


Required Qualifications & Expertise

12-19 years of relevant experience, with at least 10 years in data center operations, infrastructure engineering or DCIM/BMS/Digital Twin product management in a large enterprise or hyperscale environment
Experience in one or more of the following domains:
Direct and hands-on experience across the phases of data center – Design & Build, Planning, Operations and Optimization
Deep understanding on the design tools (like BIM/Revit), Simulation (CFD/Airflow), Virtual commissioning, Capacity planning, Hot/Cold aisle management, Power stranding & scheduled maintenance cycles
Deep working knowledge of DCIM platforms (Sunbird DCIM, Nlyte, Schneider Ecostruxure IT etc.), familiarity with BMS systems (JCI, Siemens), understanding of EPMS (Schneider Ecostruxure Power, ABB Ability, Eaton Power Xpert)
Understanding of cabling and network topology
Strong understanding of data and analytics fundamentals, IoT data pipeline, OT control systems, sensors integration, messaging protocols and how AI is applied to the infrastructure operations (AI Ops, Predictive maintenance)
Driven Sustainability and energy optimization initiatives
Experience in leading executive-level customer conversations in a data center / critical infrastructure context.
Industry certifications: CDCP / CDCS / CDCMP, RCDD, or equivalent. PMP or SAFe/Agile product certifications are plus


Preferred Qualifications

Experience in hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft, GCP, Meta), large colocation (Equinix, Digital Realty), DC OEMs & platforms (Schneider Electric, Eaton, Vertiv, Carrier, JCI, Bentley) or enterprise multi-site DC environment
Exposure to high-fidelity virtual twin with NVIDIA Omniverse, simulation tools (Cadence, Ansys), and IOT platforms (AWS, Azure)
Knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, NIST CSF)
Experience with sustainability and decarbonization roadmaps, carbon reporting (GHG protocol)
Global exposure and experience working with cross-functional teams across geographies.

Success Metrics for the Role

Creation of differentiated HCLTech value proposition for digital twins in data center
Pipeline creation and strategic deal influence
Customer adoption and ecosystem partnerships
GTM readiness and solution commercialization
Industry visibility and innovation leadership
Measurable business growth in the data center solutions segment

About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Team

The Workflows Module is the key component of HighLevel’s automation engine, enabling agencies and businesses to create powerful, automated workflows that enhance efficiency, save time, and improve outcomes. By integrating with multiple product areas within the HighLevel platform, the Workflows Module empowers users to streamline processes, nurture leads, and manage tasks seamlessly.

As part of the team, you’ll work on improving existing capabilities within workflows, conceptualizing new workflow features, and delivering solutions that drive adoption, activation, and business growth. The team is committed to optimizing user experience, increasing efficiency, and helping customers get the most value out of HighLevel.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Workflows Team. This role is perfect for a self-driven individual who is passionate about automation and SaaS products. As a SPM, you will help build impactful features and refine existing capabilities in the Workflows Module, making it easier for users to automate complex business processes.

You will work closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to understand user pain points, develop innovative solutions, and ensure seamless execution. You will play a critical role in driving product success by leveraging data, user insights, and collaborative teamwork.

Your Responsibilities 

You will own key parts of the Workflows product experience across activation, builder usability, execution reliability, and long-term engagement. This includes identifying high-impact opportunities across the workflow funnel, simplifying complex automation journeys, and partnering with cross-functional teams to ship scalable improvements that help customers automate more of their business operations.

Workflow Funnel Optimization: Identify and close gaps from workflow creation to execution to improve activation and adoption rates across accounts. 
Time to Value Acceleration: Drive initiatives that make it faster and easier for users to launch their first meaningful automation. 
Retention & Engagement: Lead efforts to make workflows a sticky, high-usage product that users return to regularly. 
Builder Simplicity & Usability: Champion ease-of-use by simplifying complex concepts, refining the UI, and reducing friction in critical paths. 
Template & Entry Point Expansion:Launch iterative improvements to templates, hotlinks and suggested workflows to bridge intent and execution. 
Support Insight to Product Fixes: Analyze support tickets and user feedback to identify and resolve common sources of confusion or setup failure. 
Optimizing existing workflows, ensuring they are intuitive, scalable and aligned with customer needs. 
Manage New Features: Managing workflow feature requests, tracking, prioritizing and ensuring timely execution of essential updates. 
Cross Team Collaboration: Collaborating with other product teams (CRM, Reporting, Payments, AI, and Integrations) to ensure seamless cross-functional workflow improvements. 
Tracking Metrics: Tracking performance metrics to identify usability bottlenecks, activation & adoption trends, and areas for optimization. 
Staying updated on industry trends in automation, integrations, and no-code/low-code platforms to drive innovation within workflows. 

Your Core Skills

About the Role
We're looking for an experienced, product-first thinker to own the end-to-end product strategy, design, and delivery of an AI-native Network Testing and Validation Platform focused on Drive Testing, Probe Testing, automated network testing, and network performance analysis.
You will shape a product that enables telecom operators, network teams, and service providers to plan, execute, automate, and analyze network testing across 4G, 5G, and evolving network environments. The platform will unify drive testing, active and passive probe testing, network telemetry, OSS data, geospatial intelligence, and customer-experience signals into a single testing and validation ecosystem. Experience with mobile SDK-based network data collection, passive data pipelines, device telemetry, or crowdsourced network-performance platforms will be valuable.
The product vision is to transform traditional network testing from manual, field-intensive, and periodic testing into a more automated, continuous, intelligent, and data-driven testing model.

Key Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Build and own a product roadmap grounded in structured discovery: Jobs-to-be-Done, outcome-driven frameworks, and continuous customer evidence
Define clear problem statements, opportunity hypotheses, and measurable success metrics (OKRs, KPIs) for every initiative
Create compelling business cases with explicit ROI, adoption, and value-realization criteria
Identify market opportunities across enterprise operations, managed services, and infrastructure markets; drive positioning and GTM strategy

Manage cross- Manage cross-pillar dependencies across Drive Test, Probe, Mobile App/SDK, and Analytics — ensuring coherent workflows and data flows end-to-end.
AI-Powered Network Testing & Automation
Own the end-to-end productization of AI capabilities across network testing — from identifying use cases and defining requirements to feature design, development, integration, rollout, and adoption.
Build AI-driven features that automatically analyze drive-test, probe-test, network events, alarms, and performance data to identify anomalies and service-impacting issues.
Develop Automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) capabilities that correlate events, alarms, KPIs, topology, configuration changes, and test results to determine probable root causes.
Build intelligent closed-loop validation where the platform detects an issue, triggers the appropriate drive/probe test, analyzes the result, recommends or initiates remediation, and automatically re-tests to validate resolution.

Design and implement pricing strategies: tiered licensing, consumption-based SaaS, and value-based models
Collaborate with Sales to develop value propositions, competitive differentiation, and sales enablement materials (battle cards, solution briefs)

Job Summary

At Arctic Wolf, you won t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - youll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We re looking for a Product Manager-Platform to be part of making this/that happen.

Position Overview and Objective

This Technical Product Manager role drives requirements, execution, and delivery for reliable, scalable data lake infrastructure and intelligent AI/ML capabilities that power Arctic Wolf s security products and platform operations. The TPM translates complex business, security, and operational needs into clear product requirements and technical specifications-initially supporting 1-2 engineering squads (scaling to 2+) across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and milestone tracking. The role collaborates closely with Data Engineers, Data Science Engineers, Platform Architects and cross-functional stakeholders to support use cases such as log availability, telemetry analysis, threat detection, and intelligent alerting while ensuring solutions adhere to robust data security, privacy, and governance standards. The role requires foundational technical fluency in distributed data systems and AI/ML lifecycles, Agile execution, and the ability to represent data platform capabilities authoritatively to integrating teams.

Responsibilities

  • Works with senior PMs to understand how data platform infrastructure and AI-enabled capabilities align with the broader platform vision and roadmap.
  • Gathers and authors requirements, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for data pipelines, query services, data lake access layers, and AI/ML model integration workflows. Defines project-level success criteria.
  • Owns the product backlog and delivery execution for 1-2 engineering squads (growing to 2+), managing prioritization, dependencies, risk mitigation, and on-time release milestones.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders (Platform Engineering, Data Science teams, Security Operations, and Architecture) to assess system capabilities, onstraints, and architectural trade-offs.
  • Validates, where possible, that High-Level Designs (HLDs) cover all validated use cases, data processing workflows, and performance requirements for platform features.
  • Presents direction, roadmaps, and delivery status for data platform and intelligent capabilities to development teams and consuming product stakeholders.
  • Answers authoritatively questions from teams integrating against data platform APIs, pipelines, and data access layers: what is supported today, what needs to be specified, and what is out of scope.
  • Identifies high-demand, heavy-lift platform requests, cost-optimization opportunities, and emerging AI use cases for consideration in future strategy and planning sessions.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Knowledge of Product Management discipline, requirements definition, and Agile/Scrum ceremonies and practices.
  • Educational background in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or 2-5 years of equivalent technical/product experience.
  • Foundational understanding of distributed data systems, data pipelines, relational/non-relational data modeling, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure components (e.g., AWS, GCP).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and lifecycle concepts (e.g., training datasets, model evaluation metrics, inference pipelines, anomaly detection, or NLP).
  • Understanding of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Begins to develop a system-level approach, understanding how data platform architecture, query performance, and indexing decisions ripple across consuming security products and operational costs.
  • Exposure to security concepts such as logging pipelines, telemetry analysis, monitoring, or threat detection systems a plus.

Complexity and Problem Solving

  • Collaborates with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Data Science Engineers, and internal stakeholders to maintain backlog priority, sizing, and acceptance criteria for data platform and AI enablement work.
  • Communicates and escalates unexpected delays, cross-team blockers, data quality issues, or non-prioritized asks from integrating teams.
  • Analyzes platform telemetry, query latency/throughput, data reliability metrics, and performance signals to determine the highest-value backlog items and platform optimizations.

Collaboration & Interaction

  • Partners with Engineering to define technical acceptance criteria and ensure tickets/epics are properly documented before scheduling into sprints.
  • Collaborates with consuming product teams and operational stakeholders to define success criteria and validate that data platform and AI features resolve the intended operational challenges.
  • Engages Engineering to monitor telemetry related to platform usage, storage/compute efficiency, and AI effectiveness, reporting regularly on key operational metrics.
  • Develops strong working relationships with Engineering and Data Science teams as a trusted technical subject-matter partner, and proactively collaborates with peer Product Managers as well as cross functional teams.

Why This Role

This is real technical ownership, not requirements administration. Youll partner directly with engineering on systems that the rest of the platform depends on, with genuine architectural input: reviewing HLDs, shaping tradeoffs, and building prototypes to test direction before engineering commits. Youll join a small team at the ground floor of one of the first governed AI-access layers in the security industry, with a growth path shaped by how fast this space matures, not a fixed org chart.

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

You will identify high-impact problems, create the roadmap, write clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure results. About Us

Mercari is a Japan-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy & sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.

Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.

For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.

About Mercari India

Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercaris applications. What you'll do:

Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?

How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on

jobs.descriptionHtmlOrText:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You start the day by reviewing portfolio-level progress across substation and grid monitoring products, gaining an overview of roadmap delivery, key risks, and interdependencies across regions and asset classes.

You meet with Product Managers to review product roadmaps, customer priorities, and execution status, ensuring alignment with the overall portfolio direction and business objectives. You work with R&D and engineering leaders to address major technical or capacity constraints and to ensure investments are focused on the most strategic initiatives.

In the afternoon, you focus on portfolio planning and steering: shaping the integrated portfolio roadmap, prioritizing initiatives across products, making investment trade-offs, and aligning with regional, commercial, and service organizations. You end the day advancing the long-term portfolio strategy for how Siemens Energy enables smarter, more resilient grid operations through monitoring, analytics, and digitalization.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Lead the Substation & Grid Monitoring portfolio, defining and owning the portfolio strategy and roadmap across asset classes, while driving prioritization and strategic trade offs to maximize customer value and business impact. 
Govern product strategy and roadmaps, providing oversight and challenge to ensure alignment with portfolio priorities, business objectives, and coherent execution across all products. 
Own the Health & Analytics Center (HAC) portfolio vision, setting strategic objectives, investment focus, and success criteria, while ensuring consistent translation into end to end product strategies and roadmaps. 
Shape the Digital Substation portfolio direction, defining priorities across monitoring, protection, control, and analytics, and ensuring cross product and cross unit alignment at portfolio level. 
Drive portfolio integration and cross functional alignment, resolving prioritization and dependency conflicts, setting portfolio guardrails, and ensuring clarity across regions, product lines, and adjacent portfolios. 
Hold portfolio level financial and organizational accountability, including R&D, CAPEX and OPEX planning, budget allocation, leadership and development of Product Management and Engineering functions, and external representation with customers, partners, and industry forums.


What You Bring

Completed university degree in electrical engineering or energy technology.
Strong product management and portfolio leadership experience in grid digitalization, substation automation with a proven ability to define product vision, portfolio strategy, and investment priorities across digital and physical grid domains.
Deep domain, technology, and digital understanding of grid digitalization concepts, protection & control systems, condition monitoring technologies, inspection data integration with strong software development foundations and machine learning analytics expertise as a distinct advantage, enabling informed portfolio-level strategic decisions grounded in technical and operational reality.
Demonstrated ability to lead and govern complex product portfolios, including responsibility for significant R&D budgets, CAPEX, and OPEX, and the capability to drive clear prioritization and investment trade-offs across grid digitalization initiatives and products.
Proven capability to translate customer needs, grid operational challenges, and market trends into differentiated product and portfolio strategies, working closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams to ensure effective translation into product strategies, roadmaps, and delivery outcomes.
Strong technical and business communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with customers, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders on grid digitalization strategy, product direction, and technology-enabled business value.
Collaborative yet decisive leadership style, suited to cross-functional, multi-disciplinary environments, with a demonstrated ability to align Product Management and Engineering teams around portfolio strategy, while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.


About The Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical


We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

DESCRIPTION

Join Amazon Pharmacy's Fulfillment Product team and shape the systems that determine how medications are dispensed, verified, and shipped to patients. You will execute the product roadmap to drive performance for the 1P Warehouse Management System (WMS) — the unified platform being built on AFT (Amazon Fulfillment Technologies) primitives to orchestrate pharmacy fulfillment within the four walls.
Pharmacy fulfillment is unlike retail: workflows span controlled substance compliance (DEA chain-of-custody), cold chain handling, pharmacist verification gates, and dynamic re-routing for problem states — all under HIPAA constraints. Every system you define and measure operates within these regulatory and operational realities, across small-format sites, regional fulfillment centers, and kiosks.
We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager to own the product execution on how Amazon Pharmacy executes fill, verify, and pack — the core dispensing workflow that turns a prescription into a shipment. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers building workcell execution services, operator tooling, and the hardware abstraction layers that connect our software to pharmacy automation

Key job responsibilities

2. Define and track metrics across the fill-verify-pack pipeline; identify bottlenecks, set targets, and partner with engineering to deliver measurable improvements in speed, accuracy, and cost-per-shipment.
3. Work with Hardware and Software Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Clinical Excellence, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
4. Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

Sr Data Product Manager , Global SAP Analytics

GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

Position Overview

The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) leads the strategy, design, and delivery of trusted, high-value data products for McCormick’s SAP Analytics. This role is accountable for the end-to-end lifecycle, quality, and adoption of SAP Analytics data products that enable measurable business outcomes — including strategic decision-making, performance transparency, and operational excellence across McCormick.

The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) is accountable for the definition, championing, and most importantly, delivery of trusted, high-value data products. The role works as one with McCormick’s Transformation & Technology (including Data & Analytics, Data Governance, Information Security and Technology teams) and Global Business Solutions (including Automation and Data Science & Engineering teams) functions to connect people, platforms, and processes — establishing a trusted, intelligent, and connected SAP Analytics data foundation that supports McCormick’s global growth and enterprise value creation.

Key Responsibilities

Description

Data Product Strategy & Vision: Defines the strategy and roadmap for SAP Analytics data products that enable functional priorities and deliver measurable business value in alignment with McCormick’s enterprise data strategies—both at the functional level, as established by the Data Owner, and at the enterprise level as established by the Chief Data & Analytics Officer (CDAO). Partners with stakeholders and Transformation & Technology Business Relationship Managers (BRMs) to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, ROI potential, and readiness for advanced analytics and AI applications. Directs the design and delivery of data products that generate tangible business outcomes while ensuring scalability, interoperability, and long‑term sustainability. Establishes and maintains strong cross‑functional alignment to effectively prioritize initiatives, communicate progress, and advance McCormick’s data‑driven transformation.

Data Product Lifecycle Ownership: Directs the planning, prioritization, and delivery of SAP Analytic data products through an agile, iterative approach that ensures responsiveness to evolving business needs. Manages the data product backlog—translating functional requirements into clear, actionable user stories—and directs Data Engineers, Data Architects (who are part of the AI and analytics product teams), and Data Stewards to deliver high-quality, secure, and accessible data solutions. Oversees release planning and approval in alignment with governance and quality standards.

Data Quality, Trust & Compliance: Drives adherence to enterprise and functional standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, and compliance across SAP Analytic data products. Partners with key stakeholders to embed governance and regulatory requirements into data product design and delivery. Monitors data quality and trust metrics, driving continuous improvement to ensure data products remain reliable, reusable, and fit for analytical and AI-driven use cases.

Data Enablement & Workforce Readiness: Enables relevant stakeholders to easily find, understand, and use trusted data by ensuring data products are well-documented, cataloged, and supported with clear usage guidance. Partners with key stakeholders to maintain accurate catalog entries, metadata, and reference materials that promote consistent and compliant data use. Leads initiatives to strengthen engagement with data products and activate a culture where data is valued, trusted, and responsibly used as “ground truth”.

Data Product Performance & Value Realization: Defines and tracks performance metrics to measure the adoption, quality, and business impact of SAP Analytic data products. Establishes feedback loops that leverage usage insights and stakeholder input to drive continuous improvement and optimization. Partners with the Data Owner to quantify and communicate data product value, demonstrating significant advancement McCormick’s digital and AI transformation.

Required Qualifications

Level of Education and Discipline

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or other applicable field
Candidates with strong SAP Analytics qualifications and a demonstrated track record of data literacy may also be considered in lieu of the above degree requirements

Experience - functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen

15+ years of experience in data product management, data strategy, or data governance within a complex or global organization
12+ years of experience in SAP Analytics within the CPG, food, or manufacturing industries
Proven ability to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of data products, from vision and roadmap through delivery and adoption
Strong understanding of data architecture, quality, metadata, and governance, with the ability to connect technical design to business value and apply modern data product concepts (e.g. data mesh)
Demonstrated success working in Agile environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams including Data Engineering, IT, and business stakeholders
Solid business acumen and communication skills, with experience quantifying data product value and driving data adoption across functions

Interpersonal Skills - leadership, interactions, communication, influence

Strategic thinking skills are essential to develop data products that create business value and support key business objectives and strategies. By connecting business context with technical execution, the role balances competing needs, prioritizes product backlogs, and ensures successful delivery of data products that achieve business objectives while driving accountability for data quality, governance, and adoption within an Agile, iterative environment.

Influencing and collaboration skills are critical to align diverse stakeholders and advance McCormick’s enterprise data and governance strategy. The Data Product Owner builds trusted relationships across multiple functions including RDQR, Transformation & Technology, and Global Business Solutions, leading through influence and collaboration to deliver data products that meet evolving business needs.

Communication skills are required to articulate data product vision, value, and progress in a clear and compelling way. The role tailors messages to different audiences, ensuring complex ideas are conveyed with clarity and purpose. Active listening, transparency, and structured communication are used to align expectations, secure engagement, and reinforce accountability for trusted, high‑value data products.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value
